declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve actual per-worker SessionLocal creation and finally close, without importing/executing a real database session during review.

declaration_reviews.name: _document_permission_exists
declaration_reviews.decision: Removed the private duplicate hand-written ACL query after real document read_scope became the authoritative owner, including membership, dataset, document and group permissions.

declaration_reviews.name: search_documents
declaration_reviews.decision: Require bound tenant/actor scope, validate requested dataset range and actual dataset/document permissions, and pass authoritative identity plus filtered IDs to the real retriever. Explicit empty document IDs return no results before retrieval. Real Documents are direct; failures raise MCPToolError.

declaration_reviews.name: _document_content_error
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve exact document/content/page/error failure payload rather than fabricate success.

declaration_reviews.name: _document_content_ids
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep required business UUID parsing and bind tenant from verified caller scope. Requested dataset/document hints restrict scope but never grant access; absent/empty/forged scope fails and no default tenant is guessed.

declaration_reviews.name: _document_content_limit
declaration_reviews.decision: Retain explicit min1000/max500000/default50000 source-character limit policy.

declaration_reviews.name: _load_scoped_document
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve required tenant/document/active-document query and exact dataset post-check; no actual DB query is run.

declaration_reviews.name: _can_read_document_content
declaration_reviews.decision: Delegate to existing read_scope.get_allowed_document_id_sets rather than infer access from requested IDs or a hand-written partial ACL. Blank/absent actors fail; actual member/dataset/document/group permissions remain authoritative.

declaration_reviews.name: _load_document_content_chunks
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve tenant/document/disabled predicates and stable order. Existing active-key-empty fallback matches the actual document_structure owner and remains the established compatibility policy; this task does not redefine pipeline-version selection.

declaration_reviews.name: _filter_document_chunks_by_page
declaration_reviews.decision: Finding: page_number=0 becomes -1 through truthiness and cannot be read; compare actual optional page values and narrow numeric conversion failures.

declaration_reviews.name: _assemble_document_content
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve real text order, separators, source-character budget, page zero and accurate returned_chunks/truncated accounting.

declaration_reviews.name: _load_scoped_document_content_chunks
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep document/dataset/tenant/ACL gates before chunk query and actual active-pipeline/page routing.

declaration_reviews.name: _build_document_content_result
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve actual source filename/type/count/page/content/truncation response fields.

declaration_reviews.name: _get_document_content_sync
declaration_reviews.decision: Retain explicit tool error payload and actual session/context ownership; no invalid result is silently labeled success by this function.

declaration_reviews.name: get_document_content
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep per-call worker/session owner, document/dataset/page/budget and bound scope; convert its own explicit failed result into MCPToolError for truthful registry status.

declaration_reviews.name: _get_document_sync
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep exact active document+tenant+dataset filters and ACL owner before returning metadata; UUID handling may be narrowed at the real boundary.

declaration_reviews.name: get_document
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve actual sync worker and bound scope; known document failure becomes explicit control error, not successful opaque data.

declaration_reviews.name: _get_document_structure_sync
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve required dataset/UUID validation and authorized structure loader arguments; retain existing explicit schema/error payload.

declaration_reviews.name: get_document_structure
declaration_reviews.decision: Retain worker/max_nodes/identity forwarding to existing authorized structure owner and explicit failed-result control.

declaration_reviews.name: _page_number
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve invalid user-page sentinel while narrowing recovery to actual integer conversion errors.

declaration_reviews.name: _page_token_values
declaration_reviews.decision: Retain positive-page/ascending or reversed range normalization and 100-page per-token bound.

declaration_reviews.name: _parse_pages_selector
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep actual integer/string selector boundary, stable sorted deduplication and global100 page cap; invalid required selectors must not silently request all content.

declaration_reviews.name: _get_page_content_sync
declaration_reviews.decision: Finding: invalid required selector read the whole document. The real registered schema requires pages; empty/invalid selectors now fail, while positive/reversed/ranged valid grammar and actual character budget remain unchanged. Every page uses trusted scope and actual permission checks.

declaration_reviews.name: get_page_content
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve required page selector, actual worker/scope/budget and explicit control failure rather than whole-document fallback.

declaration_reviews.name: _SafeMathEvaluator
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve the bounded AST interpreter; never replace it with eval/exec or broaden allowed syntax/function vocabulary.

declaration_reviews.name: _SafeMathEvaluator.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: Own actual allowed names and per-evaluation node counter.

declaration_reviews.name: _SafeMathEvaluator._bump
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve explicit AST node cap and real complexity error.

declaration_reviews.name: _SafeMathEvaluator._ensure_number_safe
declaration_reviews.decision: Finding: nonfinite floats and complex arithmetic results pass as successful JSON tool values; reject unsupported/nonfinite numeric results while retaining valid integer bit-limit policy.

declaration_reviews.name: _SafeMathEvaluator._validate_pow_exponent
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep integer exponent/estimated-bit limits and exact valid exponent rules.

declaration_reviews.name: _SafeMathEvaluator._safe_pow
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve safe two/three-argument pow formulas and explicit bool/modulus constraints.

declaration_reviews.name: _SafeMathEvaluator._expression
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep actual expression-body delegation.

declaration_reviews.name: _SafeMathEvaluator._constant
declaration_reviews.decision: Retain numeric-only non-bool literal gate and actual safety validation.

declaration_reviews.name: _SafeMathEvaluator._unary
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve only unary +/- operations and real result validation.

declaration_reviews.name: _SafeMathEvaluator._safe_multiply
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep bounded integer multiplication preflight and original multiplication formula.

declaration_reviews.name: _SafeMathEvaluator._binary
declaration_reviews.decision: Retain exact allowed operators, special safe-power owner and actual result validation.

declaration_reviews.name: _SafeMathEvaluator._name
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve exact allowed-name lookup, numeric constants and function-must-be-called error.

declaration_reviews.name: _SafeMathEvaluator._call
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep direct named calls only, no kwargs, actual function table and safe-pow override; no arbitrary attribute invocation.

declaration_reviews.name: _SafeMathEvaluator._sequence
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve bounded recursive tuple/list argument support for existing sum/min/max functions.

declaration_reviews.name: _SafeMathEvaluator.evaluate
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep original AST type dispatch and explicit unsupported-expression failure.

declaration_reviews.name: _safe_eval_math
declaration_reviews.decision: Retain real length/node/syntax boundary and existing caret-as-power interpretation.

declaration_reviews.name: _resolve_timezone
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep documented UTC default/unknown-timezone fallback while narrowing recovery to actual ZoneInfo conversion failures.

declaration_reviews.name: get_current_time
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve requested timezone/format and exact multilingual weekday/output fields.

declaration_reviews.name: calculate
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep every valid safe-AST formula/allowed function and successful payload. Evaluation failures now raise MCPToolError into the actual registry failure control instead of a success-counted data dictionary.

declaration_reviews.name: format_number
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve original format options/output/error contract; invalid external formatting reports failure.

declaration_reviews.name: convert_units
declaration_reviews.decision: Reject nonfinite/non-number and mismatched dimensions via MCPToolError. Preserve all valid same-dimension and C/F/K formulas; real failures reach registry ToolResult(False).

declaration_reviews.name: _convert_temperature
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve exact C/F/K conversion constants/formulas and explicit unknown-unit errors.

declaration_reviews.name: count_text
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep original character/word/line/paragraph counting definitions and output fields.

declaration_reviews.name: extract_keywords
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve complete English/CJK stopword vocabulary, frequency ordering and current requested slice behavior.

declaration_reviews.name: register_default_tools
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep all ten IDs and exact actual callable bindings/defaults. Five document tools receive internal scope_arg metadata; tenant/account/scope are not LLM-visible schema knobs. Existing optional import-time registration remains; no low-reference entry is removed.

declaration_reviews.name: _require_document_scope
declaration_reviews.decision: Actual tool boundary requires a DocumentToolScope with UUID tenant and nonblank real actor; absent/untrusted scope fails explicitly and never uses DEFAULT_TENANT.

declaration_reviews.name: _document_tool_result
declaration_reviews.decision: Convert only this module's known document-result error envelope into MCPToolError; error=None is valid success. This does not inspect arbitrary registry business data.

declaration_reviews.name: _search_document_scope
declaration_reviews.decision: Own a real per-worker session while delegating dataset readability and requested document-ID filtering to existing permission services. None stays unknown; an authorized empty list remains empty.

declaration_reviews.name: _clamp_int
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep actual untrusted numeric clamping/bounds and include OverflowError in the same declared invalid-number boundary recovery.

declaration_reviews.name: configure_retrieval
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep profile owner, actual requested bounds, runtime profile/mode/provider/rerank fields and score-zero behavior; avoid changing defined retrieval profile policy.

declaration_reviews.name: _safe_text
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep external provider value normalization/empty handling and bounded field previews at the actual data boundary.

declaration_reviews.name: _normalize_provider_order
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve supported tavily/serper/brave vocabulary, deduplication and established default fallback for blank/invalid supplied order.

declaration_reviews.name: _normalize_results
declaration_reviews.decision: Retain external row normalization, source/date aliases, URL deduplication and bounded real result order.

declaration_reviews.name: _run_tavily_search
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep actual key/payload/options/endpoint and context-owned AsyncClient; malformed non-object response must not become a successful empty search.

declaration_reviews.name: _run_serper_search
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve actual API/key/query-filter/options mapping and owned HTTP context; invalid non-object JSON should fail instead of fake zero hits.

declaration_reviews.name: _run_brave_search
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep actual web API request/source mappings and optional no-web-result handling, with owned AsyncClient; non-object JSON is not valid empty success.

declaration_reviews.name: web_search
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve explicit provider fallback order, real failure diagnostics, existing empty-search success policy and caller cancellation outside Exception catches; never execute providers during review.

declaration_reviews.name: _embed_cache_key
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留显式space空字符串；无space的独立工具调用才取全局配置。文本SHA公式和cache prefix协议保留。实际adapter现传实例固定space，不再让模型B命中全局模型A缓存。

declaration_reviews.name: _document_cache_client
declaration_reviews.decision: 可选缓存开关的唯一组装边界；关闭时不创建Redis连接。返回None确实表示禁用或Redis初始化失败，非必需业务结果。

declaration_reviews.name: _read_cached_document_vectors
declaration_reviews.decision: 并入共享_embed，RedisError才按既有可选缓存策略降级且记录类型；RuntimeError等程序错误不再伪装缓存miss。

declaration_reviews.name: _missing_document_vectors
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除可变None槽位和五值tuple中转，查询/文档统一在_embed解析外部cache vector；有效JSON但对象/错误维度/NaN/bool/空vector均按腐坏重算并计数。

declaration_reviews.name: _write_missing_document_vectors
declaration_reviews.decision: 由_write_cached_vectors取代；先保证实际provider行数和维度，再写缺失条目。无strict=False截短、无空vector补位，Redis pipeline有明确退出责任。

declaration_reviews.name: _log_document_cache_metrics
declaration_reviews.decision: 与原embed_query重复的metrics分支合为_log_cache_metrics；op仍区分query/documents，指标失败只影响可选观测并有debug日志。

declaration_reviews.name: LangChainEmbeddingsAdapter
declaration_reviews.decision: 持有真实model、normalization策略、固定space和cache模式，保留LangChain Embeddings协议类及四个同步/异步入口；无状态helper类未新增。

declaration_reviews.name: LangChainEmbeddingsAdapter.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: 默认cache space绑定实际model类型/model/base_url，显式传入space原样保留；use_cache=False供拥有独立clients的评估调用绕过同步Redis边界。

declaration_reviews.name: LangChainEmbeddingsAdapter._cache_key
declaration_reviews.decision: 唯一使用已固定实例space的私有派生键；全局settings后续变化不改变本实例语义，同文本不同模型键不同已复现验证。

declaration_reviews.name: LangChainEmbeddingsAdapter.embed_documents
declaration_reviews.decision: 框架协议入口，调用共享_embed并明确op=documents；空输入正常[]，计算失败传播，不补缺失行。

declaration_reviews.name: LangChainEmbeddingsAdapter.embed_query
declaration_reviews.decision: 框架单查询入口，复用相同缓存和损坏修复规则；返回真实首向量，原先查询腐坏条目永不覆盖的问题随共用流程修正。

declaration_reviews.name: LangChainEmbeddingsAdapter.dimension
declaration_reviews.decision: 公开只读属性返回真实可选dimension；None代表服务端决定维度，不能伪造固定维度。

declaration_reviews.name: create_langchain_embeddings
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留公开model-id组装入口，实际registry模型直接接LangChain adapter；无多余模式检测，默认空间由实际实例决定。

declaration_reviews.name: create_langchain_embeddings_from_config
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留六个原位置参数，增加仅关键字借用clients/use_cache；与评估真实调用一致，三个provider不关闭借用client，DashScope按实际endpoint协议解析。

declaration_reviews.name: _write_cached_vectors
declaration_reviews.decision: 只负责已验证向量的可选Redis写入；序列化错误不吞，RedisError可降级且warning，with pipeline确定释放，不引入第二数据源。

declaration_reviews.name: _log_cache_metrics
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实共用观测边界，保留event/op/hit/miss并输出corrupt；非关键日志异常只debug，主向量结果不被改写。

declaration_reviews.name: LangChainEmbeddingsAdapter._embed
declaration_reviews.decision: 顺序为读可选缓存、解析真实向量、计算missing、验证provider返回、补缓存、按输入顺序组装、归一化。无[]补位；Redis错误与程序错误分别验证。

declaration_reviews.name: LangChainEmbeddingsAdapter.aembed_documents
declaration_reviews.decision: 无缓存时直接await provider.aencode并归一化；缓存启用才借用现有受管理线程边界，避免RAGAS自有loop结束后留下模型请求线程。

declaration_reviews.name: LangChainEmbeddingsAdapter.aembed_query
declaration_reviews.decision: 单查询native异步路径与文档一致；取消传播，MockTransport finally在调用返回前完成，借用client仍打开。

declaration_reviews.name: EmbeddingModelOptions
declaration_reviews.decision: TypedDict表达现有registry name/url与直接model/base_url两种实际组装输入；model_id为目录元信息，dimension=None为远端选择。没有按风格删除真实provider输入。

declaration_reviews.name: EmbeddingBatchProgress
declaration_reviews.decision: 已有实例进度记录的稳定内部结构，total/progress为确定int；未引入Pydantic表示非API内部进度。

declaration_reviews.name: BaseEmbeddingModel
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留真实encode/aencode provider协议和共同批处理状态；资源由具体provider借用，base不关闭全局client。

declaration_reviews.name: BaseEmbeddingModel.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留实际name/model和url/base_url组装来源、API key环境变量名称解析；显式非正dimension报错而非改写默认维度。

declaration_reviews.name: BaseEmbeddingModel.encode
declaration_reviews.decision: 实际ABC同步协议必须保留，NotImplementedError仅在未实现子类执行时可见，不用空向量成功替代。

declaration_reviews.name: BaseEmbeddingModel.encode_queries
declaration_reviews.decision: 公开query协议的默认alias有真实语义，保持调用encode且错误原样传播，供provider按需覆写。

declaration_reviews.name: BaseEmbeddingModel.aencode
declaration_reviews.decision: 实际ABC异步协议必须保留；不把不可取消的sync encode强行伪装native异步。

declaration_reviews.name: BaseEmbeddingModel.aencode_queries
declaration_reviews.decision: 公开query异步协议默认直接await aencode，取消自然传播。

declaration_reviews.name: BaseEmbeddingModel.batch_encode
declaration_reviews.decision: batch_size在调用边界要求正数，状态ID按每次操作唯一，finally删除自有进度；删除刚设failed随即pop的不可观察分支，失败直接传播。

declaration_reviews.name: BaseEmbeddingModel.abatch_encode
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实批大小/并发参数先拒绝非正值，子任务受semaphore和gather拥有；失败/取消时取消并等待本次children，最终移除本次唯一进度。相同文本两次调用互不清掉对方状态已红绿验证。

declaration_reviews.name: BaseEmbeddingModel.abatch_encode.encode_batch_with_limit
declaration_reviews.decision: 闭包只持有本次task_id和局部group；完成进度累计实际完成条数，避免乱序完成按idx回退；输出按gather输入顺序汇总。

declaration_reviews.name: BaseEmbeddingModel.test_connection
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实外部诊断边界把异常转换(success=False,message)，但先验证一条实际非空有限向量；空响应不能再报告Connection successful。

declaration_reviews.name: EmbeddingClient
declaration_reviews.decision: 持有真实active vector store提供的LangChainEmbeddingsAdapter，保留跨KG调用的状态对象而非无状态static helper。

declaration_reviews.name: EmbeddingClient.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: 只获取实际所有者get_active_embedding_client，不接受None再在每次生成时猜协议；该资源由store/pool持有。

declaration_reviews.name: EmbeddingClient.generate
declaration_reviews.decision: 直接await明确的aembed_query，删除hasattr候选链和空[]兜底；KG loading两个真实调用方使用同一实际adapter。

declaration_reviews.name: EmbeddingClient.generate_batch
declaration_reviews.decision: 按两个已在Settings拥有正数约束的batch size取较小值，顺序await aembed_documents，空列表无调用；删除递归批处理与provider协议猜测。

declaration_reviews.name: get_embedding_client
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留KG loading实际async入口与受管理初始化线程；移除所有生产调用方均未使用且原实现丢弃的scenario/**kwargs，不保留假选型能力。

declaration_reviews.name: embed_code_snippet
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留已存在离线确定性字节哈希算法，63组稳定输出包含三种dimension/中英空文本；dimension非正明确报错而非悄悄生成一维。未将其伪称语义模型。

declaration_reviews.name: EmbedModelInfo
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实模型目录Pydantic配置保留；name必填非空，dimension必填正数，删除复述类型的Field description/ellipsis，model_id真实可选。目录中全部13项配置正文均核验，无模型导入/下载。

declaration_reviews.name: get_supported_model_ids
declaration_reviews.decision: 按既有dict注册顺序返回实际IDs，不引入无调用依据的cache或动态扫描。

declaration_reviews.name: get_model_info
declaration_reviews.decision: 目录查找允许未知ID未命中，None只由select/probe入口拥有，不改成空模型成功。

declaration_reviews.name: get_models_by_provider
declaration_reviews.decision: 按provider/前缀过滤真实目录；正常无匹配{}不是错误兜底。

declaration_reviews.name: EmbeddingModelStatus
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实诊断结果contract保留四种明确状态和message，dimension未知时None准确表示未测得。

declaration_reviews.name: EmbeddingModelStatusSummary
declaration_reviews.decision: 聚合真实model状态与available数量；不把异常计为可用。

declaration_reviews.name: select_embedding_model
declaration_reviews.decision: 一次目录查找决定支持性，移除列表检查后重复None判断；保留provider四类实际实现与retired-provider拒绝入口。

declaration_reviews.name: resolve_language_aware_model_id
declaration_reviews.decision: 按显式当前模型或Settings一次选择，删除硬编码备用模型和嵌套str/三元；真实空模型报错。未知语言继续使用现有基础模型，这是既定语言路由策略。

declaration_reviews.name: probe_embedding_model_status
declaration_reviews.decision: 诊断API的实际错误owner；unsupported/unavailable/error区分保留，连接测试已不虚报空响应成功，取消不被Exception捕获。

declaration_reviews.name: probe_all_embedding_models_status
declaration_reviews.decision: 各probe已拥有Exception到状态的转换，删除gather(return_exceptions=True)后再次转换的重复控制流；外层取消继续传播。

declaration_reviews.name: get_default_embedding_model_id
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留现有目录选择工具的明确默认ID，不将其叠加进resolve_language_aware_model_id必需配置流程。

declaration_reviews.name: list_embedding_providers
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实目录前缀集合去重后排序；保留稳定工具入口，无I/O或动态扩展层。

declaration_reviews.name: list_models_by_provider
declaration_reviews.decision: 公开目录列表工具调用已有过滤规则，正常空provider列表准确反映无匹配。

declaration_reviews.name: _ShortlistedEmbedding
declaration_reviews.decision: 稳定离线shortlist行数据TypedDict；document_id和score必填，不增加可空默认。

declaration_reviews.name: RescoredEmbedding
declaration_reviews.decision: 在同一稳定行contract添加rank/rescore；TypedDict继承表达数据字段而非重复业务层。

declaration_reviews.name: truncate_embedding_dimension
declaration_reviews.decision: 内部list[float]直接切片；目标维度必须正数，删除int/None/空列表猜测。

declaration_reviews.name: apply_matryoshka_to_embeddings
declaration_reviews.decision: 直接处理明确的向量列表，合法空列表自然[]；不再接受None并冒充空输入。

declaration_reviews.name: resolve_matryoshka_dimension
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留既有label到dimension及source cap算法，合法source与label全部30组结果一致；source_dim非正不再伪造一维。

declaration_reviews.name: _cosine
declaration_reviews.decision: 实际同空间向量用strict zip，维度不一致可见；零向量余弦0仍为定义内结果，不再截到两者较短长度假算。

declaration_reviews.name: _coerce_vector
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除逐坐标float+except continue：丢失非法坐标会改变向量空间。实际离线调用contract已为list[float]，无外部JSON解析职责。

declaration_reviews.name: shortlist_then_rescore
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留两阶段排序与稳定tie-break，直接使用必需向量映射；缺full vector抛KeyError，零预算返回[]，删除对每个向量重新coerce及or兜底。

declaration_reviews.name: _SyncHTTPClient
declaration_reviews.decision: 仅描述实际post借用协议，不实例化客户端或假设close拥有权。

declaration_reviews.name: _SyncHTTPClient.post
declaration_reviews.decision: Protocol回调签名匹配httpx.Client.post及假client，ellipsis为协议声明，不是缺失实现。

declaration_reviews.name: _AsyncHTTPClient
declaration_reviews.decision: 仅描述native异步post借用协议，不提供不可取消的同步替身。

declaration_reviews.name: _AsyncHTTPClient.post
declaration_reviews.decision: async Protocol签名匹配httpx.AsyncClient.post；保留框架协议。

declaration_reviews.name: EmbeddingHTTPConcurrency
declaration_reviews.decision: 保存实际sync semaphore和event-loop-local async semaphore，保留跨模型共享资源限额；删除只用于不可能初始化错误的label状态。

declaration_reviews.name: EmbeddingHTTPConcurrency.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: 只初始化锁与弱引用pool，无模型或网络I/O；error_label仅服务已删除的重复保护故同步移除真实两个构造点。

declaration_reviews.name: EmbeddingHTTPConcurrency._capacity
declaration_reviews.decision: 直接读Settings ge=1配置，删除每次调用重复max1改写。

declaration_reviews.name: EmbeddingHTTPConcurrency._get_sync_semaphore
declaration_reviews.decision: 锁内一次创建/更新并直接返回已初始化sem，移除锁外双重判空后再报未初始化。

declaration_reviews.name: EmbeddingHTTPConcurrency.sync_slot
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实contextmanager在finally释放本次取得的sem，异常不吞。

declaration_reviews.name: EmbeddingHTTPConcurrency.async_semaphore
declaration_reviews.decision: 按真实当前loop取得弱引用sem，cap变化显式清pool；None是首次loop/sem已回收的实际生命周期状态。

declaration_reviews.name: EmbeddingHTTPConcurrency.async_pool_size
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留对实际弱引用pool的锁内观测属性，不伪造活跃任务计数。

declaration_reviews.name: _parse_retry_after_seconds
declaration_reviews.decision: HTTP header边界支持秒数与HTTP日期；非法/负数/非有限值不用于sleep，日期语义和Infinity拒绝均验证。

declaration_reviews.name: _sleep_seconds_for_attempt
declaration_reviews.decision: 直接使用Settings有限非负backoff/jitter，保留既有指数退避及Retry-After最大值规则。

declaration_reviews.name: _max_retries
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除只包max0的无职责中转，Settings ge=0拥有契约，两个循环直接读确定retry值。

declaration_reviews.name: _next_retry_delay
declaration_reviews.decision: 仅表达是否仍有传输重试预算；None是真实预算耗尽，不是空结果。

declaration_reviews.name: _retry_delay_for_status_error
declaration_reviews.decision: 只有既有408/429/5xx集合且有预算才重试，401/403等直接抛；429读取真实Retry-After。

declaration_reviews.name: _sleep_sync
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除bool转换+continue包装，循环在明确的delay预算后直接有限sleep，减少跳转。

declaration_reviews.name: _sleep_async
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除async bool包装，直接await sleep；取消不包装为False。

declaration_reviews.name: _close_response_sync
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除泛吞close错误及重复close，真实获得的buffered response由内层finally关闭一次；借用client不关。

declaration_reviews.name: _close_response_async
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除泛吞close错误及重复close，真正获得的buffered response在finally await aclose；native取消端口确认cleanup先于返回。

declaration_reviews.name: post_with_retries_sync
declaration_reviews.decision: 内层拥有response关闭，外层仅捕获可恢复HTTP状态/timeout/network/remote protocol；schema错误一次失败，取消/编程错误不重试，耗尽保原异常。

declaration_reviews.name: post_with_retries_async
declaration_reviews.decision: 使用同一失败策略和loop-local semaphore，await nativepost/close/sleep；不再保last_exc=None或raise None，调用方取消继续传播。

declaration_reviews.name: DashScopeEmbedding
declaration_reviews.decision: 与OpenAI-compatible实现共享真实HTTP借用/超时/有限重试/分批协议，只覆写native payload/response；两种endpoint实际存在，非假兼容层。

declaration_reviews.name: DashScopeEmbedding.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: 借用显式clients或既有pool，原生缺省endpoint仍保留；按实际/v1/embeddings路径选择协议，当前目录compatible-mode地址不再配native payload。

declaration_reviews.name: DashScopeEmbedding._build_payload
declaration_reviews.decision: compatible模式使用input数组，native模式使用input.texts；两种真实MockTransport请求均核验。

declaration_reviews.name: DashScopeEmbedding._extract_embeddings
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除必须code=Success的错误假设，官方成功响应无此必填字段；移入_parse_response并校验真正output.embeddings/index/vector/count。

declaration_reviews.name: DashScopeEmbedding.encode
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除重复HTTP/post/try/finally；继承已验证的批处理与响应owner，仍保native输出归一化。

declaration_reviews.name: DashScopeEmbedding.aencode
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除重复异步HTTP流程；继承native await批处理，借用client不关闭，取消传播。

declaration_reviews.name: DashScopeEmbedding._effective_batch_size
declaration_reviews.decision: 按官方现有v3/v4 batch cap10和应用配置取小值；不一次发送64条到10条上限端点。

declaration_reviews.name: DashScopeEmbedding._parse_response
declaration_reviews.decision: 两种wire format各自解析，native成功不要求code字段；官方旧text_index/新index均为实际行定位，保normalize结果。

declaration_reviews.name: DeterministicTestEmbedding
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留真实offline测试provider，不误称生产语义模型；无依赖模型加载，dimension由构造器确认为int。

declaration_reviews.name: DeterministicTestEmbedding.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: 只对真实缺省None使用默认model/256维，显式0拒绝而非256；16..4096实际范围保留。

declaration_reviews.name: DeterministicTestEmbedding._add_feature
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留命名空间、BLAKE2、bucket/sign/weight公式；没有把feature策略抽成假扩展点。

declaration_reviews.name: DeterministicTestEmbedding._encode_one
declaration_reviews.decision: NFKC/casefold、4096字符上限、词与字符特征权重及空文本feature保持，直接使用已确认dimension。

declaration_reviews.name: DeterministicTestEmbedding.encode
declaration_reviews.decision: str/list是公开真实输入union，除此不再message or[]；合法输入稳定输出矩阵全等。

declaration_reviews.name: DeterministicTestEmbedding.aencode
declaration_reviews.decision: 该provider纯CPU且有限小文本，无阻塞I/O；保留ABC async协议直接调用确定性encode，不伪造网络异步。

declaration_reviews.name: OllamaEmbedding
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留实际本地HTTP模型provider状态与两个协议入口，删除内部重复容错，不加载Ollama服务。

declaration_reviews.name: OllamaEmbedding.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: 实际缺省/api/embed与Docker host转换保留；显式clients优先且由caller关闭，未传才借pool。

declaration_reviews.name: OllamaEmbedding._build_payload
declaration_reviews.decision: 使用当前/api/embed的input数组契约；str输入一次归为数组，不猜其它对象类型。

declaration_reviews.name: OllamaEmbedding._validate_embeddings
declaration_reviews.decision: 合并到共享外部向量边界validate_embedding_vectors；原来dimension未知时任意成员都通过，以及bool/漏行均已修正。

declaration_reviews.name: OllamaEmbedding._encode_one_batch
declaration_reviews.decision: 借共用HTTP重试owner，parse闭包携真实请求count；无payload正文错误日志，失败对外保持ValueError和cause。

declaration_reviews.name: OllamaEmbedding._parse_response
declaration_reviews.decision: 必须embeddings数组，真实请求count/dimension/有限数值一次验证；null不再or[]。

declaration_reviews.name: OllamaEmbedding.encode
declaration_reviews.decision: 按实际正数Settings分批且按输入序收集；删除内部None兜底和max1重复配置改写。

declaration_reviews.name: OllamaEmbedding._aencode_one_batch
declaration_reviews.decision: native异步post使用同一count校验和失败owner；不创建executor或关闭借用client。

declaration_reviews.name: OllamaEmbedding.aencode
declaration_reviews.decision: 按真实batch顺序await各批，无可空输入保护，合法空list自然无请求。

declaration_reviews.name: OpenAICompatibleEmbedding
declaration_reviews.decision: 实际通用HTTP provider类保存headers和借用clients，保留多家现有compatible协议，不按style删除实现。

declaration_reviews.name: OpenAICompatibleEmbedding.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: 只在实际没有显式client时借pool；headers仍只含Content-Type/可用Authorization，无内部tenant/user透传。

declaration_reviews.name: OpenAICompatibleEmbedding._build_payload
declaration_reviews.decision: 实际model/input wire格式保持，返回值扩大到object用于native subclass的真实input.texts形式，不新增模型字段。

declaration_reviews.name: OpenAICompatibleEmbedding._effective_batch_size
declaration_reviews.decision: 直接取已验证Settings；实际DashScope host仍cap10，native subclass再施加自身cap，不默认改写0。

declaration_reviews.name: OpenAICompatibleEmbedding._encode_one_batch
declaration_reviews.decision: 闭包绑定真实请求count；仅真实HTTP/schema边界转换ValueError并保cause，未知错误不作为成功；移除text payload日志。

declaration_reviews.name: OpenAICompatibleEmbedding._parse_response
declaration_reviews.decision: data数组必需，删除get or[]；共享schema拒绝空/坏向量，真实index排序防文档与向量错绑，无index兼容响应保持原序。

declaration_reviews.name: OpenAICompatibleEmbedding.encode
declaration_reviews.decision: str/list输入协议保留，按正数batch配置顺序处理；空输入正常[]，无None变空成功。

declaration_reviews.name: OpenAICompatibleEmbedding._aencode_one_batch
declaration_reviews.decision: 同样绑定count并await native HTTP owner；取消不被Exception转换。

declaration_reviews.name: OpenAICompatibleEmbedding.aencode
declaration_reviews.decision: native顺序批处理，使用caller/应用拥有的asyncclient，未增后备线程或schema重试。

declaration_reviews.name: normalize_embedding_vectors
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留单位化及零向量规则，明确空batch返回[]避免NumPy axis错误；无把坏数据变零向量的catch。

declaration_reviews.name: hashstr
declaration_reviews.decision: 输入已为str，删str任意对象转换；保留UTF8 replace既有Unicode策略及BLAKE2公式，显式length0现准确返回空slice。

declaration_reviews.name: get_docker_safe_url
declaration_reviews.decision: 只替换真实localhost/127.0.0.1 host，保留userinfo/端口含0/path/query/fragment；删除错误后全串replace，日志不再输出带密码endpoint。

declaration_reviews.name: current_embedding_space_hash
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留真正全局配置工具，API key不参与space；仅独立工具缺省路径使用，实例adapter不再靠它猜空间。

declaration_reviews.name: embedding_space_hash_for_config
declaration_reviews.decision: 显式配置派生space，不访问全局model；URL解析错误可见，不再catch Exception后伪称已规范化。真实API key/URL查询不进入key明文。

declaration_reviews.name: _EmbeddingItem
declaration_reviews.decision: 外部HTTP行schema使用TypedDict+TypeAdapter；embedding由共享有限向量validator处理，index/text_index为已核实两代协议，缺index的既有compatible接口保序。

declaration_reviews.name: decode_embedding_response
declaration_reviews.decision: 验证真实行数组，按索引还原输入顺序并拒绝重复/漏行/越界；不丢非法坐标或把null数组当空。

declaration_reviews.name: validate_embedding_vectors
declaration_reviews.decision: HTTP和Redis两处外部数据边界共用严格finite数值/非空坐标/count/一致dimension契约；0是合法坐标，bool/字符串/NaN不是向量。None dimension仅表示远端自动决定。

declaration_reviews.name: _to_float
declaration_reviews.decision: Parse optional AB measurements with narrow numeric errors and reject nonfinite input instead of contaminating means.

declaration_reviews.name: _average
declaration_reviews.decision: Average only measured AB values; an empty observed set remains unavailable.

declaration_reviews.name: assign_ab_variant

declaration_reviews.name: summarize_ab_results
declaration_reviews.decision: Retain actual variants and measured evaluator means without replacing valid typed rows with fictitious empty mappings.

declaration_reviews.name: MetricType

declaration_reviews.name: EvaluationScore.passed

declaration_reviews.name: EvaluationResult

declaration_reviews.name: EvaluationResult.get_score

declaration_reviews.name: EvaluationResult.to_dict

declaration_reviews.name: BaseEvaluator.metric

declaration_reviews.name: BaseEvaluator.evaluate
declaration_reviews.decision: Retain the abstract awaitable evaluation contract rather than inventing a default success.

declaration_reviews.name: FaithfulnessEvaluator.metric

declaration_reviews.name: FaithfulnessEvaluator._llm_evaluate

declaration_reviews.name: RelevanceEvaluator

declaration_reviews.name: RelevanceEvaluator.__init__

declaration_reviews.name: RelevanceEvaluator.metric
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep the RELEVANCE metric enum for relevance results.

declaration_reviews.name: RelevanceEvaluator.evaluate
declaration_reviews.decision: Dispatch relevance to the chosen judge without recovering from model failures through heuristic replacement.

declaration_reviews.name: RelevanceEvaluator._heuristic_evaluate
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve question-answer overlap scoring for deliberately model-free evaluation.

declaration_reviews.name: RelevanceEvaluator._llm_evaluate

declaration_reviews.name: _is_relevant

declaration_reviews.name: ContextPrecisionEvaluator

declaration_reviews.name: ContextPrecisionEvaluator.__init__

declaration_reviews.name: ContextPrecisionEvaluator.metric
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep CONTEXT_PRECISION as the result identity.

declaration_reviews.name: ContextPrecisionEvaluator.evaluate
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve ranked relevant-context precision and its established no-context result.

declaration_reviews.name: AnswerCorrectnessEvaluator

declaration_reviews.name: AnswerCorrectnessEvaluator._llm_evaluate

declaration_reviews.name: TrajectoryEvaluator.evaluate

declaration_reviews.name: BaseLLMClient.chat

declaration_reviews.name: BaseLLMClient.chat_stream
declaration_reviews.decision: 抽象返回(text, reasoning|None)异步迭代协议；并非直接网络请求实现；当前OpenAI适配器提供text，第二项为None，未泛称支持额外reasoning字段。

declaration_reviews.name: BaseLLMClient.chat_with_schema
declaration_reviews.decision: 按顺序添加system schema提示并保留原messages；只解首个允许的JSON fence，原JSONDecodeError直传，顶层须object且浮点有限；领域keys由真实caller验证，clean-preview raw是root维护的精确例外。

declaration_reviews.name: _await_llm_close
declaration_reviews.decision: 输入真实关闭Task；shield同loop等待，重复caller取消用既有bridge消费至完成；cleanup失败显式从取消异常链接抛出，不遗失Task或伪装关闭成功。

declaration_reviews.name: _reject_nonfinite_json
declaration_reviews.decision: JSON parse_constant的语法边界：NaN/±Infinity字面量直接ValueError，不返回raw/空对象，也不改变正常字段类型。

declaration_reviews.name: _parse_finite_json_float
declaration_reviews.decision: JSON parse_float保标准float类型；float转换后isfinite拒绝1e309溢出，普通小数/科学计数值不经过Decimal或额外schema依赖。

declaration_reviews.name: BaseLLMClient.aclose
declaration_reviews.decision: 抽象协议要求仅关闭本实例拥有的资源，借用transport由外部owner关闭；实际实现必须在使用loop上完成成功/失败/取消清理。

declaration_reviews.name: _CitationReference

declaration_reviews.name: _citation_reference

declaration_reviews.name: _build_inline_citation_href

declaration_reviews.name: _build_markdown_citation_label

declaration_reviews.name: _render_markdown_evidence

declaration_reviews.name: _render_sentence_citation_rows

declaration_reviews.name: render_sentence_citations_markdown

declaration_reviews.name: render_sentence_citations_inline

declaration_reviews.name: _resolve_explicit_http_proxy
declaration_reviews.decision: 按HTTPS/https/HTTP/http环境变量优先级选非空非SOCKS代理；trust_env禁用时才使用该结果，返回真实环境配置，不制造备用端点。

declaration_reviews.name: OpenAIChatClient
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实LangChain适配器持有模型身份/提示cache兼容状态与owned transports；显式注入资源是borrowed，不以pool flag决定是否忽略调用方资源。

declaration_reviews.name: OpenAIChatClient.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: 继承既有model/key/baseURL/temp/timeout/retry配置；缺model/key仍ConfigError；新建两个dedicated client立即记录owner，始终注入SDK，任一构造阶段失败收已分配对象，保原异常链。

declaration_reviews.name: OpenAIChatClient._convert_messages
declaration_reviews.decision: LLMRole实际只有SYSTEM/USER/ASSISTANT；逐条保序映射到System/AI/HumanMessage，使用已确定Anthropic-compatible cache注解，不猜新role或丢content。

declaration_reviews.name: OpenAIChatClient.chat
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实ainvoke边界只在temperature/max_tokens非None时传覆盖，0保留，其余kwargs含显式None原样；内容通过既有message_content_to_text提取并保raw response。安装版payload merge与before/after fake调用已证明。

declaration_reviews.name: OpenAIChatClient.chat_stream
declaration_reviews.decision: 返回惰性gen并捕获本次覆盖；与chat同样只省两项None，保原kwargs/0；include_reasoning签名保留，当前text-only适配器不合成推理内容。

declaration_reviews.name: OpenAIChatClient.chat_stream._gen
declaration_reviews.decision: 开始迭代时转换messages并调用SDK astream；实际SDK asyncgen由aclosing显式关闭，包括提前stop；非空content输出(text,None)，不在generator内关闭borrowed transport。

declaration_reviews.name: OpenAIChatClient._close_owned_transports
declaration_reviews.decision: 实际owned async在5秒shield预算内关闭，sync走既有blocking bridge；一方失败仍尝试另一方，单错保持native类型、多错显式分组，成功才清对应引用。

declaration_reviews.name: OpenAIChatClient.aclose
declaration_reviews.decision: 缓存唯一同loop关闭Task，正常/并发/重复关闭均等待同一责任完成；已失败关闭不会因再调用而假称成功或偷偷自动重试。

declaration_reviews.name: _compress_text_with_llm
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep explicit invocation-failure/empty-compression plaintext fallback and exact prompt/temperature. Finding: missing default engine model is treated as optional success although the runtime always owns it; trust that required model contract.

declaration_reviews.name: compress_context_docs_with_llm
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep disabled/no-query passthrough and real Document identity/metadata. Finding: typed Document entries and metadata are redundantly replaced/skipped as speculative missing values.

declaration_reviews.name: _normalize_fallback_spec
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实配置边界接受dict或模型名string；dict keys字符串化，model通过既有metadata_text归一化，无可用model的可选spec返回None；不把无效spec合成为provider。

declaration_reviews.name: _parse_fallback_specs
declaration_reviews.decision: 支持现有JSON object/list或逗号model列表；坏JSON按已定义可选fallback配置策略warning后忽略，正常primary继续；该策略不应用到LLM业务输出JSON。

declaration_reviews.name: _resolve_fallback_specs
declaration_reviews.decision: 每个有效spec仅对未给定的key/baseURL/temp/timeout/retry继承base配置；显式0不按falsy覆盖，返回新dict不修改调用者配置。

declaration_reviews.name: _llm_ctor_kwargs
declaration_reviews.decision: 两个实际构造点复用同一参数映射；model_config始终传，HTTP pair只有真实注入时传，使constructor准确判定owned/borrowed，不引入module Any接口。

declaration_reviews.name: _build_fallback_clients
declaration_reviews.decision: 沿既有按model名去重/选择策略构造可选链，成功对象立即append到factory已持有列表；普通可选构造失败warning继续，取消不被Exception catch吞。未扩展同名跨endpoint路由政策。

declaration_reviews.name: create_llm_client
declaration_reviews.decision: 已删除从未生效的scenario与吞未知kwargs接口；只接model_config和明确typed kw-only HTTP pair。5个真实caller同批协调迁移；未知选项在分配前TypeError，正常返回唯一ownership，取消/装配失败收已建链。

declaration_reviews.name: _construct_llm_client
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实blocking构造用join-on-cancel bridge；holder取得已建client后才返回，取消/异常期间同loop关闭已建对象，避免to_thread结果遗失。

declaration_reviews.name: _construct_llm_client.construct
declaration_reviews.decision: 工作线程唯一分配OpenAIChatClient的位置，成功立即赋给outer holder再返回；构造中途失败由constructor释放其部分资源，未返回对象不猜默认实例。

declaration_reviews.name: _construct_llm_client.log_cancelled_error
declaration_reviews.decision: bridge在caller取消时仍消费worker错误，此callback记录实际错误类型供观察；不输出API key、模型配置或伪造成功返回。

declaration_reviews.name: AllProvidersFailedError
declaration_reviews.decision: 仅表示现有provider链全部出现可重试错误后耗尽；与配置错误、鉴权错误、取消及清理错误保持区分，不当作空响应。

declaration_reviews.name: is_retryable_provider_error
declaration_reviews.decision: 保现有connect/timeout/429/5xx策略；httpx/OpenAI SDK各自status读取有实际类型分支，其他错误False，尤其鉴权/参数错误不跨provider重试。

declaration_reviews.name: FallbackLLMClient
declaration_reviews.decision: 对真实非空provider链提供chat与stream failover并拥有其children；不创建新网络client或全局registry，不承诺超出既有模型选择政策的路由。

declaration_reviews.name: FallbackLLMClient.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: 空链是实际非法状态抛ValueError；复制输入列表避免外部后续列表变动影响owner，close-task初值None仅为尚未关闭的真实状态。

declaration_reviews.name: FallbackLLMClient.chat
declaration_reviews.decision: 成功立即返回实际LLMResponse；仅现有retryable异常继续下一provider，nonretryable/取消直接抛；链耗尽保最后cause，不制造默认回复。

declaration_reviews.name: FallbackLLMClient.chat_stream
declaration_reviews.decision: 只装配本次惰性stream并保留所有调用参数，实际迭代/重试/已输出判定在局部gen中；不在装配时发请求。

declaration_reviews.name: FallbackLLMClient.chat_stream._gen
declaration_reviews.decision: 每个实际provider iterator用aclosing；输出前retryable可换下家，任意一次yield后失败直接传播防重放；提前stop关当前iterator，耗尽错误保cause。

declaration_reviews.name: _close_llm_clients
declaration_reviews.decision: 遍历真实children且一项失败仍尝试后续关闭；单错native、多错BaseExceptionGroup全部可见，不吞清理失败或引入隐式重试。

declaration_reviews.name: FallbackLLMClient.aclose
declaration_reviews.decision: 一次创建全children关闭Task，之后相同Task等待/错误复现；使用与provider相同loop，borrowed HTTP是否关闭由实际child owner判定。

declaration_reviews.name: FallbackChatOpenAI.astream
