declaration_reviews.decision: TypedDict describes one normalized rule's required tokens, thresholds, weights and overrides; retain the structural contract without a runtime wrapper class.

declaration_reviews.name: IntentRouterModel
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep the normalized schema/version/rules mapping as the internal model contract produced by the loader.

declaration_reviews.name: LearnedRouterHint
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve required hint fields and genuinely optional matched-token diagnostics; the result does not fabricate confidence when no model matches.

declaration_reviews.name: _safe_tokenize
declaration_reviews.decision: Retain bounded regex token extraction and ASCII case handling for query/model comparison; there is no resource lifecycle to abstract.

declaration_reviews.name: _coerce_float
declaration_reviews.decision: Raw model numbers need an explicit default, but only primitive conversion errors are recoverable; arbitrary exceptions now remain visible.

declaration_reviews.name: _coerce_int
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve integer parsing defaults at the raw model boundary and include OverflowError with TypeError/ValueError.

declaration_reviews.name: _normalize_rule_tokens
declaration_reviews.decision: Bound, normalize and deduplicate model tokens once; empty token collections correctly reject unusable rules.

declaration_reviews.name: _normalize_rule_overrides
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep the explicit override allowlist so learned rules cannot inject unsupported retrieval configuration keys.

declaration_reviews.name: _normalize_rule
declaration_reviews.decision: Normalize one raw rule's tokens, minimum matches, confidence, weight and override map before prediction.

declaration_reviews.name: normalize_intent_router_model
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve schema validation, the 200-rule cap and version normalization; invalid or empty models remain unavailable.

declaration_reviews.name: load_intent_router_model
declaration_reviews.decision: Retain traversal/absolute-path/extension restrictions; narrow resolution failures to OSError/RuntimeError/ValueError and file/JSON failures to OSError/ValueError.

declaration_reviews.name: predict_learned_router_hint
declaration_reviews.decision: Retain the public raw-model boundary and explicit unavailable-model hint, then delegate valid normalized data to the new prediction core.

declaration_reviews.name: predict_normalized_router_hint
declaration_reviews.decision: Added the actual prediction owner for validated rules; preserves score, tie-breaking, confidence rounding and copied overrides without a second 200-rule normalization pass.

declaration_reviews.name: classify_query_modality
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve explicit configured modality behavior and deterministic image/table/text query classification; optional query signals stay at this decision boundary.

declaration_reviews.name: normalize_source_keys
declaration_reviews.decision: Normalize externally supplied source keys into a bounded, ordered unique list; keep empty optional input distinct from failed retrieval.

declaration_reviews.name: _citation_source_values
declaration_reviews.decision: Read the documented citation/source metadata locations and collect only nonempty source values; no alternate source identity is invented.

declaration_reviews.name: _collect_present_source_keys
declaration_reviews.decision: Combine normalized citation source identities into the observed evidence set used by the mandatory recall check.

declaration_reviews.name: _match_required_source_keys
declaration_reviews.decision: Match expected keys against actually observed source keys using the existing matching policy; preserve deterministic missing-key ordering.

declaration_reviews.name: evaluate_required_source_keys
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve the explicit enabled, expected, present and missing proof fields; absence of optional obligations differs from an unmet obligation.

declaration_reviews.name: build_must_recall_fail_reasons
declaration_reviews.decision: Build failure reasons only from actual unmet source/anchor obligations and keep the existing ordered reason vocabulary.

declaration_reviews.name: _collect_source_key_values
declaration_reviews.decision: Collect source keys only from supported nested metadata representations; retain bounded recursion/shape handling at the metadata boundary.

declaration_reviews.name: infer_expected_source_keys
declaration_reviews.decision: Infer optional expected source keys from real query/source hints, preserving explicit caller expectations and bounded output.

declaration_reviews.name: infer_required_anchor_fields
declaration_reviews.decision: Infer only the supported anchor field obligations from actual query evidence; do not guess missing source identities.

declaration_reviews.name: run_default_out_of_scope_live_guard
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep retrieval adapter scoring and tenant/dataset UUID scope; named ruleset and vector-store failures now propagate instead of masquerading as empty evidence.

declaration_reviews.name: run_default_out_of_scope_live_guard._keyword_search
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve CorpusScope and dataset metadata filtering for lexical verification; the callback returns the actual corpus records.

declaration_reviews.name: run_default_out_of_scope_live_guard._vector_search
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve the retrieval adapter's score normalization and scope; remove its exception-to-empty conversion so a failed store is observable.

declaration_reviews.name: maybe_apply_out_of_scope_live_guard
declaration_reviews.decision: Move the duplicated pure gating policy to out_of_scope_verifier; all real runtime/stage consumers import that owner and temporary adapter exports are removed.

declaration_reviews.name: _normalize_vector_hits
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve streaming-specific metadata score lookup and malformed external-score skipping; narrow numeric catches to the actual conversion failures.

declaration_reviews.name: run_default_out_of_scope_live_guard
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep the streaming adapter's separate score semantics and scope; configured ruleset/store errors now remain explicit and optional HyDE text is supplied through a callable.

declaration_reviews.name: run_default_out_of_scope_live_guard._keyword_search
declaration_reviews.decision: Retain tenant/dataset CorpusScope, bounded lexical lookup and actual returned records for the shared verifier.

declaration_reviews.name: run_default_out_of_scope_live_guard._vector_search
declaration_reviews.decision: Retain scoped vector lookup and streaming-specific normalization; genuine vector-store failures no longer become an empty hit list.

declaration_reviews.name: maybe_apply_out_of_scope_live_guard
declaration_reviews.decision: Remove the second duplicated gate implementation in favor of the verifier owner; direct consumer imports replace temporary re-export aliases.

declaration_reviews.name: _safe_str
declaration_reviews.decision: Normalize genuinely optional external HyDE text and enforce the existing maximum length; no artificial text is produced for missing generation.

declaration_reviews.name: _best_score
declaration_reviews.decision: Select the best valid external score, preserving no-score None; only primitive numeric failures are skipped and logged.

declaration_reviews.name: _expand_query
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve glossary expansion order and duplicate avoidance for the optional ruleset glossary.

declaration_reviews.name: verify_out_of_scope_query
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep lexical/vector/HyDE thresholds and ambiguous verdict behavior; HyDE is always a callable returning optional text, matching both real adapters.

declaration_reviews.name: maybe_apply_out_of_scope_live_guard
declaration_reviews.decision: Shared pure gate now owns enabled/candidate/scope checks; valid optional verdict absence is retained while malformed nonempty verdicts fail their required-key contract.

declaration_reviews.name: _normalize_lightweight_query_part
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve whitespace and punctuation normalization for one externally derived lightweight query fragment.

declaration_reviews.name: _useful_lightweight_query_part
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep the explicit minimum usefulness filter so empty or trivial fragments cannot consume retrieval budget.

declaration_reviews.name: build_clause_fastlane_queries
declaration_reviews.decision: Generate the bounded existing clause-reference queries in deterministic source order without adding a model call.

declaration_reviews.name: _iter_lightweight_query_candidates
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve the supported delimiter and clause candidate extraction order; only actual candidate text is emitted.

declaration_reviews.name: build_lightweight_subquery_queries
declaration_reviews.decision: Retain maximum count, deduplication and original-query exclusion so expansion remains bounded and behaviorally stable.

declaration_reviews.name: SourceKeyObligation
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve the minimal structural proof record for an expected source key and its observed satisfaction.

declaration_reviews.name: AnchorObligation
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve the minimal anchor requirement/proof structure; no extra class hierarchy or inferred identity is needed.

declaration_reviews.name: _to_int
declaration_reviews.decision: Parse metadata-derived proof counts with the explicit caller default and narrow primitive conversion catches, including overflow.

declaration_reviews.name: _build_source_key_obligations
declaration_reviews.decision: Build ledger entries from actual expected, present and missing source-key evidence; preserve ordering and proof semantics.

declaration_reviews.name: _build_anchor_obligations
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve per-field anchor obligations and actual observed anchor satisfaction instead of fabricating a successful proof.

declaration_reviews.name: build_recall_obligation_ledger
declaration_reviews.decision: Combine source and anchor obligations into the existing ledger schema with explicit satisfied/unsatisfied totals.

declaration_reviews.name: build_must_recall_proof
declaration_reviews.decision: Serialize the real obligation ledger and fail reasons into the existing mandatory-recall proof schema; optional obligations remain optional.

declaration_reviews.name: _bounded_reason_codes
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep bounded ordered reason-code normalization for layered routing traces without affecting retrieval decisions.

declaration_reviews.name: _normalize_partition_keys
declaration_reviews.decision: Normalize optional policy partition keys to their supported bounded list representation.

declaration_reviews.name: classify_composite_query
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve deterministic composite-query classification and its existing query-splitting signals.

declaration_reviews.name: build_router_layers
declaration_reviews.decision: Build the established intent/modality/complexity/partition trace layers from actual routing results; no additional model or storage access is added.

declaration_reviews.name: RetrievalCandidateSingleflightTimeoutError
declaration_reviews.decision: 实际HTTP调用方需要区分相同检索等待超时，保留503与Retry-After协议，不作为缓存miss处理。

declaration_reviews.name: RetrievalCandidateSingleflightTimeoutError.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: timeout_sec决定503重试提示，构造父HTTPException是框架协议，至少一秒的响应头有等待边界含义。

declaration_reviews.name: _DistributedRetrievalLease
declaration_reviews.decision: lease_key与owner共同标识释放/续租权限；冻结记录防止后续释放错误owner。

declaration_reviews.name: _hash_doc_scope
declaration_reviews.decision: 实际document_ids排序后哈希使相同文档范围顺序无关，Redis key不暴露完整范围文本。

declaration_reviews.name: build_retrieval_candidate_cache_key
declaration_reviews.decision: 签名绑定tenant/account/dataset/doc范围、pipeline/token、行为参数；query/filter进入稳定哈希而不是原文键。

declaration_reviews.name: _current_inflight_retrieval_candidates_key
declaration_reviews.decision: 读取本线程上下文的本地leader key，None确实表示尚未取得领导权，供异常清理使用。

declaration_reviews.name: _clear_current_inflight_retrieval_candidates_key
declaration_reviews.decision: 只清理匹配key的ContextVar，防止嵌套或旧请求清掉其他检索的leader状态。

declaration_reviews.name: _clear_current_distributed_retrieval_lease
declaration_reviews.decision: 仅清除当前匹配的lease记录；未取得lease与不匹配记录是实际生命周期状态。

declaration_reviews.name: _pop_inflight_retrieval_candidates
declaration_reviews.decision: 字典pop必须在共享锁内，使完成/拒绝同一Future的所有权只被取得一次。

declaration_reviews.name: acquire_inflight_retrieval_candidates
declaration_reviews.decision: 锁内复用现有Future或创建leader Future，返回bool与Future的稳定二元协议。

declaration_reviews.name: resolve_inflight_retrieval_candidates
declaration_reviews.decision: 先从共享表取走Future并清上下文，再完成尚未结束Future；已取消/完成是合法并发状态。

declaration_reviews.name: reject_inflight_retrieval_candidates
declaration_reviews.decision: 原BaseException存入Future，followers应收到原检索失败，不能转换为缓存miss。

declaration_reviews.name: reject_current_inflight_retrieval_candidates
declaration_reviews.decision: 公共异常出口按ContextVar清理实际leader；无当前key时无需拒绝其他Future。

declaration_reviews.name: wait_for_inflight_retrieval_candidates
declaration_reviews.decision: 仅将Future等待超时转为专用503；其他检索异常原样传播，deepcopy隔离多个请求可变结果。

declaration_reviews.name: _retrieval_candidate_singleflight_lease_ttl_sec
declaration_reviews.decision: 响应TTL和等待上限共同决定5分钟内有界lease，不能按单行包装删除这条租约策略。

declaration_reviews.name: _retrieval_candidate_singleflight_wait_timeout_sec
declaration_reviews.decision: 统一分布式轮询截止时间与配置最小一秒，避免不同轮询分支使用不同超时。

declaration_reviews.name: _distributed_result_encryption_available
declaration_reviews.decision: 短期跨进程候选也受SECRET_KEY长度门禁，缺少加密能力时不发布候选原文。

declaration_reviews.name: _retrieval_candidate_singleflight_result_ttl_sec
declaration_reviews.decision: 分布式临时结果5至30秒的产品寿命独立于exact cache TTL，保留明确限额。

declaration_reviews.name: _retrieval_candidate_singleflight_lease_renew_interval_sec
declaration_reviews.decision: 按lease寿命的三分之一续租并限制5至30秒，避免过密续租或租约过期。

declaration_reviews.name: _distributed_retrieval_result_key
declaration_reviews.decision: 短期结果后缀是共享读写协议，两个消费者需要完全相同的Redis命名。

declaration_reviews.name: _read_retrieval_candidate_payload
declaration_reviews.decision: Redis/解密/JSON是实际外部缓存边界；miss或坏缓存可旁路，保留list和dict项验证，不伪造业务结果。

declaration_reviews.name: _write_retrieval_candidate_payload
declaration_reviews.decision: 可选缓存序列化、加密与体积限额失败返回store状态；不改变主检索，网络失败使client失效并告警。

declaration_reviews.name: _lease_heartbeat_id
declaration_reviews.decision: heartbeat表必须同时按lease key和owner隔离，不能仅用请求key误停止后来的owner。

declaration_reviews.name: _stop_distributed_retrieval_lease_heartbeat
declaration_reviews.decision: 从锁内移除heartbeat后发stop并有界join；None/已停止是实际清理幂等状态。

declaration_reviews.name: _start_distributed_retrieval_lease_heartbeat
declaration_reviews.decision: 事件与守护线程由lease生命周期拥有，放入受锁保护的表再启动，释放时停止。

declaration_reviews.name: _start_distributed_retrieval_lease_heartbeat._maintain
declaration_reviews.decision: 等待事件控制有限续租间隔；Redis不可用或续租权丢失就退出，不盲目新建lease或无限重试。

declaration_reviews.name: _read_any_distributed_retrieval_candidates
declaration_reviews.decision: exact候选与加密短期结果是两个既有缓存通道，明确先exact后singleflight，不是存储故障切换主数据库。

declaration_reviews.name: _try_acquire_distributed_retrieval_lease
declaration_reviews.decision: True/False/None分别表示获得、占用、Redis失败；第三态用于允许主检索继续而非伪造已持有lease。

declaration_reviews.name: _claim_distributed_retrieval_lease
declaration_reviews.decision: 获得lease后再次检查结果消除竞争窗口，已有结果则先释放；否则启动本owner heartbeat。

declaration_reviews.name: _raise_distributed_retrieval_wait_timeout
declaration_reviews.decision: 分布式等待截止必须显式抛503并记录有界等待，不返回空候选误报成功。

declaration_reviews.name: acquire_or_wait_for_distributed_inflight_retrieval_candidates
declaration_reviews.decision: 加密/Redis不可用旁路与真实lease竞争等待分开；轮询有deadline和最大间隔，返回leader/payload/lease协议。

declaration_reviews.name: release_distributed_inflight_retrieval_candidates
declaration_reviews.decision: 先停止本owner heartbeat再用owner比较释放Redis租约，已有None和网络失败都是已定义可选清理状态。

declaration_reviews.name: release_current_distributed_inflight_retrieval_candidates
declaration_reviews.decision: 外层异常出口通过ContextVar定位lease；实际资源释放仍由单一lease函数完成。

declaration_reviews.name: get_cached_retrieval_candidates
declaration_reviews.decision: exact cache opt-in开关是公开缓存入口协议，关闭时不接触Redis。

declaration_reviews.name: get_distributed_inflight_retrieval_candidates
declaration_reviews.decision: 短期结果总是走专属后缀和解密，不能与未加密exact读入口合成不明模式。

declaration_reviews.name: set_cached_retrieval_candidates
declaration_reviews.decision: 仅在exact配置启用时按其TTL写入，返回缓存写入状态而非业务成功状态。

declaration_reviews.name: publish_distributed_inflight_retrieval_candidates
declaration_reviews.decision: singleflight结果采用独立短TTL且强制加密，不能复用普通exact TTL而泄漏候选寿命。

declaration_reviews.name: clear_inflight_retrieval_candidates
declaration_reviews.decision: 批量清理先锁内移除Future/heartbeat，再取消、停止和有界join；不在持锁期间等待线程。

declaration_reviews.name: _normalize_provider
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除：唯一cache-key链在builder与version signature重复归一化/拒绝退役provider；现在builder只执行一次。

declaration_reviews.name: _provider_version_signature
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除：单次调用只包装已归一化provider和两个Settings字段，已直接构造在key签名中。

declaration_reviews.name: _normalize_meta_value
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留None/标量及float六位精度规范；删除内部str转换的广义吞异常，非法对象不再冒充缺失metadata。

declaration_reviews.name: _fingerprint_candidate_entry
declaration_reviews.decision: RerankCandidate.id和metadata来自内部dataclass；空id不参与key，严格白名单防止文本进入缓存指纹。

declaration_reviews.name: fingerprint_rerank_candidates
declaration_reviews.decision: 保序记录id与允许的信号字段，稳定JSON哈希不包含候选text；不是按集合排序改变重排输入次序。

declaration_reviews.name: build_evidence_post_rerank_cache_key
declaration_reviews.decision: provider只归一化一次并拒绝退役值；tenant/account/query哈希和corpus/model/embedding身份仍绑定完整。

declaration_reviews.name: _TTLCache
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实共享内存LRU有容量、TTL和锁，保留有状态类；移除单行Settings包装，主get/set直接读取策略。

declaration_reviews.name: _TTLCache.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: 每实例独立Lock和OrderedDict，避免请求结果容器跨cache实例共享。

declaration_reviews.name: _TTLCache.clear
declaration_reviews.decision: 锁内清空本内存缓存；没有调用Redis或主索引，不扩大清理范围。

declaration_reviews.name: _TTLCache._ttl_sec
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除仅被get使用的单行Settings转发，get直接读取已声明TTL。

declaration_reviews.name: _TTLCache._max_entries
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除重复设置访问；get/set各自在自己的操作中读取容量，set不再先enabled再重复容量判断。

declaration_reviews.name: _TTLCache._enabled
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除将开关/容量判断分散到三个小方法的链，get/set顺序展示真实禁用条件。

declaration_reviews.name: _TTLCache.get
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留关闭/零容量、未命中和过期语义；锁内LRU提升并返回payload副本，配置转发减为直接读取。

declaration_reviews.name: _TTLCache.set
declaration_reviews.decision: 一次读取容量后锁内写入、LRU提升、淘汰；零容量仍禁用，未添加备用缓存。

declaration_reviews.name: _TTLCache.keys
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除：app/scripts/tests均无引用的私有cache键快照方法，没有承担资源、框架或公开导出契约。

declaration_reviews.name: get_evidence_post_rerank_cache_backend
declaration_reviews.decision: 改为直接读取Settings；root已将字段改Literal并在before validator归一化，未知值不再默选memory。

declaration_reviews.name: _get_cached_payload_from_redis
declaration_reviews.decision: 读取/JSON为可选Redis边界，保留坏缓存miss与dict验证；网络失败可见并失效连接。

declaration_reviews.name: _set_cached_payload_to_redis
declaration_reviews.decision: 序列化失败或Redis写失败返回False是store状态；TTL配置与client状态只影响可选缓存。

declaration_reviews.name: get_cached_evidence_post_rerank_result
declaration_reviews.decision: 缓存JSON需检查ordered_ids/score_map形状；数值解析只捕获TypeError/ValueError/OverflowError，不吞任意程序错误。

declaration_reviews.name: set_cached_evidence_post_rerank_result
declaration_reviews.decision: 只缓存排序id、分数与provider/model，按明确backend选择一种缓存，不写双份数据。

declaration_reviews.name: clear_evidence_post_rerank_cache_for_tests
declaration_reviews.decision: 既有测试资源入口清内存并失效Redis client；本轮未调用或改tests，不按无生产调用删除清理契约。

declaration_reviews.name: clear_evidence_post_rerank_cache
declaration_reviews.decision: API清理入口仅清本内存cache并报告完成，保留公开__all__契约，不宣称删除Redis或索引。

declaration_reviews.name: _coerce_channel_budgets
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实可选字段None表示未配置；已提供值统一由Pydantic验证vector/bm25/lexical与非负quota，0保留，坏值/未知channel不再逐项跳过。

declaration_reviews.name: _coerce_channel_min_scores
declaration_reviews.decision: 共享外部policy边界校验实际支持channel和0..1阈值；None仅表示无覆盖，非法值不默默省略。

declaration_reviews.name: resolve_channel_budget_policy_overrides
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留profile→mode→default既有选择序及明确reason；选中policy的budget/minscore先验证再生成override，schema不匹配明确used=False，hash/模式不改。

declaration_reviews.name: _normalize_channel_names
declaration_reviews.decision: 外部policy边界只规范化真实Mapping的str键；非Mapping原样交Pydantic拒绝，不返回空policy伪装有效。

declaration_reviews.name: _RetrievalContractPolicy
declaration_reviews.decision: 原私有跨模块类型已改公开RetrievalContractPolicy，所有真实消费者同步迁移。

declaration_reviews.name: normalize_retrieval_contract_mode
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实配置入口规范化既有none/off/deterministic/strict/audit aliases，未知模式后由policy明确按原关闭语义处理；没有新增catch或备用检索实现。

declaration_reviews.name: resolve_retrieval_contract_policy
declaration_reviews.decision: 按既有deterministic/must-recall/evidence-strict模式生成确定policy；hard fallback是现存产品策略，不因style删除。新公开TypedDict作为实际所有者，返回必需键由消费者直接读。

declaration_reviews.name: RetrievalContractPolicy
declaration_reviews.decision: 实际策略的完整必需TypedDict，公开名字与跨模块所有权一致。

declaration_reviews.name: _normalize_value
declaration_reviews.decision: 仅接受JSON基本值/Mapping/sequence，保留False/0；不支持对象直接TypeError，删除任意str(value)导致不稳定hash及泄露repr。

declaration_reviews.name: _normalize_mapping
declaration_reviews.decision: 递归删除已确认文本/身份scope键，新增user_id/dataset_ids/document_id/table_ids；实际mapping契约直接使用key.strip，不把任意对象键猜成str。

declaration_reviews.name: _normalize_sequence
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留list/tuple语义，set按stable_json_dumps确定排序；两个PYTHONHASHSEED子进程旧hash不同、新hash相同已有证据。

declaration_reviews.name: build_retrieval_config_fingerprint
declaration_reviews.decision: config真实必需Mapping不再None/错误shape→{}，合法空配置仍{}；保留metadata_filter单独hash与摘要规则，外部schema/hash字段不变。

declaration_reviews.name: retrieval_cache_runtime_values
declaration_reviews.decision: 从实际Settings选取现有BM25/MILVUS_BM25/LEXICAL/RERANK/RETRIEVAL+VECTOR_BACKEND配置，未添加已退役实验能力。

declaration_reviews.name: _build_retrieval_cache_behavior_hash
declaration_reviews.decision: 按实际HybridSearchOptions/retriever/runtime形成cache行为hash；scope参与缓存隔离hash而不进入公开fingerprint正文，两者目的明确保留。

declaration_reviews.name: RetrievalConfigSnapshotInput
declaration_reviews.decision: 内部snapshot输入Mapping必需，rag模板真实可选。

declaration_reviews.name: RetrievalConfigSnapshotOutput
declaration_reviews.decision: 内部结果承载真实fingerprint，无额外空默认。

declaration_reviews.name: _normalize_rag_config_template
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实可选template Mapping只保留已公开key/version/AB/patch字段；无模板None不伪造模板记录。

declaration_reviews.name: build_retrieval_config_snapshot
declaration_reviews.decision: 直接复制真实retrieval配置，附受限模板信息并调用同一fingerprint owner；无需在每层重复dict/None猜测。

declaration_reviews.name: normalize_rerank_profile
declaration_reviews.decision: profile为真正可选请求选择，空白规范化为未提供是已有语义；无多层异常/Any转换。

declaration_reviews.name: resolve_rerank_search_k
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留sweet_spot最少20/其它最少1实际搜索预算规则，不把该产品minimum当无依据兜底。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridSearchOptions
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实每次检索参数dataclass，document_ids=None无范围与[]空范围保持；frozen不宣称深冻结，可选字段属于真实检索模式。

declaration_reviews.name: _resolve_hybrid_search_options
declaration_reviews.decision: 实际HybridRetriever仍支持options对象与具名search参数两种调用形式；无覆盖直接返回原对象，有覆盖用dataclasses.replace，避免手抄全部字段。

declaration_reviews.name: normalize_retrieval_mode
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留公开hybrid/vector/keyword/mmr/auto与真实fulltext/bm25/lexical/dense/semantic aliases；sparse已退役显式拒绝，不重新实现后备。

declaration_reviews.name: _ProfileOptions
declaration_reviews.decision: 原私有跨模块类型改公开RetrievalProfileOptions，消费者同步迁移。

declaration_reviews.name: normalize_retrieval_profile
declaration_reviews.decision: profile只在此规范化一次并检查已退役选项；下游读取确定值，非空未知profile由统一入口拒绝。

declaration_reviews.name: is_recall_first_profile
declaration_reviews.decision: 纯profile集合判断承载真实召回优先规则，维持质量/层级策略集合，未用class包装。

declaration_reviews.name: _apply_hierarchy_overlay_defaults
declaration_reviews.decision: 已有层级preset统一修改实际TypedDict，不再各层重复归一化/字段猜测；parent/sibling=0是明确关闭扩展。

declaration_reviews.name: _apply_default_expansion_defaults
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留既有top_k最低20、threshold0和层级/邻居参数，字段从一处统一写入；没有新增功能开关。

declaration_reviews.name: _configured_reranker_provider
declaration_reviews.decision: 要求开启rerank的preset确实有支持provider；none/off等不伪装可用重排，错误对外可见。

declaration_reviews.name: _normalize_profile_option
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实可选str只strip/lower一次；None/空白表示无覆盖。归一化保留在profile边界，不再每个消费点重复。

declaration_reviews.name: apply_retrieval_profile_overrides
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留全部192组合法preset结果；基础映射先规范化，再按preset顺序应用真实差异，False/0含义不被全盘or覆盖，所有调用方迁移公开RetrievalProfileOptions。

declaration_reviews.name: RetrievalProfileOptions
declaration_reviews.decision: 实际profile输出必需键与有条件层级/邻居NotRequired字段，默认值只由profile owner写一次。

declaration_reviews.name: CorpusScope
declaration_reviews.decision: tenant必填，dataset/document tuple表达真实可选过滤范围；冻结内部值记录，不引入API模型。

declaration_reviews.name: CorpusSearchResult
declaration_reviews.decision: records与BM25 readiness/status共同返回，无结果与index禁用有独立reason，不混作异常。

declaration_reviews.name: is_milvus_bm25_enabled
declaration_reviews.decision: 只读已配置BM25开关和vector backend，明确不探测网络服务。

declaration_reviews.name: CorpusIndex
declaration_reviews.decision: 拥有BM25 store及受锁保护的一秒版本token缓存；资源职责独立于召回排序。

declaration_reviews.name: CorpusIndex.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: 允许注入store用于实际组装/验证，否则取共享native store；每实例RLock和版本LRU独立。

declaration_reviews.name: CorpusIndex._open_session
declaration_reviews.decision: 现有数据库工厂hook供chunk lookup/version查找取得Session，调用点负责finally关闭；保留注入边界。

declaration_reviews.name: CorpusIndex._normalize_dataset_scope_ids
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除：CorpusScope.dataset_ids已是UUID tuple，仅排序去重一行，现在resolve_version直接表达，不再接收未知None形态。

declaration_reviews.name: CorpusIndex._prepare_retrieval_document
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除：仅转发Document与log_fallback；两个实际调用点直接调用text_preparation真实owner。

declaration_reviews.name: CorpusIndex.search
declaration_reviews.decision: 强制tenant；配置禁用返回带reason的正常通道状态，启用后store异常传播，保留原scope与metadata_filter。

declaration_reviews.name: CorpusIndex.upsert
declaration_reviews.decision: 写入前检查每Doc tenant及调用方Session中的document归属，设置dataset身份后native upsert；不代替调用方commit。

declaration_reviews.name: CorpusIndex.remove
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除必须有tenant和非空过滤，backend不支持时明确0删除；成功路径失效本地版本缓存。

declaration_reviews.name: CorpusIndex._invalidate_version_cache
declaration_reviews.decision: 仅锁内移除目标tenant前缀token，不影响其他租户或持久native index。

declaration_reviews.name: CorpusIndex.clear_version_cache
declaration_reviews.decision: 清的是进程内版本快照，保留docstring说明native index durable，避免被误用为索引删除。

declaration_reviews.name: CorpusIndex.chunk_id_lookup
declaration_reviews.decision: 只为缺id的vector候选查pair，保留completed/publication/tenant/dataset/document过滤、pipeline优先回填键与Session finally。

declaration_reviews.name: CorpusIndex._iter_query_rows
declaration_reviews.decision: yield_per是SQLAlchemy流式批量读取协议，chunk lookup和backfill共用真实batch边界，非多余逐行包装。

declaration_reviews.name: CorpusIndex._base_completed_chunk_query
declaration_reviews.decision: 统一native corpus查询的tenant、published、disabled与active pipeline条件，ORM绑定值不拼接SQL。

declaration_reviews.name: CorpusIndex._document_from_chunk_row
declaration_reviews.decision: 显式8列投影转换Document，重写权威身份字段，只有nullable dataset/page允许缺失。

declaration_reviews.name: CorpusIndex._load_retrieval_docs_from_db
declaration_reviews.decision: 过滤和排序/limit保留在数据库，按yield_per转换并直接调用实际文本准备函数，不先全表加载再分页。

declaration_reviews.name: CorpusIndex.resolve_version
declaration_reviews.decision: 调用方Session可能有未提交写，不放进共享token缓存；自有Session用finally关闭，token故障明确None供缓存绕过。

declaration_reviews.name: CorpusIndex._count_retrieval_docs_in_db
declaration_reviews.decision: 与实际加载复用相同published/tenant/scope条件，count空值0是聚合查询语义。

declaration_reviews.name: CorpusIndex._raise_retrieval_rebuild_limit_exceeded
declaration_reviews.decision: 超限为明确运维错误并带范围计数；不能降级为截断重建或静默成功。

declaration_reviews.name: CorpusIndex._load_bounded_corpus_documents
declaration_reviews.decision: 先count再最多cap+1读取，第二次检查保护并发变化，零cap表示配置允许不设限。

declaration_reviews.name: CorpusIndex.rebuild
declaration_reviews.decision: 只支持显式Milvus BM25回填与正batch size，沿调用方Session读取/失效token；没有在本轮实际调用。

declaration_reviews.name: get_corpus_index
declaration_reviews.decision: 明确共享CorpusIndex单例的组装入口，保留store及版本锁状态的实际生命周期。

declaration_reviews.name: _coerce_float
declaration_reviews.decision: Optional external metrics may contain invalid primitive numbers; preserve None/default semantics with only OverflowError/TypeError/ValueError conversion catches.

declaration_reviews.name: _coerce_bool
declaration_reviews.decision: Optional metrics preserve None as unknown and serialize actual present flag truthiness; this is a capsule field boundary.

declaration_reviews.name: _sanitize_citation
declaration_reviews.decision: After membership testing, index the existing external citation key directly. Preserve allowlist, source-citation-hash precedence and exact anchor/citation hash payload construction.

declaration_reviews.name: _capsule_payload_without_hash
declaration_reviews.decision: Canonical capsule payload intentionally includes missing optional metrics as its established schema values; preserve generated timestamp, citation ordering, nullable traces and all hash inputs.

declaration_reviews.name: recompute_capsule_hash
declaration_reviews.decision: Copy payload and remove only capsule_hash/signature before canonical hashing, preserving hash length and serialization.

declaration_reviews.name: _signing_secret_from_settings
declaration_reviews.decision: Settings is authoritative; remove broad exception to empty-secret conversion so configuration faults cannot impersonate a legitimately unconfigured signing secret.

declaration_reviews.name: sign_evidence_capsule
declaration_reviews.decision: Empty configured secret legitimately means no signature; otherwise preserve key ID normalization, signature envelope, HMAC payload and lengths.

declaration_reviews.name: verify_evidence_capsule_signature
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep external signature shape/schema/algorithm/value/length validation, secret resolution and existing reason-code order. No signature algorithm or hash input is changed.

declaration_reviews.name: build_evidence_capsule
declaration_reviews.decision: Use the guaranteed signing-enabled Settings field directly. Preserve optional input sanitation, canonical capsule hash and the existing logged best-effort signature attachment behavior.

declaration_reviews.name: _resolve_validation_options
declaration_reviews.decision: Explicit flags avoid Settings reads. Missing options resolve from actual validated Settings; remove broad catch that silently disabled strict/signature checking after a configuration error.

declaration_reviews.name: _validate_citation_hashes
declaration_reviews.decision: Retain external citation object handling, anchor-hash requirement, exact row-hash recomputation and declared hash order.

declaration_reviews.name: _validate_strict_capsule
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve capsule hash verification before citation hashes and ordered citation_hashes comparison, with the same existing reason strings.

declaration_reviews.name: validate_evidence_capsule
declaration_reviews.decision: Retain external JSON envelope validation, then requested strict integrity and signature checks in original order; malformed external payloads remain explicit failed validation outcomes.

declaration_reviews.name: _collapse_ws
declaration_reviews.decision: Normalize source text whitespace at the citation presentation boundary; required text is already a string.

declaration_reviews.name: _coerce_int
declaration_reviews.decision: External numeric metadata can be absent, numeric text, nonnumeric text or malformed primitives; narrow to the three actual float/int conversion exception classes.

declaration_reviews.name: _coerce_bbox
declaration_reviews.decision: Retain dict/four-item coordinate layouts, nullable coordinate rejection and positive rectangle constraints; these are real source-position validations.

declaration_reviews.name: _extract_citation_bbox
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep established metadata key precedence and list alternatives; first valid source rectangle wins.

declaration_reviews.name: _parse_position_tag_pages
declaration_reviews.decision: Parse the first page of a position-tag range and reject nonpositive/malformed page numbers.

declaration_reviews.name: _position_tag_bbox_from_match
declaration_reviews.decision: Require all five tag fields and valid page/rectangle; preserve the unusual x0/x1/y0/y1 source tag order.

declaration_reviews.name: _range_distance
declaration_reviews.decision: Compute distance to a source interval with the same inclusive edges, needed to select nearest position tag.

declaration_reviews.name: _target_midpoint
declaration_reviews.decision: Evidence span offsets are genuinely optional; reject missing/negative starts and retain bounded midpoint calculation.

declaration_reviews.name: _iter_position_tag_matches
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep exact match order and source content interval between tags; invalid tags still advance last_tag_end as in the original source positioning algorithm.

declaration_reviews.name: _extract_position_tag_bbox
declaration_reviews.decision: Choose the first tag without a target or nearest tag to evidence midpoint; preserve exact-match early return and source spans.

declaration_reviews.name: _iter_position_tag_strings
declaration_reviews.decision: External metadata may hold scalar or list position tags in alternate attribute views; retain shape checks and ordered extraction.

declaration_reviews.name: _extract_citation_bbox_with_page
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve metadata bbox priority, inline source tag fallback and auxiliary tag-source precedence, including whether a tag supplies the page number.

declaration_reviews.name: _extract_page_number
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep optional page key alternatives, positive page rules, zero-based page_index conversion and explicit fallback.

declaration_reviews.name: _extract_query_terms
declaration_reviews.decision: Extract unique regex terms and prefer longer matches; term order, case handling and maximum count remain unchanged.

declaration_reviews.name: _find_first_match
declaration_reviews.decision: Terms are strings produced by the query parser, so remove repeated str conversions; preserve earliest match selection and Unicode casefold-to-source offset mapping.

declaration_reviews.name: _snippet_max_chars
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep the sixty-character minimum and integer budget normalization; remove unsupported None-like defaulting for a required numeric parameter.

declaration_reviews.name: _matched_terms_in_window
declaration_reviews.decision: Terms are already parsed strings; remove conversion while preserving ASCII casefold versus CJK/raw matching and output order.

declaration_reviews.name: _sentence_window
declaration_reviews.decision: Use the existing sentence boundary helpers without changing focus/window clipping or original source offset semantics.

declaration_reviews.name: _snippet_text
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve presentation whitespace collapse, fallback window and ellipsis markers at clipped edges.

declaration_reviews.name: _hit_window
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep the same one-third leading context and bounded trailing window around the original match index.

declaration_reviews.name: _fallback_snippet_span
declaration_reviews.decision: A no-query-hit citation still has the existing bounded prefix span; preserve sentence boundary and ellipsis behavior.

declaration_reviews.name: _build_snippet_and_span
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep hit and no-hit span algorithms unchanged; correct the stale docstring that incorrectly claimed fallback offsets were None.

declaration_reviews.name: _build_snippet_from_span
declaration_reviews.decision: Only caller passes differences of already parsed integer hierarchy offsets; remove repeated int parsing and exception-to-empty result, retaining all range clipping and snippet selection.

declaration_reviews.name: _is_uuid_like
declaration_reviews.decision: UUID receives str(value) after the actual None gate; malformed UUID text raises ValueError, which is the only caught parse failure now.

declaration_reviews.name: _stable_tag_chunk_id
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep the fixed namespace and mimirq:tag table-ID UUID5 representation; stable public identifiers remain unchanged.

declaration_reviews.name: _parse_json_object
declaration_reviews.decision: Required source text is a string. Retain invalid/deep JSON rejection using ValueError/RecursionError rather than swallowing unrelated programming errors.

declaration_reviews.name: _optional_int
declaration_reviews.decision: Optional external integer metadata retains None and invalid primitive behavior; catch only OverflowError/TypeError/ValueError.

declaration_reviews.name: _tag_sheet_summary
declaration_reviews.decision: TAG sheet name/index are optional external fields, including valid zero sheet index; preserve the established human-readable format.

declaration_reviews.name: _tag_shape_summary
declaration_reviews.decision: Only render table shape when both row and column counts parse; zero counts remain valid.

declaration_reviews.name: _tag_preview_rows
declaration_reviews.decision: Retain external column/row shape checks, cell-to-text conversion and six-column/four-row preview budget.

declaration_reviews.name: _format_tag_table_store_summary
declaration_reviews.decision: Recognized TAG table payload has actual required table_id/sql fields; preserve optional document/sheet/shape/preview/truncation text and fallback to source content for unrelated payloads.

declaration_reviews.name: _bounded_str
declaration_reviews.decision: External optional provenance fields deliberately normalize blank values to absent and cap text length before export.

declaration_reviews.name: _safe_kg_path_item
declaration_reviews.decision: Retain object validation and identifier allowlist so raw text evidence is not exported as provenance.

declaration_reviews.name: _safe_kg_path_items
declaration_reviews.decision: Validate external path list and retain only nonempty sanitized entries, capped at ten.

declaration_reviews.name: _safe_kg_path_provenance
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve schema/kind/nodes/edges allowlist and bounds, narrowing hops conversion catch to actual numeric parse failures while retaining logging.

declaration_reviews.name: _CitationContext
declaration_reviews.decision: Per-document dataclass carries the actual computed citation construction state and nullable source metadata; it is local to one citation and introduces no shared request context.

declaration_reviews.name: _CitationScores
declaration_reviews.decision: TypedDict requires every score key from the sole _citation_scores producer; raw optional score fields remain Any until their metadata parsing boundary.

declaration_reviews.name: _float_meta
declaration_reviews.decision: Numeric external score metadata keeps zero default and malformed primitive tolerance; catch only its actual float conversion errors.

declaration_reviews.name: _rounded_optional
declaration_reviews.decision: Optional raw scores are converted/rounded once; preserve logging and None for invalid primitive scores with precise conversion catches.

declaration_reviews.name: _optional_clean_str
declaration_reviews.decision: Real optional metadata strings use blank-to-None normalization here; this is the owning metadata boundary, not an internal missing-field substitute.

declaration_reviews.name: _citation_scores
declaration_reviews.decision: Construct every declared _CitationScores key once from optional metadata; required downstream keys can therefore be indexed without duplicating shape checks.

declaration_reviews.name: _citation_plugin_metadata
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep explicit plugin display/evaluable/record-identity view validation and copies; these are external JSON layers.

declaration_reviews.name: _hit_type
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve TAG/image/MMR and score comparison priorities exactly; no ranking tie or hit classification policy changes.

declaration_reviews.name: _media_urls
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve optional image identifiers/URLs and clean-DOCX URL construction from real metadata alternatives; do not fabricate business resource IDs.

declaration_reviews.name: _resolve_chunk_id
declaration_reviews.decision: Document always has id, though its value may be None; use the property directly and retain external chunk-ID fallback plus stable TAG UUID generation.

declaration_reviews.name: _family_keys
declaration_reviews.decision: Hierarchy family/parent metadata is genuinely optional; preserve alternative fields and family-hit meaning.

declaration_reviews.name: _citation_context
declaration_reviews.decision: Document guarantees a metadata dict; consume it directly while retaining external field parsers, TAG JSON boundary, position selection and media/family conversion.

declaration_reviews.name: _absolute_evidence
declaration_reviews.decision: Absolute document positions exist only when both document start and local offset exist; keep explicit optional coordinate semantics.

declaration_reviews.name: _base_citation
declaration_reviews.decision: Use required _CitationScores keys directly and required elapsed input without empty default; preserve every citation field, numeric rounding, optional raw metadata and source/hash-relevant values.

declaration_reviews.name: _tag_schema_link_values
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep actual optional metadata, diagnostics and payload fallback precedence for schema-link score and strategy.

declaration_reviews.name: _tag_row_source_values
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep metadata precedence over optional TAG row_source object and preserve table/token/hash values.

declaration_reviews.name: _limited_unique_strings
declaration_reviews.decision: External list values are bounded, stripped and order-deduplicated; preserve the exact supplied limit and omission rules.

declaration_reviews.name: _safe_join_provenance
declaration_reviews.decision: Validate external join entries and allow only bounded table/column/reason/confidence fields, at most ten records.

declaration_reviews.name: _apply_tag_fields
declaration_reviews.decision: Only TAG citations receive table/schema-link/row-source/join fields; preserve field precedence, lengths, hashes and table budgets.

declaration_reviews.name: _kg_path_entries
declaration_reviews.decision: External path entry validation keeps nonempty entity IDs, bounded type strings and six-step cap.

declaration_reviews.name: _apply_kg_fields
declaration_reviews.decision: Attach only successfully sanitized graph path/provenance; missing metadata remains absent rather than synthetic evidence.

declaration_reviews.name: _apply_media_fields
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve optional image/DOCX fields and the existing boolean has_image meaning.

declaration_reviews.name: _apply_hashes
declaration_reviews.decision: Hash payload field set, bbox inclusion, ordering point and lengths are retained exactly; no algorithm or canonical serialization changes.

declaration_reviews.name: _hierarchy_anchor_span
declaration_reviews.decision: document_id is legitimately nullable in _base_citation and may be a UUID-like metadata value. Parse it at the optional string boundary instead of .strip on None; preserve cross-document rejection and all numeric containment tests.

declaration_reviews.name: _merge_hierarchy_parent_spans
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve parent/anchor chunk lookup, role filter, source range containment, local snippet mapping and the existing update order.

declaration_reviews.name: build_citations_from_docs
declaration_reviews.decision: Retain citation construction sequence, position/TAG/KG/media fields, hash application and logged optional parent-span merge boundary; no extra data reads or content retention.

declaration_reviews.name: _as_dict
declaration_reviews.decision: External persisted JSON metadata can be absent or malformed; preserve object-or-empty normalization at this real boundary.

declaration_reviews.name: _clean_text
declaration_reviews.decision: Source headings/descriptions are optional heterogeneous metadata; retain None, whitespace normalization and length cap.

declaration_reviews.name: _slug
declaration_reviews.decision: Heading identifiers retain Unicode alphanumeric rules, collapsed separators and section fallback; path/title normalization happens before tree assembly.

declaration_reviews.name: _coerce_path
declaration_reviews.decision: External heading paths support known sequence and separator formats; retain shape checks, title cleaning and ordered components.

declaration_reviews.name: _extract_chunk_path
declaration_reviews.decision: Use real chunk metadata path/title alternatives then a deterministic guaranteed chunk-index fallback; no query or identity default is introduced.

declaration_reviews.name: _node_template
declaration_reviews.decision: Construct a complete fresh node dictionary with independent mutable lists, nullable page range and explicit hierarchy metadata placeholders.

declaration_reviews.name: _update_page_range
declaration_reviews.decision: Node producer always provides page_start/page_end keys; index them directly and preserve genuinely nullable/invalid page handling and min/max range updates.

declaration_reviews.name: _append_unique
declaration_reviews.decision: Only actual present values are appended once; None can arise from optional source metadata and is intentionally excluded.

declaration_reviews.name: _find_or_create_path_node
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve deterministic path IDs, lookup reuse, child ordering and real max-node truncation/empty-path None outcome.

declaration_reviews.name: build_document_structure_from_chunks
declaration_reviews.decision: Borrowed document/chunk rows have real ORM attributes. Preserve sort order, node budget, metadata alternatives and no-text manifest schema.

declaration_reviews.name: _iter_nodes

declaration_reviews.name: TextQueryOutcome.used
declaration_reviews.decision: 实际生成文本是否非空；不推断模型成功或伪造模型名。

declaration_reviews.name: StepBackQueryOutcome
declaration_reviews.decision: step-back实际文本与其解析metadata、失败/时间。

declaration_reviews.name: StepBackQueryOutcome.used
declaration_reviews.decision: 实际step-back文本有无，parse metadata/failure另保留。

declaration_reviews.name: ModelQueryExpansions
declaration_reviews.decision: 四种实际扩展Outcome及总耗时，保独立策略执行顺序。

declaration_reviews.name: QueryExpansionBudget
declaration_reviews.decision: 全部非可空预算字段，0为既有无对应限制语义；只在请求组装边界解析。

declaration_reviews.name: RetrievalRequest
declaration_reviews.decision: 准备请求、真实options Mapping及已解析budget。

declaration_reviews.name: QueryRoutingDecision
declaration_reviews.decision: normalize结果/evidence/意图/adaptive/channel metadata及有效覆盖各有来源。

declaration_reviews.name: StreamQueryRoutingDecision
declaration_reviews.decision: stream复用真实routing并附complexity覆盖/真实可选bucket。

declaration_reviews.name: QueryExpansionRequest
declaration_reviews.decision: 准备结果/路由/确定budget/实际模型检索mode，多query顺序开关保留。

declaration_reviews.name: QueryPlan
declaration_reviews.decision: 保存实际各阶段结果与最终变体，不在属性里重算或偷偷查Engine。

declaration_reviews.name: QueryPlan.query
declaration_reviews.decision: 读取已准备的真实query，未重走normalize或字典猜字段。

declaration_reviews.name: QueryPlan.queries
declaration_reviews.decision: 读取variant_stage拥有的最终有序queries，预算筛选不在属性里重做。

declaration_reviews.name: QueryPlan.retriever_options
declaration_reviews.decision: 读取routing.normalization真实更新映射，不引入Engine反向依赖。

declaration_reviews.name: DatasetRouteHint
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实配置terms/UUID tuple/mode，值容器不可变缺省tuple。

declaration_reviews.name: DatasetScopePlan
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实主/扩展/基础/命中范围与诊断计数，非API Pydantic请求。

declaration_reviews.name: _DatasetRouteState
declaration_reviews.decision: 仅本次路由中间状态，未保存到跨请求共享对象。

declaration_reviews.name: normalize_route_mode
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留现有Dify路由JSON mode/merge入口aliases和prepend缺省，DatasetRouteHint也使用同一规则；未新增兼容分支。

declaration_reviews.name: _dedupe_dataset_ids
declaration_reviews.decision: UUID已由真实producer解析，直接按值有序去重；不再内部UUID(str(...))层层保护。

declaration_reviews.name: _hint_dataset_ids
declaration_reviews.decision: 按输入route顺序收集实际ID后共用去重；合法无route空tuple。

declaration_reviews.name: _without_dataset_ids
declaration_reviews.decision: 对实际tuple范围做集合排除，同时保留源顺序；无错误到空范围转换。

declaration_reviews.name: _matched_terms
declaration_reviews.decision: 合法空query无匹配；对已声明str terms做strip/casefold，保留真实命中词而非伪造term。

declaration_reviews.name: _initial_dataset_scope
declaration_reviews.decision: strict或不含未命中hint时只使用base；宽路由按既有产品规则附hint IDs，不取消授权过滤。

declaration_reviews.name: _apply_dataset_route
declaration_reviews.decision: strict replace真正替换范围，append/prepend保原顺序和strict标志；无默认租户或全库fallback。

declaration_reviews.name: _apply_dataset_route_hints
declaration_reviews.decision: 顺序执行命中的真实route，返回稳定临时state；空terms/IDs是无效route不应用，不以异常代替正常无命中。

declaration_reviews.name: _plan_primary_and_expansion_scope
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留strict/replace-primary/matched/unmatched/base各实际范围优先级；每个return均有scope规则依据。

declaration_reviews.name: plan_dataset_scope
declaration_reviews.decision: 主流程为去重base、合并hint、匹配route、划主/扩展范围、生成元数据；10组scope路径结果保持，ID不重新猜格式。

declaration_reviews.name: summarize_chain_step
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实citation metadata的source/document_id/snippet可缺，既有优先级和长度上限保留；metadata_text拥有类型读取，无catch吞检索错误。

declaration_reviews.name: build_chained_query
declaration_reviews.decision: 仅使用最近三条真实findings去重与有限截断，空当前subquestion正常不发查询；正常文本矩阵保持。

declaration_reviews.name: EntityMatch
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实实体key/匹配文本/原始字符起止，非合成坐标。

declaration_reviews.name: _normalize_candidates
declaration_reviews.decision: 现有公开实体匹配输入允许外部混合metadata候选，统一trim/去重/长词优先的实际解析边界保留；不是在每次regex访问中重复猜类型。

declaration_reviews.name: _is_ascii_token_surface
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实ASCII token边界策略与中文子串策略分开，纯函数不使用工具类。

declaration_reviews.name: _compile_surface_pattern
declaration_reviews.decision: 先re.escape用户实体，再按ASCII真实边界构造pattern；不因频率低删除输入转义。

declaration_reviews.name: _replace_span_with_spaces
declaration_reviews.decision: 用等长空格保护原始offset，使短实体不抢已匹配长实体，保留字符坐标。

declaration_reviews.name: find_entity_matches
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留长词优先、token边界、匹配数限制和最后位置排序，9组含中文/ASCII/空输入结果一致；不对搜索未命中加错误。

declaration_reviews.name: extract_partition_keys
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实匹配结果casefold去重并保序，最多max_keys；无命中正常[]，未使用空结果绕过租户边界。

declaration_reviews.name: _sig
declaration_reviews.decision: ASCII casefold与非ASCII原文签名是既有确定性去重语义，空词返回空签名而非网络/DB失败。

declaration_reviews.name: _extract_terms
declaration_reviews.decision: 实际regex term/min/max/stopword过滤，保原字符语义与顺序，不引入模型调用。

declaration_reviews.name: _iter_meta_values
declaration_reviews.decision: Document.metadata真实外部任意字段在这里转有限文本候选，最多16项；已类型化Document对象不再hasattr/getattr兜底。

declaration_reviews.name: _dedupe_terms
declaration_reviews.decision: 同一_sig规则去重并保有序，输出限制为既定follow-up预算；不建新cache。

declaration_reviews.name: _unused_followup_result
declaration_reviews.decision: 多个已定义正常不使用分支共用稳定返回结构，used=False/reason真实，不是异常变成功；减少重复响应维护点。

declaration_reviews.name: _extract_query_terms
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除单次转发helper，主流程直接构造真实query term set，避免拆成无职责函数。

declaration_reviews.name: _extract_gap_terms
declaration_reviews.decision: 可选evidence_gap来自实际coverage诊断，保缺source/anchor reason；gap词与query词去重，有gap但文档无分词时现在也可使用。

declaration_reviews.name: _score_terms_from_docs
declaration_reviews.decision: 直接读实际Document.metadata/page_content；保元数据权重及2000字符正文限额，删除重复shape/default猜测。

declaration_reviews.name: _rank_scored_terms
declaration_reviews.decision: 两个映射由同一score owner产生，直接必需键读取；保原score降序与term tie-break。

declaration_reviews.name: _select_followup_terms
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实gap优先，再按分值补未出现词到预算；不增加候选推断。

declaration_reviews.name: build_contextual_followup_query
declaration_reviews.decision: 顺读query/预算、gap、docs打分、选词、截长；gap-only不再误报no_new_terms，既有64组正常输出一致。

declaration_reviews.name: KGResponseContractError
declaration_reviews.decision: 已有明确业务异常区分拒绝/损坏KG响应与正常零实体。

declaration_reviews.name: raise_for_rejected_response
declaration_reviews.decision: 实际KG响应error/rejected不能当空entities成功，用已有KGResponseContractError标明失败。

declaration_reviews.name: search_kg_query_async
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实KG查询组装和async服务调用入口，scope来自明确request，不隐式从Engine/route模块取依赖。

declaration_reviews.name: search_kg_query
declaration_reviews.decision: 现有同步RAG入口通过实际async bridge调用KG owner，未使用随意asyncio.run嵌套事件循环。

declaration_reviews.name: _scored_entities
declaration_reviews.decision: 外部KG entities的既有weight/type解析过滤保留，非法必要格式按contract error而非伪造成功。

declaration_reviews.name: _select_entity_names
declaration_reviews.decision: 按既有阈值/排除类型/数量选真实名称，查询预算不在每一层重新猜。

declaration_reviews.name: _allowed
declaration_reviews.decision: 只检查显式enabled、服务可用、真实租户/范围与预算；禁用不调用KG，不凭scope缺失猜默认租户。

declaration_reviews.name: _response_entities
declaration_reviews.decision: 实际服务响应必须是声明的entities集合，区别错误响应与正常无实体。

declaration_reviews.name: _expanded_queries
declaration_reviews.decision: 只从实际选中名称生成有界query，保顺序去重，无伪造实体。

declaration_reviews.name: expand_kg_query
declaration_reviews.decision: 现有可选KG扩展失败保failure和debug，used不伪真；耗时从真实开始到失败记录，旧0秒修为真实预算。

declaration_reviews.name: expand_kg_query_async
declaration_reviews.decision: 同样记录失败实际耗时，await原生KG调用且取消不被Exception吞；不额外开不可管理线程。

declaration_reviews.name: QueryModelOutputError
declaration_reviews.decision: 已有明确模型JSON输出契约错误；保留失败可见。

declaration_reviews.name: _GeneratedText
declaration_reviews.decision: 一次模型调用的文本/实际耗时/真实model/异常，无成功兜底默认。

declaration_reviews.name: _checked_text
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实runtime chain已经StrOutputParser→str，删除无依据的内部类型防线；原始模型JSON数组/member验证仍由_query_array拥有。

declaration_reviews.name: _invoke_text
declaration_reviews.decision: 仅在现有可选生成owner捕获模型异常，返回failure与真实耗时/model；失败不再耗时0逃过latency budget。

declaration_reviews.name: _ainvoke_text
declaration_reviews.decision: native await模型invoke，对Exception保failure/时间，CancelledError继续传播。

declaration_reviews.name: _not_run_metadata
declaration_reviews.decision: 明确未执行的parse metadata，非伪造模型成功；多个真实disabled分支共用。

declaration_reviews.name: _failure_metadata
declaration_reviews.decision: 实际异常类型/失败原因的有限元数据，原异常在Outcome保留，未吞失诊断。

declaration_reviews.name: _normalized_queries
declaration_reviews.decision: 对已解析str查询统一清空白、去重和排除原query，不重复对每个值做Any容错。

declaration_reviews.name: _query_array
declaration_reviews.decision: 原始LLM文本JSON解析边界仍验证array与字符串member；没有用删除内部类型检查来放过坏模型输出。

declaration_reviews.name: _multi_allowed
declaration_reviews.decision: 真正enabled/count/input length的产品调用条件，0 count关闭生成，不改成默认次数。

declaration_reviews.name: _text_allowed
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实文本策略enabled/length门禁，非无依据None检查。

declaration_reviews.name: _decomposition_allowed
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实decomposition开关/问题长度/可用子问题预算，保原资格策略。

declaration_reviews.name: _multi_result
declaration_reviews.decision: 组装实际多query解析结果、元数据和failure，失败字段不消失，预算/排重策略保留。

declaration_reviews.name: _hyde_result
declaration_reviews.decision: HyDE文本长度规则与真实模型失败状态保留，不把无内容编为假回答。

declaration_reviews.name: _step_back_result
declaration_reviews.decision: step-back解析规则/原query排除与metadata保留，外部无效结果明确记录。

declaration_reviews.name: _heuristic
declaration_reviews.decision: 现有可选decomposition启发式策略保留，明确无model_used；不是临时发明后备模型。

declaration_reviews.name: _decomposition_result
declaration_reviews.decision: 模型失败后既有heuristic可恢复查询，但保留原failure/model耗时；旧失败耗时被清0的预算漏洞已修。

declaration_reviews.name: generate_multi_queries
declaration_reviews.decision: 门禁后创建真实multi-query binding，再invoke→解析；保持count/temperature/AB策略。

declaration_reviews.name: generate_multi_queries_async
declaration_reviews.decision: 同样native await，已禁用不创建模型；不会在取消后偷偷继续executor。

declaration_reviews.name: generate_hyde_query
declaration_reviews.decision: keyword模式按既有策略不跑HyDE，其余真实allowed后invoke→HyDE outcome。

declaration_reviews.name: generate_hyde_query_async
declaration_reviews.decision: 与sync门禁一致，native await与输出owner职责不混用。

declaration_reviews.name: generate_step_back_query
declaration_reviews.decision: 明确step-back资格、binding与result步骤，不用动态getattr选择模型。

declaration_reviews.name: generate_step_back_query_async
declaration_reviews.decision: 同一资格/result策略await实际async模型；模型错误交共同owner。

declaration_reviews.name: decompose_query
declaration_reviews.decision: 无API key且已启用heuristic时沿原策略直接启发式，否则真实decompose；未新增retry/fallback。

declaration_reviews.name: decompose_query_async
declaration_reviews.decision: 同步同策略，native await模型生成，取消继续传播。

declaration_reviews.name: expand_model_queries
declaration_reviews.decision: 按既有multi/HyDE/step-back/decomposition顺序汇总实际结果；总耗时真实记录。

declaration_reviews.name: expand_model_queries_async
declaration_reviews.decision: 按既有async顺序await各策略而非擅自并发改变预算；真实失败耗时传后续variant预算。

declaration_reviews.name: QueryContractDefaults
declaration_reviews.decision: Settings在实际组装边界投影的完整确定默认。

declaration_reviews.name: HierarchyContractSettings
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实层级设置的确定类型，preset覆盖用replace。

declaration_reviews.name: QueryContractNormalizationInput
declaration_reviews.decision: 移除无人使用requested_retrieval_mode/profile，保实际state/query/hierarchy/defaults。

declaration_reviews.name: QueryContractNormalizationOutput
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实profile/contract使用公开TypedDict，输出确定retriever/state更新。

declaration_reviews.name: _requested_top_k
declaration_reviews.decision: 现存request/state归一化边界承接Pydantic可选top_k与配置minimum；没有在检索内部重复UUID/None校验，既有16组请求结果保留。

declaration_reviews.name: _requested_score_threshold
declaration_reviews.decision: None继承配置，0明确保留；不使用or吞真实0阈值。

declaration_reviews.name: _resolve_request_retrieval_mode
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实auto模式交已有guess_retrieval_mode，其它只通过统一mode规范化，不重复主流程router。

declaration_reviews.name: _apply_hierarchy_profile_overrides
declaration_reviews.decision: 先收集实际profile有覆盖的字段，再dataclasses.replace；删除每字段int/bool/str和全量手抄constructor。

declaration_reviews.name: _state_updates_from_profile
declaration_reviews.decision: TypedDict必需键直接读，只有真正可选contract/visible-evidence覆盖才写state，显式False保留。

declaration_reviews.name: normalize_query_contract
declaration_reviews.decision: 入口一次应用profile并直接读确定类型，生成retriever/state更新与contract policy；删除两个未被消费的requested字段及其构造映射，保原外部结果。

declaration_reviews.name: query_contract_defaults
declaration_reviews.decision: Settings真实默认由这里投影到内部稳定contract，未新增字段级空值兜底。

declaration_reviews.name: resolve_query_preparation_request
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实可选overrides只在本组装边界继承Settings；False/0/空rulesets的合法含义保留。

declaration_reviews.name: resolve_alias_query_settings
declaration_reviews.decision: enabled未指定才依据aliases决定，max_queries=None才用5；显式0不自动变5。

declaration_reviews.name: resolve_kg_expansion_settings
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实KG配置一次解析exclude types/服务开关/预算，后续依赖明确settings对象。

declaration_reviews.name: resolve_model_query_settings
declaration_reviews.decision: 一次合并配置/真实overrides/AB选择，count/temperature的已有安全预算限制保留；无把False统一当未提供。

declaration_reviews.name: _normalize_multi_query_label
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除单次可空标签转发helper，AB边界直接strip/lower真实str，减少空None中转。

declaration_reviews.name: parse_model_query_overrides
declaration_reviews.decision: 请求映射到已有ModelQueryOverrides的实际边界，保持None继承与False/0覆盖；不把模块对象当Any参数传给服务。

declaration_reviews.name: parse_query_expansion_budget
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实请求预算键由QUERY_PLANNING_OPTION_KEYS补齐，否则原builder会丢2/3/5变0；仅此处解析到非可空QueryExpansionBudget。

declaration_reviews.name: parse_query_expansion_budget.count
declaration_reviews.decision: 私有闭包集中三个有相同预算含义的计数键，None表示无预算限制0；不是给任意数据兜底的safe_get。

declaration_reviews.name: _QueryPhraseMatch
declaration_reviews.decision: 稳定match score/phrase/最长token/coverage结构，0为合法无匹配。

declaration_reviews.name: _normalize_text
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实str直接NFKC/分隔符/空白/casefold，删除Unicode规范化泛吞异常，失败可见。

declaration_reviews.name: _query_tokens
declaration_reviews.decision: 保既有regex及共享STOPWORDS/boilerplate策略，词筛选不是错误降级。

declaration_reviews.name: extract_informative_query_phrases
declaration_reviews.decision: 保长ngram优先、数量/长度限制及unigram开关，150组query/text/预算组合结果不变。

declaration_reviews.name: extract_informative_query_phrases.add
declaration_reviews.decision: 闭包拥有实际seen/phrases，统一同一规范化与160字符限制，不能因短小删除导致重复维护。

declaration_reviews.name: query_phrase_match
declaration_reviews.decision: 保原覆盖率/长短phrase权重和zero-match score0，正常无匹配与外部执行失败不混用。

declaration_reviews.name: _QueryPlanStageInputs
declaration_reviews.decision: 实际deterministic/aliases/KG request/settings组合有后续重复使用。

declaration_reviews.name: _ModelQueryPlanStageInputs
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除仅再包已有ModelQueryRequest+同settings的重复结构。

declaration_reviews.name: _rewrite_configuration
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实开关关闭时None，启用才组装已有策略spec；None是实际未配置结果，不是错误兜底。

declaration_reviews.name: _rewrite_allowed
declaration_reviews.decision: 按真实历史占位/问题长度/should_rewrite_query门禁，避免所有query都发模型。

declaration_reviews.name: _rewrite_result
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实str文本strip和既有空rewrite保原问题策略，返回attempted/used区别；不再对已经text-parser输出加类型猜测。

declaration_reviews.name: rewrite_query
declaration_reviews.decision: 明确模型/计时/调用/组装；可选rewrite失败保原query+failure+真实耗时，未伪装used成功。

declaration_reviews.name: rewrite_query_async
declaration_reviews.decision: 同样记录失败耗时，native await且取消不被捕获，保模型调用参数。

declaration_reviews.name: prepare_query
declaration_reviews.decision: 实际公开业务入口负责rewrite→后处理，保明确models依赖。

declaration_reviews.name: prepare_query_async
declaration_reviews.decision: await rewrite后同一纯后处理owner，未重复实现industry/temporal流程。

declaration_reviews.name: complete_query_preparation
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实行业和时态旁路各有failure/metadata，保原query主流程和可观测性；未默认构造不存在模型/数据库。

declaration_reviews.name: expand_deterministic_queries

declaration_reviews.name: normalize_retrieval_query

declaration_reviews.name: deduplicate_retrieval_queries

declaration_reviews.name: _normalize_exact_anchor

declaration_reviews.name: _iter_metadata_exact_anchor_values

declaration_reviews.name: _iter_metadata_exact_anchor_values.add

declaration_reviews.name: _metadata_exact_anchor_match
declaration_reviews.decision: Empty normalized queries return no match; otherwise delegates anchor scoring using the root-only value source and shared normalizer.

declaration_reviews.name: _float_or_default

declaration_reviews.name: _apply_metadata_exact_anchor_to_result

declaration_reviews.name: _metadata_exact_anchor_doc_order_meta
declaration_reviews.decision: Constructs the four documented document-order diagnostics with actual zero/false initial values; this is a result contract, not an arbitrary forwarding layer.

declaration_reviews.name: _annotate_anchor_docs
declaration_reviews.decision: Annotates a document copy only on a match, counts real score promotions and preserves input position for stable ties.

declaration_reviews.name: _metadata_exact_anchor_sort_key
declaration_reviews.decision: Sort callback changes precedence only above the 0.65 anchor threshold and retains original index as the final tie breaker.

declaration_reviews.name: _apply_metadata_exact_anchor_doc_ordering
declaration_reviews.decision: Orchestrates annotate, early no-match return and stable sort; before/after document keys drive actual top_changed diagnostics.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionPolicy
declaration_reviews.decision: FusionPolicy carries one request's strategy, RRF constant and optional typed channel maps; no shared mutable defaults.

declaration_reviews.name: DedupPolicy
declaration_reviews.decision: DedupPolicy groups the validated duplicate threshold and comparison/identity limits without introducing runtime behavior.

declaration_reviews.name: DiversityPolicy
declaration_reviews.decision: DiversityPolicy separately expresses document/page caps and desired distinct documents; zero caps remain meaningful.

declaration_reviews.name: RerankPolicy
declaration_reviews.decision: RerankPolicy carries enabled/provider/top_n from the retriever's established configuration owner.

declaration_reviews.name: RankingPolicy

declaration_reviews.name: RankedCandidates

declaration_reviews.name: rank_candidates

declaration_reviews.name: _RankingRun
declaration_reviews.decision: _RankingRun legitimately owns the selected algorithms and one call's metrics; instances are not cached across requests.

declaration_reviews.name: _RankingRun.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: Constructor assigns explicit request/policy values and a fresh metrics dictionary; _last_channel_metrics aliases that same request-owned diagnostics object.

declaration_reviews.name: _RankingRun.rank
declaration_reviews.decision: Rank runs channel preparation, protected anchors, metadata ordering, dedup, rerank and diversity in business order, preserving attribution and final protected records.

declaration_reviews.name: _RankingRun._append_protected
declaration_reviews.decision: Appends only missing protected keys and records additions before/after diversity under distinct metric names; input order remains authoritative.

declaration_reviews.name: _RankingRun._apply_hybrid_rerank_stack
declaration_reviews.decision: Runs MMR or weighted scoring first, then an optional configured provider; renamed downstream methods to avoid falsely implying all providers are LLMs.

declaration_reviews.name: _RankingRun._apply_optional_llm_reranker
declaration_reviews.decision: Optional-provider policy keeps explicit disabled/high-confidence skips and candidate budgets; method name now reflects API/local/LLM provider support.

declaration_reviews.name: _RankingRun._apply_optional_reranker
declaration_reviews.decision: Optional-provider policy keeps explicit disabled/high-confidence skips and candidate budgets; method name now reflects API/local/LLM provider support.

declaration_reviews.name: _RankingRun._run_llm_reranker
declaration_reviews.decision: Provider execution still records the established observable optional failure; exact zero elapsed time and a supplied provider string are no longer replaced through truthiness.

declaration_reviews.name: _RankingRun._run_optional_reranker
declaration_reviews.decision: Provider execution still records the established observable optional failure; exact zero elapsed time and a supplied provider string are no longer replaced through truthiness.

declaration_reviews.name: _RankingRun._reranked_documents
declaration_reviews.decision: Rebuilds the reranked prefix from validated IDs, applies exact-content/metadata boosts, appends unranked originals and preserves deterministic key ties.

declaration_reviews.name: _RankingRun._hybrid_result_attribution
declaration_reviews.decision: Attribution distinguishes actual positive vector/BM25/lexical signals and counts multi-channel hits; missing optional score signals represent zero contribution.

declaration_reviews.name: _FusionRuntime
declaration_reviews.decision: _FusionRuntime is the concrete typed field/chunk boost payload built once per merge.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin
declaration_reviews.decision: FusionMixin supplies real algorithms consumed by request-owned _RankingRun and HybridRetriever; retained inheritance protocol and state dependencies.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._resolve_query_chunk_type_signal
declaration_reviews.decision: Query text may be absent; ordered table/formula/code/chart/seal hints intentionally select the first recognized chunk type.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._build_fusion_runtime
declaration_reviews.decision: Resolves configured field and chunk boosts once, caps title/heading boosts and derives the optional preferred chunk type.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._resolve_chunk_type
declaration_reviews.decision: Metadata chunk/content/visual roles and legacy chart naming are external stored-data variants; unknown roles intentionally use text.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._chunk_type_boost
declaration_reviews.decision: Uses the typed runtime directly; zero weighting disables the signal and chart-to-figure matching keeps its explicit 0.75 adjustment.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._resolve_field_signal
declaration_reviews.decision: Field role depends only on the result metadata and chunk ID suffix, so changed the instance method to static without altering resolution precedence.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._field_boost
declaration_reviews.decision: Pure title/heading/body boost projection reads already-built runtime values, preserving zero boosts.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._normalize_channel_results
declaration_reviews.decision: Min-max normalizes numeric channel results, retains the best duplicate payload and now reads its locally-created score directly.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._update_fusion_observability
declaration_reviews.decision: Field/chunk counts are optional observability and retain their logged sidecar failure boundary; no primary candidates are replaced if metrics fail.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._attach_field_aware_signal
declaration_reviews.decision: Missing channel membership is legitimate; merges the strongest optional field/chunk annotations from the three normalized channels.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._channel_score
declaration_reviews.decision: A candidate absent from one channel contributes zero while present channel payloads supply their normalized score.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._all_channel_keys
declaration_reviews.decision: Returns sorted union of channel keys to make channel merge order deterministic across dictionary construction orders.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._merged_channel_data
declaration_reviews.decision: Chooses real channel data, merges missing metadata and borrows a real chunk ID from another channel only when needed.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._rank_sort_key
declaration_reviews.decision: Rank callback uses score descending then result identity; no incidental object or insertion-order tie is introduced.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._build_rank_map
declaration_reviews.decision: First occurrence establishes rank for duplicate keys; subsequent repeats do not inflate reciprocal-rank hits.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._rrf_raw_score
declaration_reviews.decision: Adds only actual channel ranks to the RRF sum; absent ranks correctly contribute zero.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._rank_score
declaration_reviews.decision: Missing or nonpositive rank has no rank signal, otherwise returns its reciprocal.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._build_rrf_merged_items
declaration_reviews.decision: Builds mandatory score/rank fields and aligned raw score list in the same iteration; strategy and optional rank-score fields remain explicit.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._normalize_raw_scores
declaration_reviews.decision: Nonempty merged items guarantee the aligned raw score list and rrf_score_raw fields; removed synthetic zero defaults from this internal invariant.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._apply_phrase_bonus
declaration_reviews.decision: Exact phrase annotation is gated by a real optional query and uses the existing bounded bonus owner, preserving provider-independent scoring.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._sort_key_rrf
declaration_reviews.decision: RRF tie callback preserves score/raw/vector/BM25/lexical/key precedence.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._sort_key_budgeted_rrf
declaration_reviews.decision: Budgeted RRF ties deliberately use rank scores instead of raw channel magnitudes; retained that distinction.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._coerce_budgets
declaration_reviews.decision: Renamed to _normalize_budgets: receives typed integer map or absent map, normalizes channel names and clamps negative budgets without swallowing internal type errors.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._normalize_budgets
declaration_reviews.decision: Renamed to _normalize_budgets: receives typed integer map or absent map, normalizes channel names and clamps negative budgets without swallowing internal type errors.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._coerce_min_scores
declaration_reviews.decision: Renamed to _normalize_min_scores: receives typed float map or absence; clamps configured thresholds once and removes impossible AttributeError recovery.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._normalize_min_scores
declaration_reviews.decision: Renamed to _normalize_min_scores: receives typed float map or absence; clamps configured thresholds once and removes impossible AttributeError recovery.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._coerce_weights
declaration_reviews.decision: Renamed to _normalize_weights: filters the known channel names and positive typed weights; no hidden arbitrary object parsing remains.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._normalize_weights
declaration_reviews.decision: Renamed to _normalize_weights: filters the known channel names and positive typed weights; no hidden arbitrary object parsing remains.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._resolve_budgeted_budgets
declaration_reviews.decision: Explicit configured budgets win; otherwise distributes the prefix quota round-robin across active channels and never treats zero as an active quota.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._candidate_eligible
declaration_reviews.decision: A candidate is eligible when at least one present channel clears that channel's optional minimum score.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._budget_channel_order
declaration_reviews.decision: Per-channel budget ordering preserves phrase-match priority, original rank and result-key ties.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._consume_budget_channel
declaration_reviews.decision: Consumes only the channel's quota, rejects already-used or ineligible keys and increments the actual picked count.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._fill_budgeted_prefix
declaration_reviews.decision: Fills remaining prefix slots from global sorted candidates using the same eligibility rule and shared used set.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._record_budgeted_rrf_metrics
declaration_reviews.decision: Budget metrics serialize actual selected/eligible counts behind the established optional diagnostics boundary; no ranking fallback is added.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._merge_results_rrf
declaration_reviews.decision: RRF now uses the configured instance constant only when the argument is None; required instance state is accessed directly rather than guessed defaults.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._merge_results_budgeted_rrf
declaration_reviews.decision: Budgeted RRF uses explicit top_k/RRF values, retains quota selection and prefix annotations; typed maps are normalized without repeated coercion.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._merge_results_weighted
declaration_reviews.decision: Weighted fusion still returns None only when no positive configured weights exist, which is the established request for the caller's linear path.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._sort_key_linear
declaration_reviews.decision: Linear/weighted sort callback keeps numeric signal precedence followed by stable result identity.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._merge_results_linear
declaration_reviews.decision: Linear merge preserves vector-only, keyword-only and dual-channel formulas before applying plugin policy.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._merge_results
declaration_reviews.decision: Public merge owns optional lexical/query/config selection, rejects unknown strategy names and retains the documented weighted-to-linear no-weights path.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._weight_rerank
declaration_reviews.decision: Weighted lexical scoring keeps TF-IDF, cosine and exact phrase bonus calculations local and stable rather than delegating through a generic executor.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._weight_rerank.tfidf_vec
declaration_reviews.decision: Nested tfidf_vec closes over the one-call IDF table; it is a real repeated transformation for query and document vectors.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._weight_rerank.cosine
declaration_reviews.decision: Nested cosine handles genuine zero/empty vectors and avoids division by zero; no exception blanket is used.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._mmr_doc_similarity
declaration_reviews.decision: MMR token cache is built for every participating object, so similarity now indexes both entries directly instead of inventing empty token sets.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._mmr_diversity_penalty
declaration_reviews.decision: An empty selected set has zero diversity penalty; otherwise uses maximum similarity to actual selections.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._best_mmr_candidate
declaration_reviews.decision: Scans current candidates in order and replaces the best only on a strictly greater MMR score, retaining stable ties.

declaration_reviews.name: FusionMixin._mmr_rerank
declaration_reviews.decision: MMR keeps one tokenization per candidate, the existing lambda clamp and top_k selection bound; query score is already embodied in candidate relevance.

declaration_reviews.name: _DedupRuntime

declaration_reviews.name: _DedupState

declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin

declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin._first_metadata_value

declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin._document_chunk_family_key

declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin._result_chunk_family_key

declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin._resolve_family_collapse_key

declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin._should_apply_hierarchy_family_collapse
declaration_reviews.decision: Reused configuration predicate is called by both this mixin and recall/retriever; retained the existing cross-owner method contract.

declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin._init_family_collapse_stats
declaration_reviews.decision: Optional stats and retrieval profile are real reporting inputs; no profile is fabricated when absent.

declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin._set_family_collapse_stats

declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin._collapse_results_by_family

declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin._get_doc_id
declaration_reviews.decision: Missing document metadata ID produces the established empty diversity bucket rather than an invented document identity.

declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin._match_metadata_filter
declaration_reviews.decision: Deleted unused single-step _match_metadata_filter forwarding method and its import after app/scripts reference search found no consumers.

declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin._normalize_similarity_token

declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin._tokenize_for_similarity

declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin._jaccard

declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin._fingerprint

declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin._bounded_similarity_settings

declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin._resolve_near_dedup_runtime

declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin._simhash64_from_meta

declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin._is_seen_chunk_id
declaration_reviews.decision: Optional chunk identity is remembered once; absent identity does not falsely deduplicate unrelated records.

declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin._is_seen_content_hash
declaration_reviews.decision: Optional content hash is normalized and deduplicated without substituting a synthetic hash.

declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin._record_identity_dedup_key
declaration_reviews.decision: Record identity requires a real dict/key and includes dataset/document scope to avoid cross-scope collision.

declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin._record_identity_over_cap

declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin._is_near_duplicate_simhash
