declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin._remember_near_simhash
declaration_reviews.decision: Stored hash decoding has the real ValueError boundary and logs invalid metadata; broad unrelated exceptions are no longer hidden.

declaration_reviews.name: DedupDiversityMixin._is_jaccard_duplicate

declaration_reviews.decision: 来源枚举与metadata快照是已发布诊断结果，不与候选list混用。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateTimings
declaration_reviews.decision: 未执行通道计时合法为0，不能用别的计时字段替换；属于一个batch的值记录。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateBatch
declaration_reviews.decision: cache hit没有collection/ranking，failure与candidates分别保存；外层Retriever必须抛出failure。

declaration_reviews.name: retrieve_candidates
declaration_reviews.decision: 顺序为cache→collect→rank→diagnostics→publish；with保证拒绝/释放，异常作为failure返回供Retriever公开出口传播。

declaration_reviews.name: _cache_scope
declaration_reviews.decision: 把真实ResolvedRetrievalScope投影到缓存准入，保留运行时missing ids与embedding空间；唯一配置映射位置。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateCacheSession
declaration_reviews.decision: 一次请求的key/token/lease/leader/finished共同状态，负责publish或reject，不作为跨请求单例。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateCacheSession.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: 请求与corpus必需且明确注入；可空key/token/lease表示尚未准入，不伪造已获得资源。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateCacheSession.__enter__
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实with协议返回当前session，由__exit__处理未publish与lease释放，不能按一行删除。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateCacheSession.__exit__
declaration_reviews.decision: leader未完成时向followers发布原异常或明确未publish错误；finally总释放已取得lease。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateCacheSession.outcome
declaration_reviews.decision: deepcopy诊断metadata防止batch消费者修改cache session状态，property是快照协议。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateCacheSession._release_lease
declaration_reviews.decision: 先把实例lease置None再释放，避免重复退出释放新owner；None是未取得/已释放的真实状态。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateCacheSession._admit
declaration_reviews.decision: runtime范围不全必须LookupError；版本token不可用只禁缓存，不回退旧语料版本或修改主查询范围。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateCacheSession._semantic_parameters
declaration_reviews.decision: options.retrieval_mode已有str契约，删除or hybrid默认；tenant/account/scope/token参数仍与exact及semantic一致。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateCacheSession.lookup
declaration_reviews.decision: exact/semantic读取失败仅记录cache skip，缓存确实可选；本地/分布式等待由专门生命周期方法接管。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateCacheSession._acquire_singleflight
declaration_reviews.decision: 本地Future是主检索结果，移出Redis降级catch后原异常传播；合法空list仍算follower成功，Redis异常仍旁路。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateCacheSession._follower_result
declaration_reviews.decision: 只接受已成功获得的候选list，设置本请求source/hit/finished并按top_k裁剪，不再在调用点探测未知形状。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateCacheSession.publish
declaration_reviews.decision: degraded主结果不进入exact/semantic且拒绝followers；正常结果完成本地与分布式publish并释放lease。

declaration_reviews.name: ChannelRequest
declaration_reviews.decision: query/options/resolved scope三者对应一次通道执行；不把整个Retriever传入collection。

declaration_reviews.name: ChannelRequest.mode
declaration_reviews.decision: options字符串用于mode分支，property统一读取本请求模式；不从全局可变Retriever临时状态取得。

declaration_reviews.name: ChannelRequest.fetch_k
declaration_reviews.decision: MMR按其fetch multiplier扩大，其他模式两倍；top_k与倍率有独立预算含义。

declaration_reviews.name: ChannelRequest.corpus_scope
declaration_reviews.decision: tenant不存在显式LookupError；documents优先，其他情况下从JSON dataset filter收集scope，保留安全范围。

declaration_reviews.name: ChannelPolicy
declaration_reviews.decision: BM25/lexical/exact fallback开关与pg_trgm未知状态来自配置；未知trgm确实需运行时探测。

declaration_reviews.name: ChannelPlan
declaration_reviews.decision: 计划记录三个执行开关及keyword策略诊断，不携带后端资源或无关context。

declaration_reviews.name: VectorRecall
declaration_reviews.decision: 分开records、per-shard batch、failure/admission timeout和elapsed，部分成功保持可观察。

declaration_reviews.name: MetadataExactRecall
declaration_reviews.decision: protected records、触发原因和exact失败属于该query，容器用default_factory防止跨查询共享。

declaration_reviews.name: KeywordRecall
declaration_reviews.decision: BM25 status与lexical outcome各有独立记录，elapsed与run_reason保留真实降级解释。

declaration_reviews.name: ChannelCollection
declaration_reviews.decision: 计划、vector、keyword、health共同表达该次收集；冻结外层不意味着内部结果不可变，后续normalizer仍按原策略更新。

declaration_reviews.name: ChannelCollection.channels
declaration_reviews.decision: 把三个channel实际records投影为HybridChannelResults供ranking准备，未执行annotation时stats为空是阶段状态。

declaration_reviews.name: ChannelCollection.failure
declaration_reviews.decision: 只有无任何通道候选时上抛admission timeout；部分成功与一般降级仍通过health明确记录。

declaration_reviews.name: plan_channels
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除完全未读取的query参数；固定mode/policy分支直接产生向量/BM25/lexical计划，保留keyword主次顺序。

declaration_reviews.name: collect_channels
declaration_reviews.decision: 公共函数每次创建新的collector并执行，保证所有请求临时状态都不跨调用共享。

declaration_reviews.name: _ChannelCollector
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实共享的是本次request/plan/通道outcomes；对象生命周期仅包一次collect。

declaration_reviews.name: _ChannelCollector.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: 必需request/policy/corpus明确注入，vector_store=None是真实工厂组装模式，health/outcomes每次新建。

declaration_reviews.name: _ChannelCollector.collect
declaration_reviews.decision: 直观mode分支保留vector/BM25/lexical既有fallback顺序及召回事件，不加入通用pipeline执行器。

declaration_reviews.name: _ChannelCollector._vector_search
declaration_reviews.decision: missing runtime不做错误空间搜索；shard failure、admission timeout与successful_shards分别记录，通道故障不是健康空结果。

declaration_reviews.name: _ChannelCollector._bm25_search
declaration_reviews.decision: BM25IndexNotReadyError必须传播给运维处理；其他通道故障记health及failure后允许既定fallback。

declaration_reviews.name: _ChannelCollector._lexical_request
declaration_reviews.decision: 以keyword filter替换同scope的metadata filter，使SQL召回与BM25范围一致，复用于普通与exact SQL。

declaration_reviews.name: _ChannelCollector._lexical_search
declaration_reviews.decision: Session上下文由此持有；LexicalOutcome可有partial records与failure，两者共同决定成功/降级记录。

declaration_reviews.name: _ChannelCollector._hybrid_lexical_search
declaration_reviews.decision: 先判断CJK metadata anchor及primary数量，再决定普通lexical/exact补充；保留未触发时明确run_reason。

declaration_reviews.name: _ChannelCollector._metadata_exact_search
declaration_reviews.decision: 这是已定义附加召回旁路，故障记录run_reason/failure后保留主候选；独立with Session不会污染其他通道Session。

declaration_reviews.name: _ChannelCollector._append_metadata_exact_results
declaration_reviews.decision: 按chunk_id保序去重，并把实际追加项登记protected_records供ranking后续保护。

declaration_reviews.name: empty_channel_metrics
declaration_reviews.decision: 每次新建timing/count/degradation形状，未执行通道0值是明确的cache-hit和失败前状态。

declaration_reviews.name: serialize_collected_channels
declaration_reviews.decision: typed channels/CorpusSearchResult/FusionPolicy已经给定list/dict/int，删除or空集合、重复int及dict探测；输出键和rounding不变。

declaration_reviews.name: RetrievalChannelHealth
declaration_reviews.decision: 本query的attempted/successful/failure集合是实际共享状态，各容器独立，不替换为无状态工具类。

declaration_reviews.name: RetrievalChannelHealth.started
declaration_reviews.decision: 记录通道尝试以区别从未运行与运行失败，set幂等符合重复fallback调用。

declaration_reviews.name: RetrievalChannelHealth.succeeded
declaration_reviews.decision: 成功同时登记attempted，允许部分分片成功与同通道失败共存。

declaration_reviews.name: RetrievalChannelHealth.failed
declaration_reviews.decision: 只发布错误类型名，保留降级可观察性而不把query/完整异常写入公开metrics。

declaration_reviews.name: RetrievalChannelHealth.publish
declaration_reviews.decision: 稳定排序原因和通道集合；只有尝试过且无成功时all_failed，不把未执行通道判为全失败。

declaration_reviews.name: _log_retriever_fallback
declaration_reviews.decision: 非关键旁路错误统一记录context和exc_info；保留历史rag.retriever类别，不反向导入HTTP装配器。

declaration_reviews.name: _normalize_exact_anchor
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除本地固定NFKC/regex副本，改直导ranking.metadata.normalize_exact_anchor；六处调用迁移，不合并不同metadata视图语义。

declaration_reviews.name: _append_metadata_anchor_values
declaration_reviews.decision: 外部metadata值可以是标量或list/tuple，只有字符串进入anchor；按(field,text)保序去重，保留真实JSON边界检查。

declaration_reviews.name: _iter_metadata_exact_anchor_values
declaration_reviews.decision: 先evaluable/display/indexed三个view再root，顺序与anchors.py仅root的版本不同，保留本结果投影职责。

declaration_reviews.name: _looks_like_metadata_exact_anchor
declaration_reviews.decision: 把公共metadata匹配核心绑定本系统normalizer；多个CJK判定/metadata搜索消费者共用明确anchor规则。

declaration_reviews.name: _metadata_exact_anchor_match
declaration_reviews.decision: query统一compact后与三view/root枚举匹配；空query正常无匹配，保留fields/values/primary_score契约。

declaration_reviews.name: _query_looks_like_cjk_metadata_anchor
declaration_reviews.decision: 至少四个CJK字符才触发额外SQL fallback，避免普通英文hybrid付出不必要DB成本，阈值是既有策略。

declaration_reviews.name: _results_contain_metadata_exact_anchor
declaration_reviews.decision: typed list/dict不再逐项探测未知形状；optional limit只判断一次，score解析仍保留明确raw channel容错。

declaration_reviews.name: _float_or_default
declaration_reviews.decision: 实际raw metadata/候选分数边界允许缺失或非数字，捕获TypeError/ValueError并按调用方明确default返回；与ranking版本异常范围不同不盲合。

declaration_reviews.name: _apply_metadata_exact_anchor_to_result
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留metadata exact分数/字段/多anchor信息及可选promotion；0 score仍可被明确match策略提升，非缺失默认。

declaration_reviews.name: _apply_exact_content_bonus_to_result
declaration_reviews.decision: 已有exact_phrase_score即不重复加分，优先indexed retrieval text并限定boost；保留phrase匹配字段与1.0上限。

declaration_reviews.name: _DocumentEnrichmentContext
declaration_reviews.decision: 十二个map分别承载SQL查得的user/dataset/readiness/pipeline/labels/governance，全部default_factory为本次补全独立。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin
declaration_reviews.decision: 与HybridRetriever实际session/config协议共同工作；主补全负责ACL/tenant/版本，neighbor/stitch/parent为独立既有后处理策略。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._enrich_results_with_db_metadata
declaration_reviews.decision: 主SQL/ACL失败不再返回[]伪装无证据；记录stats后原样抛出，finally仍关闭已经取得的Session。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._reset_enrichment_stats
declaration_reviews.decision: 只有调用方提供stats才清空/初始化本pass计数；无可选stats时不额外建共享状态。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._enrichment_runtime_state
declaration_reviews.decision: account空白在本身份边界归为未提供；dataset来自明确scope，embedding_runtime确实可由调用方传入或从scope加载。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._load_enrichment_chunks_by_id
declaration_reviews.decision: 仅查候选UUID id，有tenant时追加tenant过滤；无候选ids正常空map，SQL故障不在此吞掉。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._result_chunk_ids
declaration_reviews.decision: raw候选id可能缺失或非UUID，先转str再UUID只会有预期ValueError；移除无依据TypeError/AttributeError捕获。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._load_enrichment_chunks_by_pair
declaration_reviews.decision: 只查询id未解析候选的(document_id,index) pair，保留tenant范围及候选级映射，不改全表遍历。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._missing_chunk_pairs
declaration_reviews.decision: 外部metadata的UUID/index转换允许TypeError/ValueError跳过；去掉无法由标准转换产生的AttributeError遮蔽。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._load_document_enrichment_context
declaration_reviews.decision: 主document查询失败不再返回空context；正常无doc_ids才空记录，标题与权威元数据的SQL错误传到拥有Session的入口。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._query_document_enrichment_rows
declaration_reviews.decision: 明确12列ORM投影并应用tenant过滤；doc_ids来自查得chunks，逐行填充本次context。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._record_document_enrichment_row
declaration_reviews.decision: 列tuple按查询契约解包；JSON doc_meta/user有真实可变形状，保留验证，nullable authority/time/dataset按各自业务处理。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._authority_level
declaration_reviews.decision: ORM authority_level是nullable Integer；明确int或None，None为0，移除字符串猜测与广义转换容错，保留0至100约束。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._record_document_timestamps
declaration_reviews.decision: ORM DateTime明确datetime或None；不再吞AttributeError/TypeError，平台日期转换的ValueError/OverflowError/OSError仍是可选信号失败。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._record_document_parse_quality
declaration_reviews.decision: JSON parse_quality可为对象或数值；float只捕获真实数值转换错误并保留0至1范围，程序异常不再全吞。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._document_ready
declaration_reviews.decision: active_pipeline_ready显式False必须保留；再按archived/disabled/publication拒绝，status仅在没有显式ready时决定。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._document_active_pipeline_key
declaration_reviews.decision: 优先active_doc_pipeline_key，其次active hash再pipeline hash；确无版本时None是既有旧文档无版本语义。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._query_first_chunk_content
declaration_reviews.decision: 取首chunk的SQL故障不再默报空标题map；仍以doc范围和可选tenant过滤，不在已失败事务中继续ACL查询。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._populate_document_titles
declaration_reviews.decision: filename/doc metadata/首chunk确实可能缺失，交derive_document_title真实owner统一策略，避免复造标题规则。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._resolve_allowed_docs_for_enrichment
declaration_reviews.decision: account有而tenant无时显式空授权集合；无account保持既有可信范围模式，不制造默认身份。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._allowed_docs_for_account
declaration_reviews.decision: SQL/授权服务错误不再返回空授权集合伪装正常deny；从ORM UUID构建候选，保留dataset交集和check_member=True。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._resolve_enriched_results
declaration_reviews.decision: 按原候选顺序解析chunk、执行guard并补全；tenant下无法解析chunk计orphan并丢弃，不新增匿名绕过。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._resolve_result_chunk
declaration_reviews.decision: 先chunk id后document/index查候选map；JSON index/UUID的实际错误继续作为未解析，去掉AttributeError兜底。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._result_passes_enrichment_guards
declaration_reviews.decision: ACL、dataset、disabled、embedding和active pipeline仍全部检查；权威doc readiness map缺记录也拒绝，不再以空map跳过检查。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._increment_enrichment_stat
declaration_reviews.decision: stats确实可选，提供时已由reset创建相应计数，直接递增而不重新默认/猜类型。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._embedding_space_allowed
declaration_reviews.decision: per-shard expected hash优先；非vector/无score结果保留既有跳过空间校验语义，已有hash必须匹配存储版本。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._active_pipeline_allowed
declaration_reviews.decision: 已知active key则要求候选版本一致；确无active版本的旧数据保留现有允许策略，不自行恢复旧索引。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._merge_chunk_into_result
declaration_reviews.decision: 只在guard通过后用SQL chunk id/content/缺失metadata补全，再顺序合并文档标签、位置、治理与user信息。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._merge_document_labels
declaration_reviews.decision: 文件名/source标签按实际source_labels策略替换占位值，真实标题/层级字段的缺失才补全，不覆盖已给metadata。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._merge_chunk_positions
declaration_reviews.decision: page/page_number为0不再被当缺失覆盖；必填ORM chunk_index直接读取，删无依据广义catch。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._merge_governance_metadata
declaration_reviews.decision: 仅复制确实由document查询取得的authority/time/publication/supersedes；未取得时间不伪造当前时间或默认更新时间。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._merge_document_user_metadata
declaration_reviews.decision: 已有document_user优先；parse quality只在None时补，真实0分保留。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._apply_enrichment_metadata_filter
declaration_reviews.decision: 内部过滤器明确返回blocked/matched/summary，直接使用而不重复默认；过滤器自身错误传播，合法invalid-filter仍由边界fail closed。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._expand_results_with_neighbors
declaration_reviews.decision: 可选连续上下文SQL失败有日志并保留已授权主结果；pipeline-aware fetch和总添加上限仍在，扩展后由主流程再enrich。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._neighbor_anchor_state
declaration_reviews.decision: JSON的doc/index允许缺失，转换失败只使该anchor不可扩展；保留所需pipeline key，移除AttributeError兜底。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._doc_pipeline_key
declaration_reviews.decision: 共享读取doc_pipeline_key或doc_id加pipeline_hash；document_id确实可空，缺版本返回None而不合成任意版本。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._neighbor_needed_pairs
declaration_reviews.decision: 只为有效UUID/index生成给定窗口非负邻居，排除anchor自身，set消除重复SQL pair。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._load_neighbor_chunks
declaration_reviews.decision: 一个自有Session加载短文和相邻pair，finally始终关闭；doc/pipeline过滤仍分别在实际查询/组装边界执行。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._load_document_chunks_for_siblings
declaration_reviews.decision: 按具体文档集合与tenant查询，逐chunk应用desired pipeline过滤；不跨版本扩充短文。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._load_neighbor_pairs
declaration_reviews.decision: SQL tuple_只查needed_pairs，tenant和pipeline过滤保留；输出键是(str doc_id,int index)供context展开。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._chunk_matches_desired_pipeline
declaration_reviews.decision: 按每doc明确desired版本比对；没有请求版本才允许，不把一个doc的版本规则用于其他doc。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._stitching_score
declaration_reviews.decision: score来源仍可能是外部候选数值，预期TypeError/ValueError给已有0分旁路，移除AttributeError吞程序错误。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._split_stitchable_results
declaration_reviews.decision: 有效document/index进入连续组，其余保留singleton而不丢候选；index转换只捕获真实数值错误。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._append_stitched_run
declaration_reviews.decision: 空run在分组末尾是实际可能状态；非空run计算最高分、起点和最早位置供稳定排序。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._stitching_groups_for_doc
declaration_reviews.decision: 按index/原位置顺序连接连续run，遇间隔就结束当前run；不把不同文档或非连续块硬拼。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._stitch_results_for_continuity
declaration_reviews.decision: 只重新排序、不增删候选，关闭开关时原样返回；元数据与分数透传，未知位置保留singleton。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._auto_merge_parent_child
declaration_reviews.decision: 明确append/replace模式，先分组、选组、取父、组装；保留min_children/max_parents预算和pipeline身份。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._parent_child_merge_mode
declaration_reviews.decision: 此字段仍是既有str配置，当前拥有其replace/append规范和默认replace策略；未擅自修改root之外Settings。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._group_parent_child_results
declaration_reviews.decision: 以(document,family)隔离父子身份，只收明确child/parent角色；保留child id集合供replace时处理邻居。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._desired_parent_pipeline_by_doc
declaration_reviews.decision: 从当前实际候选记录每doc第一个版本约束，不将父取回与另一版本child合并。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._select_parent_child_groups
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留现有按最佳child分数选组、max_parents和replace min_children的策略顺序，本轮不改专项合并算法。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._best_child_score
declaration_reviews.decision: 对真实候选score求已有非负最佳分，坏数值可跳过但不再捕获AttributeError。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._fetch_parent_child_chunks
declaration_reviews.decision: 父查询为可选增强，错误可日志降级为空父map；本轮同时修复replace缺父丢child，使降级不再损失主结果。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._parent_child_lookup_scope
declaration_reviews.decision: family来自metadata文本，doc_id转换的预期失败只有ValueError；坏doc不参与扩展，不吞任意异常。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._query_parent_child_chunks
declaration_reviews.decision: SQL约束doc/tenant、parent角色与family允许集合，回读后再验证pipeline，保留父节点实际身份。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._parent_result_for
declaration_reviews.decision: 既有父结果就提升到max(existing,0.97 child)，新父复制实际SQL content/metadata；缺父仍None，保留完整字段与衰减。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._append_parent_child_results
declaration_reviews.decision: 原结果先保留，仅在首个选中child后追加尚不存在且确取到的父；不重复添加已有parent。

declaration_reviews.name: CandidateEnrichmentMixin._replace_parent_child_results
declaration_reviews.decision: 修复selected只包含已有或确取到的父，缺父/可选SQL故障时保留children和neighbor；成功替换顺序与0.97分数不变。

declaration_reviews.name: LexicalRequest
declaration_reviews.decision: query/top_k与明确RetrievalScope构成SQL召回请求，不接收动态module/context执行器。

declaration_reviews.name: LexicalOutcome
declaration_reviews.decision: records、trgm可用性与failure分别返回，部分FTS成功后trgm失败有真实表达，不伪装完全成功。

declaration_reviews.name: _LexicalRun
declaration_reviews.decision: 保存本次多种词法方法已收集records和一次trgm探测状态，容器独立，允许部分结果保留。

declaration_reviews.name: _lexical_search_config
declaration_reviews.decision: fts配置、fetch倍率/上限、trgm开关及最短query组成同一SQL预算；保留既有simple与限额规则。

declaration_reviews.name: _lexical_cjk_token_terms
declaration_reviews.decision: 只对含CJK问题分词，去短词/重复/被长词包含项并限16；数字与英文code在CJK query中仍可保留。

declaration_reviews.name: _lexical_base_query
declaration_reviews.decision: 实查所有生产调用都来自lexical_dataset_scope的UUID列表，删除无消费者的单UUID/None探测，统一dataset_ids list及IN过滤；tenant/publication/doc条件不变。

declaration_reviews.name: _lexical_result_from_row
declaration_reviews.decision: SQL9列投影一次转float分数并补身份；source的重复嵌套get改setdefault常量，保留metadata过滤拒绝结果。

declaration_reviews.name: _add_lexical_rows
declaration_reviews.decision: result来自上面已归一化行解析器，比较直接读score不再重复float/default；replace_if_higher策略不变。

declaration_reviews.name: _collect_lexical_fts_results
declaration_reviews.decision: tsquery builder由当前FTS/plain真实策略注入，rank排序与limit均在SQL执行，行交统一解析器。

declaration_reviews.name: _lexical_pg_trgm_available_now
declaration_reviews.decision: pg_trgm未知None才查询扩展，已知False不被当作缺失重复探测；状态归本run。

declaration_reviews.name: _collect_lexical_trigram_results
declaration_reviews.decision: PostgreSQL similarity和百分号operator匹配明确query，按rank limit后只替换更高分候选。

declaration_reviews.name: _collect_lexical_cjk_token_results
declaration_reviews.decision: ILIKE值经过转义、SQL绑定；条件加权与命中阈值是既有CJK策略，未用风格调整SQL算法。

declaration_reviews.name: _search_lexical_db_with_session
declaration_reviews.decision: 顺序FTS→无结果plain→可选trgm→CJK，保留PostgreSQL能力边界与partial records；排序直接用本run已float的score。

declaration_reviews.name: _escape_sql_like_term
declaration_reviews.decision: 反斜杠、百分号、下划线按LIKE转义，调用SQL始终指定escape，不能按短函数移除安全边界。

declaration_reviews.name: _metadata_exact_db_like_terms
declaration_reviews.decision: 提供原文/NFKC/中英文括号变体，按出现顺序去重，保留metadata exact召回兼容规则。

declaration_reviews.name: _metadata_exact_db_like_terms.add
declaration_reviews.decision: 嵌套闭包共享本次variants/seen，去空去重并保序，是实际变体收集状态，不新建工具类。

declaration_reviews.name: _metadata_exact_result_from_row
declaration_reviews.decision: 先真实metadata anchor匹配，再补SQL身份和candidate字段；去掉重复source get，0/未匹配仍按原匹配策略。

declaration_reviews.name: _search_metadata_exact_anchor_db_with_session
declaration_reviews.decision: JSON cast+ILIKE只做有限SQL候选，真实anchor解析后按必需candidate_score排序，不再次猜数值形态。

declaration_reviews.name: search_lexical
declaration_reviews.decision: 使用调用者Session不关闭/commit；故障返回已收集候选及原failure给collector健康记录，属于明确多通道部分成功协议。

declaration_reviews.name: search_metadata_exact
declaration_reviews.decision: 关闭/空query/非PostgreSQL正常不执行，SQL错误必须在LexicalOutcome.failure中保留，collector只将其当附加召回失败。

declaration_reviews.name: _effective_filter
declaration_reviews.decision: 给词法与metadata exact共同叠加scope.dataset_ids，不重复在每种SQL收集器各自重建范围。

declaration_reviews.name: parse_dataset_scope_values
declaration_reviews.decision: JSON边界支持eq/in/list及单值并保序去重；已验证键直接索引，UUID(stripped str)仅捕获ValueError。

declaration_reviews.name: collect_dataset_scope
declaration_reviews.decision: 按direct→and→or收集JSON filter的dataset身份；真实可能无范围时空list，不制造默认dataset。

declaration_reviews.name: _scope_from_and
declaration_reviews.decision: AND子条件可汇聚已知dataset集合，忽略非dict部分是当前filter范围发现协议，实际匹配仍由metadata_filters校验。

declaration_reviews.name: _scope_from_or
declaration_reviews.decision: OR每个分支都必须可确定dataset才能收集范围；任一未知分支就无确定scope，不能扩大安全过滤。

declaration_reviews.name: lexical_dataset_scope
declaration_reviews.decision: 词法SQL需要dataset UUID列表和旧行投影的单dataset string两个值，保留明确tuple而不引入万能context。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridChannelResults
declaration_reviews.decision: 三个候选list与pre-fusion stats分开命名；raw collection和normalization后的vector有不同值，不能混为同一阶段结果。

declaration_reviews.name: candidate_metadata_from_doc
declaration_reviews.decision: 把Doc metadata投影到候选，保留tenant/dataset/document/chunk及pipeline/plugin/schema views；pipeline JSON嵌套有真实shape检查。

declaration_reviews.name: result_content_from_doc
declaration_reviews.decision: Document.metadata直接读取；内部保留的display字符串即使为空也返回，不再把合法空正文换成索引增广文本。

declaration_reviews.name: result_key
declaration_reviews.decision: 按doc/index→chunk id→正文稳定hash确定身份；metadata/id确实可在legacy raw vector中缺失，保留显式优先级。

declaration_reviews.name: top_scored_results
declaration_reviews.decision: heapq自身支持空list，删除重复early return和top_k int/or默认；typed整数仍按max(0,top_k)限定，平分按identity稳定排序。

declaration_reviews.name: _filter_vector_results_by_document_ids
declaration_reviews.decision: 客户端document范围是Milvus pushdown可能因上限跳过时的实际二次安全检查；缺doc id不能穿过已请求范围。

declaration_reviews.name: _apply_vector_client_filter
declaration_reviews.decision: 仅runtime shards场景移除统一embedding_space_hash客户端条件，其他metadata条件继续逐项匹配，不删除tenant/dataset过滤。

declaration_reviews.name: _backfill_chunk_ids
declaration_reviews.decision: 已有id先统一为str并写metadata；缺id按doc_pipeline_key优先再doc/index lookup，不猜新id、不跨版本替代。

declaration_reviews.name: normalize_vector_channel_results
declaration_reviews.decision: 固定document过滤→client metadata过滤→id backfill直读；空列表每阶段自然无操作，删两层重复空结果返回。

declaration_reviews.name: prepare_hybrid_channel_results
declaration_reviews.decision: channel_items由内部channel结果构造，不再逐项探测dict；保留annotation/promotion的原score、副字段、计数与channel归属。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever
declaration_reviews.decision: 保留LangChain/Pydantic请求配置与公开sync/async协议；业务中间结果由CandidateBatch携带，PrivateAttr仅作为最后一次诊断快照，不参与该次排序输入。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._open_session
declaration_reviews.decision: 供enrichment和runtime调用取得SQLAlchemy Session的实际注入hook；取得资源的调用层仍负责with/finally关闭。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._resolve_tenant_uuid
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除app/scripts无调用的旧默认tenant转换；当前生产身份始终来自明确options/self scope，未新增默认身份。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._explicit_dataset_scope_ids
declaration_reviews.decision: Pydantic已经把dataset_id(s)解析为UUID，直接复用runtime_scope的UUID tuple去重排序，不再送JSON parser猜形态。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._dataset_scope_ids
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除已无生产消费者的document优先旧scope入口；实际ChannelRequest/ResolvedScope已经分别持有document和dataset范围。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._normalize_dataset_scope_ids
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除未用cls的class method及重复JSON解析；唯一活跃调用改用typed UUID tuple真实owner。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._with_dataset_scope_filter
declaration_reviews.decision: 两个self配置调用点保留instance convenience，但不重造过滤算法，直调用runtime_scope.with_dataset_scope_filter。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._dataset_scope_filter_value
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除与runtime_scope完全同体的单dataset/in构造副本，实例过滤方法已依赖实际owner。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._normalize_partition_keys
declaration_reviews.decision: 旧options/metadata路由入口可能给单字符串或集合，保留strip/保序去重及8项界限，不将这个实际输入边界当普通内部字段删掉。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._resolve_entity_partition_keys
declaration_reviews.decision: extract_partition_keys是已读的纯确定匹配函数，移除把程序错误降为空路由的广义catch；显式keys/entity优先级不变。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._merge_entity_partition_metadata_filter
declaration_reviews.decision: 用户已有partition约束与解析keys取交集，不覆盖或扩大原过滤；entity路由诊断仍不泄漏完整候选文本。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._resolve_embedding_runtime
declaration_reviews.decision: 旧八方法runtime链收敛到resolve_runtime_scope；tenant/dataset成立才查库，finally关闭且清理错误不覆盖主LookupError，保留原资源政策。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._default_embedding_runtime
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除与runtime_scope重复的default配置/hash逻辑，活跃hook直接依赖默认runtime真实owner。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._runtime_from_dataset_shards
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除中转None/单shard/多shard选择链，scope解析器已给最终runtime，无需再次解析同组datasets。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._resolve_single_dataset_embedding_runtime
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除不可达单dataset回退：此前有效tenant/dataset已必经shard加载返回或抛错，不会走到该第二套查询。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._load_single_dataset_embedding_runtime
declaration_reviews.decision: 随不可达单dataset入口删除重复SQL/metadata验证；现有load_runtime_shards拥有同tenant查询和缺失语义。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._resolve_dataset_runtime_shards
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除旧私有列表tuple装配和自有Session重复查找；活跃scope解析使用RuntimeShard明确类型和既有异常转换。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._dataset_runtime_metadata_by_id
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除旧字符串键metadata map查询副本；runtime_scope.load_runtime_shards仍检查tenant、缺记录、坏metadata。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._group_dataset_runtime_shards
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除第二处按runtime分组/hash更新实现，保留实际owner中的OrderedDict稳定顺序和空间身份。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._hybrid_search
declaration_reviews.decision: 现有调用方需要候选list接口；与batch接口返回契约不同，保留明确adapter及legacy覆盖入口。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._hybrid_search_batch
declaration_reviews.decision: 共享异常出口释放当前分布式lease并拒绝leader Future后重新抛出；这是实际资源保证，不按包装行数删除。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._hybrid_search_impl
declaration_reviews.decision: 解析options/scope→构造request→retrieve_candidates→更新诊断→抛failure，候选与错误从batch明确获得。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._resolve_hybrid_runtime_scope
declaration_reviews.decision: entity和dataset过滤合成后明确构造scope，Session只围绕解析器调用，finally关闭；未替代tenant/ACL产品模式。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._hybrid_channel_policy
declaration_reviews.decision: 三项实例bool允许None表示用Settings，显式False必须保留；返回本次collector的稳定policy。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._hybrid_ranking_policy
declaration_reviews.decision: 把已声明Retriever配置一次投影为Fusion/Dedup/Diversity/Rerank策略，真实字段组装而不是传整个模块。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._get_relevant_documents
declaration_reviews.decision: LangChain sync入口顺序为query/scope/budget、候选召回、enrichment/后策略、Document输出；公开框架参数保持。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._normalize_retrieval_query
declaration_reviews.decision: query长度限制是真实外部入口预算，再交共享normalize_query owner，保留original与normalization诊断。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._validate_retrieval_scope_requirements
declaration_reviews.decision: dataset/doc/metadata scope至少一种，否则仅CHAT_ALLOW_OPEN_SCOPE明确允许；不把缺scope自动换默认dataset。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._retrieval_search_budget
declaration_reviews.decision: reranker、family collapse、overfetch与MMR均有实际倍率/上限，保留预算分支而非按函数短小删除。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._retrieval_overfetch_reasons
declaration_reviews.decision: 文档预限定不必ACL过取；open scope ACL、active pipeline、metadata过滤分别解释扩大候选预算的实际原因。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._apply_retrieval_overfetch_bounds
declaration_reviews.decision: 实例None才继承Settings，随后真实mult/cap控制请求预算；未更改合法关闭上限0的语义。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._build_retrieval_debug_payload
declaration_reviews.decision: 显式记录预算、query规范与scope诊断；optional profile确实可缺失，字段和既有trace协议未改。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._retrieval_scope_kind
declaration_reviews.decision: 按documents→dataset_id→dataset_ids→metadata→open确定诊断分类，不承担或绕过实际权限检查。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._effective_retrieval_metadata_filter
declaration_reviews.decision: 同一entity/dataset合成规则提供给召回和最终enrichment，保留metadata_filter_enabled的配置意义。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._record_milvus_pushdown_debug
declaration_reviews.decision: Settings给定int与字符串、document_ids是Pydantic list；删除无依据TypeError/AttributeError catch及未知None诊断。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._invoke_hybrid_retrieval
declaration_reviews.decision: 明确把当前Retriever配置投影成该batch options覆盖，requested/search_k不同预算都保留，不探测输入对象。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._record_hybrid_debug_metrics
declaration_reviews.decision: CandidateBatch总由empty/serializer提供已知metrics形状，直接拷timing/count及degradation；删二次safe解析/默认0。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._safe_retrieval_timing_debug
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除单次safe-wrapper；内部已数值化timing无需重复get/float/广义兜底，原四个输出字段保留。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._safe_retrieval_count_debug
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除单次safe-wrapper；原vector/bm25 count在已知shape里直接读取，错误不再伪装全0。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._post_process_retrieval_results
declaration_reviews.decision: 主enrich后扩邻居/父合并，再只为新增identity做第二次enrich，随后metadata排序与治理/collapse/compaction，ACL收口顺序不变。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._enrich_retrieval_results
declaration_reviews.decision: 两个实际pass共同取得results/stats/count，不仅转发；runtime与最终metadata filter明确传给权限补全owner。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._record_late_filter_collapse
declaration_reviews.decision: before/count是已知整数，直接计算丢弃比率；删除广义catch和重复数值默认，仅空pass的可选stats计数保留0。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._reenrich_expanded_results
declaration_reviews.decision: 只有identity集合变化才重新查SQL/ACL，连续排序不触发无意义第二次补全；新邻居仍不能绕过权限。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._apply_retrieval_post_ordering
declaration_reviews.decision: metadata anchor排序及其诊断构成实际后处理阶段，保持query与stats而不是无职责单次转发。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._apply_retrieval_post_policies
declaration_reviews.decision: 顺序governance→family collapse→confidence compaction；原final counts和stitching标志保留。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._results_to_documents
declaration_reviews.decision: 只取requested_k，stitch是明确可选order-only旁路，失败保留已授权原顺序；最后构造真实Document并记录数目。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._document_from_result
declaration_reviews.decision: 去除内部expected embedding hash后复制明确定义的score/provenance字段，内容与chunk id保持最终候选契约。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._apply_governance_policy
declaration_reviews.decision: 只使用已enrich元数据做publication/supersedes过滤与authority/recency排序；无额外DB/model调用，三Settings开关直接展示。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._governance_policy_flags
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除唯一调用的三Settings字段转发，主治理函数直接读取bool配置，不再为一次元组解包跳文件位置。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._collect_governance_features
declaration_reviews.decision: 按实际doc id收集publication/supersedes，不给无doc_id记录编造身份；发布替代文档才抑制被替代项。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._governance_features_for_result
declaration_reviews.decision: 私有SQL补全字段优先，legacy metadata字段仍可缺失；数值转换只捕获真实TypeError/ValueError，authority一次归一化供后续使用。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._filter_governance_results
declaration_reviews.decision: 分别移除unpublished和已被当前published候选替代的文档，计数按实际删除数，不查其他空间。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._reorder_governance_results
declaration_reviews.decision: 维持score加boost再按原index稳定排序；avg/max的单行私有函数已内联，空boost的0是实际空集合语义。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._governance_scored_rows
declaration_reviews.decision: 一次读取配置/当前时间，逐结果以已归一化features计算boost，保留原index和base score供稳定排序。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._governance_base_score
declaration_reviews.decision: score=0明确保留，不再or回退retrieval_score；只有None才用次级score，坏数值依既有0分策略处理。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._governance_score_boost
declaration_reviews.decision: 上游features已把authority限到0至100并解析timestamp，删除重复clamp/int/float及catch，保留None时间和既定衰减公式。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._average_boost
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除仅一次调用的sum/len包装，直接在治理排序阶段计算平均boost。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._max_boost
declaration_reviews.decision: 删除仅一次调用的max包装，排序阶段直接表达空集合default=0。

declaration_reviews.name: HybridRetriever._aget_relevant_documents
declaration_reviews.decision: LangChain async协议保留，阻塞SQL/模型召回通过既有run_blocking_retrieval_call线程边界，不在事件循环直接执行。

declaration_reviews.name: RetrievalScope
declaration_reviews.decision: tenant/account可空来源于可信/未指定模式，dataset/doc tuple与metadata filter明确范围；不伪造默认身份。

declaration_reviews.name: RuntimeShard
declaration_reviews.decision: embedding runtime与该空间覆盖的dataset ids必须成对保存，避免跨空间查询。

declaration_reviews.name: ResolvedRetrievalScope
declaration_reviews.decision: scope、runtime ids/shards、keyword/vector filter及无dataset文档状态是解析后的稳定输出，不依赖Retriever可变临时字段。

declaration_reviews.name: ResolvedRetrievalScope.dataset_scope_ids
declaration_reviews.decision: scope可能由多个内部入口创建，公开只读property保证稳定UUID排序去重，为缓存key确定身份。

declaration_reviews.name: ResolvedRetrievalScope.missing_dataset_ids
declaration_reviews.decision: 按实际runtime shards覆盖计算缺失dataset，供channel health/cache admission显式失败而非默认空间搜索。

declaration_reviews.name: ResolvedRetrievalScope.corpus_scope
declaration_reviews.decision: 只有tenant存在才构造CorpusScope；None明确表示缓存不能准入，不使用默认tenant冒充身份。

declaration_reviews.name: normalize_dataset_scope_ids
declaration_reviews.decision: 只处理已声明UUID tuple，不解析未知JSON；多处scope/corpus解析需要稳定排序和去重。

declaration_reviews.name: default_embedding_runtime
declaration_reviews.decision: 默认embedding配置只在实际全局/多空间兼容模式选用，并替换当前空间hash；本轮Retriever旧副本退出。

declaration_reviews.name: dataset_scope_filter_value
declaration_reviews.decision: 单dataset用标量、多dataset用in，过滤值来自UUID tuple而不是手拼SQL。

declaration_reviews.name: with_dataset_scope_filter
declaration_reviews.decision: 复制可选filter后setdefault范围，不覆盖调用者已经给出的dataset条件；被lexical与Retriever共同复用。

declaration_reviews.name: build_vector_filter
declaration_reviews.decision: 按backend允许字段投影并处理page/img_url别名，必要时绑定dataset及embedding hash；document_user不错误推给向量存储。

declaration_reviews.name: load_runtime_shards
declaration_reviews.decision: 按tenant/dataset ORM查询，缺记录或坏metadata明确LookupError；按真实embedding配置分组，不用首dataset冒充全部。

declaration_reviews.name: resolve_document_datasets
declaration_reviews.decision: 必须查齐请求document ids，返回dataset集合和确实无dataset的文档状态，缺文档不会被无条件全局搜索替代。

declaration_reviews.name: resolve_runtime_scope
declaration_reviews.decision: 统一document/dataset→runtime/filter主流程；SQL故障转带cause的LookupError，配置ValueError保留，现有Retriever hook复用此owner。

declaration_reviews.name: _dataset_scoped_runtime_lookup_error
declaration_reviews.decision: 统一tenant与范围计数的PII受控错误描述，不回显原query/密钥，供调用方区分runtime不可用。

declaration_reviews.name: _is_dataset_scope_condition
declaration_reviews.decision: 递归识别外部JSON eq/in/list标量是否真的有dataset条件；不把空列表/None当已有安全范围。

declaration_reviews.name: _metadata_filter_has_dataset_scope
declaration_reviews.decision: AND任一条件与OR所有条件的范围逻辑保留；只是存在性判断，不代替完整metadata matcher授权。

declaration_reviews.name: normalize_document_questions
declaration_reviews.decision: document_questions是外部metadata边界，保留list/非空/保序去重与200字限额；max_items预算从循环内移到一次计算。

declaration_reviews.name: _format_metadata_view_value
declaration_reviews.decision: schema metadata允许标量/list/dict，0与False不在空值集合；按已定义上限格式化，不吞必需业务数据。

declaration_reviews.name: _format_metadata_view_value._clean
declaration_reviews.decision: 本格式化函数内部共享空白压缩动作，接收外部metadata原值是允许str展示的实际边界。

declaration_reviews.name: _metadata_view_header_lines
declaration_reviews.decision: 只展示display/evaluable两个dict view并保序去重，max_fields预算一次计算；字段值按metadata展示契约截断。

declaration_reviews.name: rerank_text_from_result
declaration_reviews.decision: content在入口已索引读取，删无效的result dict再探测；metadata view仍属于可选JSON展示，保留类型检查。

declaration_reviews.name: augment_retrieval_corpus_text
declaration_reviews.decision: rich header已应用时不重复增广；原正文未包含的questions才追加，空正文也能形成合法检索文本。

declaration_reviews.name: prepare_retrieval_document
declaration_reviews.decision: 直接Document.model_copy并移除无恢复价值的重构fallback/log参数；内部display key缺失与空字符串分开，重复准备不丢原正文。

declaration_reviews.name: question_channel_overlap_score
declaration_reviews.decision: 现有直接测试覆盖questions token重叠的纯函数；无I/O或备用实现，0表示无重叠，未因本轮规约擅自删除其计算契约。

declaration_reviews.name: VectorSearchRequest
declaration_reviews.decision: query/top_k/threshold与具体scope绑定，不能用全局Retriever临时字段决定该分片请求。

declaration_reviews.name: VectorShardResult
declaration_reviews.decision: 每个runtime shard单独返回records和failure，失败不冒充健康空结果。

declaration_reviews.name: VectorSearchBatch
declaration_reviews.decision: 聚合records同时保留所有shard结果，允许局部成功并让health判断整体降级。

declaration_reviews.name: VectorSearchBatch.failures
declaration_reviews.decision: 只读汇集真实非None错误，调用方按异常类型识别admission timeout。

declaration_reviews.name: VectorSearchBatch.successful_shards
declaration_reviews.decision: 没有failure的空结果也是正常成功分片，不按是否有records伪造失败。

declaration_reviews.name: search_dataset_vectors
declaration_reviews.decision: 按该dataset runtime生成query embedding，原tenant/doc/filter传Milvus，保留过取倍数及阈值后裁剪。

declaration_reviews.name: tag_expected_space
declaration_reviews.decision: 复制每个metadata后标expected hash，不能改共享raw记录来影响其他shard或请求。

declaration_reviews.name: search_runtime_shards
declaration_reviews.decision: 有限ThreadPoolExecutor由with关闭，逐shard预算和结果记录明确，最终稳定top_k聚合。

declaration_reviews.name: search_runtime_shards.execute
declaration_reviews.decision: 按shard空间构造filter，dataset-scoped与全局store路径是真实后端差异；失败保留原异常与shard身份。

declaration_reviews.name: search_runtime_shards.search
declaration_reviews.decision: backend budget admission是独立限流边界，失败形成该shard outcome，不能省略执行预算直接调用模型。

declaration_reviews.name: search_vectors
declaration_reviews.decision: 明确shards→单dataset runtime→普通store三条实际路径，统一返回VectorSearchBatch，不添加未知provider兼容分支。

declaration_reviews.name: __getattr__
declaration_reviews.decision: Module __getattr__ is Python's actual lazy-export protocol, resolves only declared targets, caches the resolved value and raises AttributeError for unknown names.

declaration_reviews.name: OpenAIReranker
declaration_reviews.decision: OpenAI-compatible subclass is a real APIReranker protocol implementation sharing transport/state while retaining its own wire format.

declaration_reviews.name: OpenAIReranker._build_payload
declaration_reviews.decision: Payload emits the OpenAI-compatible model/query/documents shape; max_chunks_per_doc is included only under its existing provider parameter flag.

declaration_reviews.name: OpenAIReranker._extract_results
declaration_reviews.decision: Results extraction belongs to the external OpenAI-compatible JSON boundary; retained its current partial-score tolerance rather than inventing a different provider schema.

declaration_reviews.name: DashScopeReranker
declaration_reviews.decision: DashScope remains a distinct protocol implementation because its input/parameters and output envelope differ from OpenAI-compatible APIs.

declaration_reviews.name: DashScopeReranker._build_payload
declaration_reviews.decision: DashScope payload keeps top_n=len(documents), return_documents=False and optional instruct semantics exactly.

declaration_reviews.name: DashScopeReranker._extract_results
declaration_reviews.decision: Extracts the actual DashScope output/results envelope; external output tolerance is not replaced with internal-data assumptions.

declaration_reviews.name: _scoring_session
declaration_reviews.decision: Real per-invocation aiohttp session context owner, finite5second shielded close. Capture only the escaping operation error; ambient caller except state must not turn close failure into successful scoring. Actual source fake72-case suite covers failure/primary/ambient ownership.

declaration_reviews.name: _ScoreCache
declaration_reviews.decision: Score cache legitimately owns its lock, LRU entries, cap and TTL; cache lifecycle remains local to each API reranker.

declaration_reviews.name: _ScoreCache.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: Constructor initializes fresh lock/data/configuration for each score cache instance.

declaration_reviews.name: _ScoreCache.configure
declaration_reviews.decision: Config receives typed cap/TTL and updates/evicts under the existing lock; removed redundant numeric/or coercion without changing disable/eviction behavior.

declaration_reviews.name: _ScoreCache._is_expired
declaration_reviews.decision: Stored TTL is already numeric; nonpositive TTL means no expiry, otherwise compares actual timestamps directly.

declaration_reviews.name: _ScoreCache.get
declaration_reviews.decision: Locked lookup distinguishes absent entry from score zero, expires old data and bumps retained entries in LRU order.

declaration_reviews.name: _ScoreCache.set
declaration_reviews.decision: Locked insertion retains size eviction and stores the actual numeric score/timestamp; no lock removal or speculative retry.

declaration_reviews.name: sigmoid
declaration_reviews.decision: Sigmoid is the explicit numeric normalization used only when requested by API scoring.

declaration_reviews.name: BaseReranker
declaration_reviews.decision: BaseReranker defines the real common sync/async provider protocol, not a hypothetical one-implementation factory framework.

declaration_reviews.name: BaseReranker.rerank
declaration_reviews.decision: Abstract synchronous rerank raises NotImplementedError until the concrete provider implements it.

declaration_reviews.name: BaseReranker.arerank
declaration_reviews.decision: Async adapter intentionally offloads a synchronous provider call using asyncio.to_thread; cancellation semantics remain those of that established thread boundary.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker
declaration_reviews.decision: Retain provider config, cache, rate and circuit locks; remove globally cached loop-bound session/destructor lifecycle in favor of per-call session ownership.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: Constructor establishes explicit model/key/URL/timeout, fresh locks/cache and lazy session without opening the network at module import.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker._cache_key
declaration_reviews.decision: Score-cache identity hashes actual query/document plus max_length/normalization; empty text deliberately disables this optional cache key.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker._rate_limit_sync
declaration_reviews.decision: Positive validated QPS determines one interval; removed redundant positive checks while retaining locked scheduling and sync wait.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker._rate_limit_async
declaration_reviews.decision: Async rate limiter keeps the same locked slot reservation and uses async sleep; no blocking sleep replaces it.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker._circuit_open
declaration_reviews.decision: Circuit open state is read under its lock using monotonic time.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker._record_success
declaration_reviews.decision: Successful API work atomically clears failure count and open-until state.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker._record_failure
declaration_reviews.decision: Failure threshold/reset updates are locked and set the actual monotonic circuit deadline.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker._ensure_session
declaration_reviews.decision: Delete lazy cached session acquisition; actual invocation context creates and closes the session in its calling loop.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker._build_payload
declaration_reviews.decision: Abstract payload callback is required by the actual APIReranker subclass protocol and must remain provider-specific.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker._extract_results
declaration_reviews.decision: Abstract results callback is required by the actual wire-format protocol, so its short abstract body is not an unused wrapper.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker._document_batches
declaration_reviews.decision: Batching computes stable ordinal/start slices from the already-bounded positive batch size.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker._normalize_scores
declaration_reviews.decision: Explicit normalize=False returns original scores; True applies the declared sigmoid transform.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker._async_retry_batch
declaration_reviews.decision: Retry now distinguishes HTTP response errors from connection/payload/timeouts; 401/403 no longer consume retry budget, while allowed statuses retain bounded backoff.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker._sync_should_retry
declaration_reviews.decision: Synchronous retry classification retains explicit retryable HTTP codes and transport RequestError policy.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker._sync_request_result
declaration_reviews.decision: A borrowed sync client remains borrowed; locally-created client uses with and configured timeout/proxy policy around the actual request.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker._scores_from_result
declaration_reviews.decision: External result entries retain current index bounds and partial-score alignment; catches now cover real numeric conversion errors only, not arbitrary programming failures.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker._sync_retry_batch
declaration_reviews.decision: Retry loop only repeats classified recoverable failures, consumes its finite budget and rethrows the original final error.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker._circuit_open_stats
declaration_reviews.decision: Typed string query hashing cannot fail under UTF-8 errors=ignore; removed its blanket catch while retaining hashed-query circuit-skip metrics.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker._configure_result_cache
declaration_reviews.decision: Optional score cache is configured from actual settings; disabled mode explicitly clears cache state.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker._prepare_rerank_documents
declaration_reviews.decision: Candidate IDs/text are required dataclass fields, read directly; truncation is governed only by the supplied max_chars bound.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker._resolve_cached_scores
declaration_reviews.decision: Cached zero scores count as hits; only None is a miss, and missing documents retain aligned original indexes.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker._fill_missing_scores
declaration_reviews.decision: Writes returned numeric scores into corresponding missing positions and optional cache entries using the same query/text key.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker._rerank_failure_metrics
declaration_reviews.decision: Failure metrics retain the real exception and hashed query; removed impossible hash recovery rather than suppressing actual API failure.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker._finalize_rerank_result
declaration_reviews.decision: Finalization preserves score ordering, stable score ties, top_n projection and provider/model identity; only redundant typed-query hashing catch was removed.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker.acompute_score
declaration_reviews.decision: Batch tasks now have an explicit owner: failure/cancellation cancels and drains peers before propagating the original error, without ExceptionGroup conversion.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker._batch_rerank
declaration_reviews.decision: Actual async response is consumed within async with and session rate-limit policy; session creation/close remains in the provider owner.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker.compute_score
declaration_reviews.decision: Synchronous scoring now honors the constructor's timeout instead of overwriting it from ambient Settings; finite batching/thread-pool ordering and failures remain unchanged.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker.rerank
declaration_reviews.decision: Public kwargs resolve None defaults once; explicit max_chars=0 can disable truncation and false normalization is preserved; transport failures stay visible.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker.arerank_legacy
declaration_reviews.decision: Legacy async interface retains its distinct list-of-dicts return contract and delegates actual asynchronous score computation.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker.aclose
declaration_reviews.decision: Delete obsolete cached-session close API; no noop compatibility method falsely implies lifecycle ownership.

declaration_reviews.name: APIReranker.__del__
declaration_reviews.decision: Delete unreliable running-loop destructor teardown; deterministic invocation and application owners now perform real cleanup.

declaration_reviews.name: DocumentReranker
declaration_reviews.decision: DocumentReranker is the real adapter between common candidates and the project's document-level providers.

declaration_reviews.name: DocumentReranker.run
declaration_reviews.decision: Abstract run signature is shared by weighted/parent-child/LLM implementations and retains framework-required optional arguments.

declaration_reviews.name: DocumentReranker._rerank_run_options
declaration_reviews.decision: Provider option selection is a real overridable hook used by LLMReranker to pass tenant/query context, so its default empty dict is valid.

declaration_reviews.name: DocumentReranker.rerank
declaration_reviews.decision: Adapter copies required candidate metadata, attaches candidate_id, invokes run and projects actual returned IDs/scores without an unnecessary None metadata fallback.

declaration_reviews.name: reset_reranker_caches
declaration_reviews.decision: Actual shutdown after worker draining clears process cache dictionaries under existing locks, then delegates LLM cache reset. It does not close borrowed HTTP transports or invalidate an independently held model; pool owner closes later.

declaration_reviews.name: _api_cache_key
declaration_reviews.decision: API cache key hashes all model/URL/key/timeout/init options; secrets never appear as plaintext cache-key components.

declaration_reviews.name: _local_cache_key
declaration_reviews.decision: Local key hashes concrete provider/model or lambda components; this is a stable instance-identity contract.

declaration_reviews.name: _load_attr
declaration_reviews.decision: Dynamic attribute load is the actual deferred optional-provider boundary and is used by multiple real provider builders.

declaration_reviews.name: _get_or_create_cached_reranker
declaration_reviews.decision: Instance creation and cache publication remain inside the same provider cache lock; no unsynchronized fallback constructor was added.

declaration_reviews.name: _build_dashscope_reranker
declaration_reviews.decision: DashScope builder resolves real configuration defaults, provider URL, timeout and parameters once before cached construction.

declaration_reviews.name: _build_openai_reranker
declaration_reviews.decision: OpenAI-compatible builder separately resolves its configured base URL/key fallback and keeps all init options in instance identity.

declaration_reviews.name: _build_llm_reranker
declaration_reviews.decision: LLM builder is an entry in the concrete provider dispatch table and loads the actual optional implementation only when selected.

declaration_reviews.name: _build_parent_child_reranker
declaration_reviews.decision: Parent-child builder is a real dispatch callback and intentionally constructs the local document algorithm without a transport.

declaration_reviews.name: _build_weighted_reranker
declaration_reviews.decision: Weighted builder requires weights and tenant context explicitly; absent mandatory weights remain a visible ValueError.

declaration_reviews.name: _build_long_context_reranker
declaration_reviews.decision: Injected long-context scorers stay uncached; deterministic default instances are keyed by actual selected model identity.

declaration_reviews.name: _build_mmr_reranker
declaration_reviews.decision: MMR builder preserves the two current request option names, explicit lambda zero and stable configuration-specific instance reuse.

declaration_reviews.name: _build_kg_reranker
declaration_reviews.decision: KG builder maps the concrete two KG provider names to their corresponding graph strategy and defers graph imports.

declaration_reviews.name: get_reranker
declaration_reviews.decision: Public factory checks retired/unknown providers and dispatches recognized aliases to concrete builders; no synthetic provider is invented on failure.

declaration_reviews.name: _IdentityReranker
declaration_reviews.decision: Identity reranker is the real disabled-provider implementation and keeps only its resolved provider metadata.

declaration_reviews.name: _IdentityReranker.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: Disabled/blank provider labels resolve to the existing none identity; this is an explicit optional-rerank contract, not tenant/model substitution.

declaration_reviews.name: _IdentityReranker.rerank
declaration_reviews.decision: A present score=0 is now retained rather than replaced by retrieval_score; actual malformed external score values still use the documented numeric default.

declaration_reviews.name: get_reranker_for_retrieval
declaration_reviews.decision: Retrieval entry distinguishes absent/disabled reranking from active provider construction and retains that explicit identity behavior.

declaration_reviews.name: get_rag_reranker
declaration_reviews.decision: Published deprecated factory remains an observable warnings-based migration entry with its existing llm default and pc alias; not deleted merely because app callers migrated.

declaration_reviews.name: KGReranker
declaration_reviews.decision: KGReranker is the real async graph integration, distinct from ordinary synchronous document scoring.

declaration_reviews.name: KGReranker.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: Constructor stores the required concrete graph strategy.

declaration_reviews.name: KGReranker.rerank
declaration_reviews.decision: Sync method explicitly raises the documented unsupported-operation error; it must not fabricate empty graph results.

declaration_reviews.name: KGReranker.arerank_kg
declaration_reviews.decision: Async graph method dispatches PageRank/RRF with real event/config inputs and projects their required events/clues/stats without changing graph semantics.

declaration_reviews.name: get_kg_reranker
declaration_reviews.decision: Strategy cache stores stateless graph adapters; no per-query graph evidence is retained on the shared instance.

declaration_reviews.name: reset_llm_reranker
declaration_reviews.decision: Actual lock-protected singleton reference reset after worker draining. Cached model borrows pool transport; no invented model.close or per-user closure is introduced.

declaration_reviews.name: LLMRerankResult
declaration_reviews.decision: LLMRerankResult is the concrete raw-result contract with IDs, numeric scores, elapsed time and actual model identity.

declaration_reviews.name: _build_http_clients
declaration_reviews.decision: Remove independently created once-used HTTP clients. LLM construction borrows actual pool clients, so partial SDK construction does not create ownerless transports.

declaration_reviews.name: _extract_json_array
declaration_reviews.decision: Model text may omit a JSON array; extraction returns explicit absence instead of inventing an array.

declaration_reviews.name: _clamp_int
declaration_reviews.decision: External structure integers retain bounded conversion with TypeError/ValueError/OverflowError; arbitrary unrelated exceptions now propagate.

declaration_reviews.name: _clamp_score
declaration_reviews.decision: External scores retain their explicit numeric fallback/clamp and only catch the genuine numeric conversion failure types.

declaration_reviews.name: _sanitize_list_structure
declaration_reviews.decision: Optional model list structure is accepted only as a dict and bounds its documented numeric fields.

declaration_reviews.name: _sanitize_table_structure
declaration_reviews.decision: Optional table metadata permits only actual nonblank title/sheet text, clipped to the declared payload limit.

declaration_reviews.name: _sanitize_structure
declaration_reviews.decision: Structure sanitizer combines only valid nonempty list/table payloads; arbitrary metadata is not blindly forwarded into prompts.

declaration_reviews.name: _prepare_llm_candidates
declaration_reviews.decision: Candidate preparation uses real document content/identity and selected metadata fields, keeping original documents mapped by their IDs.

declaration_reviews.name: _document_meets_threshold
declaration_reviews.decision: A threshold of zero is distinct from no threshold; absent document score remains the existing metadata policy.

declaration_reviews.name: _append_ranked_documents
declaration_reviews.decision: Ranked document lookup retains unknown/duplicate-ID protection; required document metadata is read directly instead of repairing an impossible None.

declaration_reviews.name: _append_unreranked_documents
declaration_reviews.decision: Fills only unused qualifying originals in original order up to top_n, preserving the established partial-model-result policy.

declaration_reviews.name: _build_candidate_payload
declaration_reviews.decision: Raw candidates always supply a metadata dict; removed repeated or-empty guesses while retaining actual optional header/role/structure validation.

declaration_reviews.name: _vector_anchor_score
declaration_reviews.decision: External vector/score/distance values are parsed once at candidate preparation with the documented precedence.

declaration_reviews.name: _load_weight_mapping
declaration_reviews.decision: Config supports the current JSON-string/dict forms; malformed JSON remains its existing optional empty-map behavior, while only JSONDecodeError is caught.

declaration_reviews.name: resolve_llm_reranker_weight
declaration_reviews.decision: Tenant-specific weights outrank query-type weights, then the configured default; explicit zero weights are retained.

declaration_reviews.name: _finalize_rerank_scores
declaration_reviews.decision: Internal finalization now consumes already-bounded weight/vector/model scores directly, preserving vector-only fallback and stable score/ID ties.

declaration_reviews.name: LLMReranker
declaration_reviews.decision: Own model/chain configuration while borrowing transports from the application-owned pool; no misleading local close method is added.

declaration_reviews.name: LLMReranker.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: Use actual external sync/async pool clients and explicit LLM_TIMEOUT; failed ChatOpenAI construction leaves the borrowed pool open.

declaration_reviews.name: LLMReranker._candidate_id
declaration_reviews.decision: Candidate identity follows real candidate/doc/chunk metadata, then document/index and finally per-call index; no business tenant/model identity is fabricated.

declaration_reviews.name: LLMReranker._rerank_run_options
declaration_reviews.decision: Real document-adapter hook projects tenant_id/query_type only, keeping provider-specific kwargs out of unrelated run implementations.

declaration_reviews.name: LLMReranker.run
declaration_reviews.decision: Document flow builds candidates, calls raw provider once, appends ranked then untouched originals and enforces threshold/top_n.

declaration_reviews.name: LLMReranker.rerank_raw
declaration_reviews.decision: Raw model output keeps unknown-ID filtering and documented vector-only parse fallback; duplicate fallback branches now share the final scoring path.

declaration_reviews.name: get_llm_reranker
declaration_reviews.decision: Synchronize first construction and subsequent identity through a real threading lock shared with reset.

declaration_reviews.name: rerank_long_context_candidates
declaration_reviews.decision: Strict scorer returns the promised score map; removed fake empty-success fallback and repeated candidate copies, while a single bounded limit drives output and stats.

declaration_reviews.name: _default_long_context_scorer
declaration_reviews.decision: Required candidate IDs and tokenizer strings are read directly; only optional chunk-index metadata keeps narrow numeric-error recovery and its debug log.

declaration_reviews.name: LongContextReranker
declaration_reviews.decision: LongContextReranker owns the selected scorer and model label, with no per-request mutable results.

declaration_reviews.name: LongContextReranker.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: Explicit injected scorer is retained; only a genuinely absent scorer/model label receives the established deterministic default.

declaration_reviews.name: LongContextReranker.rerank
declaration_reviews.decision: Adapter passes the candidate sequence to its one conversion owner and attaches the real provider/model identity to the result.

declaration_reviews.name: _token_set
declaration_reviews.decision: Tokenizer already returns normalized strings; removed repeated str/strip conversion while preserving nonempty token set semantics.

declaration_reviews.name: _jaccard
declaration_reviews.decision: Empty token sets have an explicit zero Jaccard similarity and nonempty union computes actual overlap.

declaration_reviews.name: MMRReranker
declaration_reviews.decision: MMRReranker owns only its configured lambda, leaving per-query token and selection state local.

declaration_reviews.name: MMRReranker.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: Constructor bounds the concrete lambda once, preserving valid endpoint values including zero and one.

declaration_reviews.name: MMRReranker.rerank
declaration_reviews.decision: Required string IDs and locally-built token maps now use direct indexing; relevance/diversity formula, selection order and stable ties remain intact.

declaration_reviews.name: ParentChildReranker
declaration_reviews.decision: Concrete document-level provider implements the shared run protocol with no artificial extra transport layer.

declaration_reviews.name: ParentChildReranker.run
declaration_reviews.decision: Grouping keeps legacy parent fields, document/index fallback, best-child preference, stable score ties and explicit optional threshold semantics.

declaration_reviews.name: RerankerProviderFamily
declaration_reviews.decision: Frozen family metadata records canonical name, aliases, tier/category and real deferred modules without importing provider implementations.

declaration_reviews.name: get_reranker_provider_family
declaration_reviews.decision: Public optional string provider is trimmed/casefolded directly; removed arbitrary-object str conversion while preserving None/blank and unknown lookup results.

declaration_reviews.name: iter_reranker_provider_families
declaration_reviews.decision: Returns the immutable ordered family tuple as the actual metadata registry iteration contract.

declaration_reviews.name: list_registered_reranker_providers
declaration_reviews.decision: Projects canonical provider names in registry order; does not instantiate providers.

declaration_reviews.name: RerankerDescription
declaration_reviews.decision: Provider description shape explicitly separates the required provider/tier from its optional mode field.

declaration_reviews.name: RerankerCapabilities
declaration_reviews.decision: Capability shape distinguishes requested/resolved provider, aliases, tier/category and deferred modules.

declaration_reviews.name: describe_reranker_provider
declaration_reviews.decision: Description retains disabled aliases, retired families, unknown experimental labels and default openai; only unnecessary str coercion was removed.

declaration_reviews.name: get_reranker_capabilities
declaration_reviews.decision: Capabilities preserve requested alias and canonical resolution plus exact tier/module metadata without forcing optional implementation import.

declaration_reviews.name: list_reranker_capabilities
declaration_reviews.decision: Lists family capabilities from the single registry owner, keeping deterministic family and alias order.

declaration_reviews.name: RerankCandidate
declaration_reviews.decision: Frozen candidate carries required string id/text and independent metadata dictionary per instance.

declaration_reviews.name: RerankResult
declaration_reviews.decision: Result keeps ordered IDs, score map and independent item/clue/stats containers; elapsed/model/provider are genuinely optional.

declaration_reviews.name: SyncReranker
declaration_reviews.decision: SyncReranker is an actual structural protocol consumed by retrieval callers, not a runtime compatibility probe.

declaration_reviews.name: SyncReranker.rerank
declaration_reviews.decision: Protocol rerank signature promises a concrete RerankResult and intentionally has no executable algorithm body.

declaration_reviews.name: AsyncReranker
declaration_reviews.decision: AsyncReranker records the actual async structural contract separately from the sync interface.

declaration_reviews.name: AsyncReranker.rerank
declaration_reviews.decision: Async protocol method retains coroutine semantics and the concrete result contract.

declaration_reviews.name: RerankMode
declaration_reviews.decision: Existing enum names the real published document-rerank modes and is not replaced by an untyped string set.

declaration_reviews.name: VectorSetting
declaration_reviews.decision: Pydantic vector settings retain weight plus embedding provider/model identity as a concrete external configuration contract.

declaration_reviews.name: KeywordSetting
declaration_reviews.decision: Pydantic keyword setting separately records the actual keyword weight.

declaration_reviews.name: Weights
declaration_reviews.decision: Weights composes the two concrete configurations required by WeightedReranker.

declaration_reviews.name: WeightedReranker
declaration_reviews.decision: Provider owns tenant/weights/optional embedding callable and keeps result-specific work local to run.

declaration_reviews.name: WeightedReranker.__init__
declaration_reviews.decision: Constructor receives real required tenant/weight configuration and only the documented optional embedding dependency.

declaration_reviews.name: WeightedReranker.run
declaration_reviews.decision: Empty input now returns before any scorer work; zero threshold is honored, required metadata is not guessed missing, and assigned scores drive stable sorting.

declaration_reviews.name: WeightedReranker._calculate_keyword_score
declaration_reviews.decision: Keyword handler remains a real deferred dependency; concrete document metadata always exists and receives actual extracted keywords.

declaration_reviews.name: WeightedReranker._keyword_idf
declaration_reviews.decision: Keyword IDF uses observed document frequency and the existing smoothed formula.

declaration_reviews.name: WeightedReranker._tfidf_vector
declaration_reviews.decision: TF-IDF vector projects actual counts with zero for terms absent from the document vocabulary.

declaration_reviews.name: WeightedReranker._cosine_similarity
declaration_reviews.decision: Cosine returns zero only for a real zero norm and otherwise divides actual dot product by vector norms.

declaration_reviews.name: WeightedReranker._calculate_cosine
declaration_reviews.decision: Optional embedding callable selects actual query-vector computation; existing document scores/vectors retain their documented precedence and zero-vector behavior.

declaration_reviews.name: _log_orchestrator_fallback
declaration_reviews.decision: 共享非关键检索扩展失败的debug边界，保留原logger name、exception和traceback；不据此声称检索成功。

declaration_reviews.name: _safe_int
declaration_reviews.decision: 仍用于外部enrichment/候选metadata及已有可选state诊断；仅捕获真实数字解析异常，保留显式default/clamp语义；删对已类型化default/min/max的重复int转换。必需业务输入不通过此函数变成功。

declaration_reviews.name: _safe_float
declaration_reviews.decision: 仍供已有候选metadata分值/可选KG boost的既定默认与范围策略，非模型请求失败兜底；删对已类型化default/min/max重复float转换，未扩展新默认。

declaration_reviews.name: document_key
declaration_reviews.decision: 优先真实document_id+chunk_index（0有效），其次真实chunk/doc id；只有无ID的合法派生Document才按原content hash标识，非伪造DB身份。hash公式保留。

declaration_reviews.name: _coerce_optional_bool
declaration_reviews.decision: 真实调用方已通过Pydantic为bool或None，删除猜字符串/数字的共享兜底；两个KG stage直接区分None继承配置与显式False。

declaration_reviews.name: _top_relevance_score
declaration_reviews.decision: Citation relevance/retrieval scores are metadata-derived numeric values; an empty citation set has conservative score zero. Retain TypeError/ValueError handling, remove AttributeError masking of invalid internal citation objects.

declaration_reviews.name: _apply_abstain_thresholds
declaration_reviews.decision: Apply citation count, relevance, parse gate and mandatory recall gates in their existing priority; only update the per-request abstention decision and reason.

declaration_reviews.name: _apply_out_of_scope_guard
declaration_reviews.decision: Pass optional tenant/dataset identifiers and the explicit verifier callback to the existing live guard; verifier execution remains at its real optional policy boundary.

declaration_reviews.name: _record_abstain_metrics
declaration_reviews.decision: Serialize the computed decision and settings into metrics; optional verdict and optional request flags are legitimate missing values, not invented business identities.

declaration_reviews.name: _emit_retrieval_hardcase
declaration_reviews.decision: Create a bounded candidate only when enabled and empty/abstaining; preserve query/config hash payload, timestamp and existing candidate schema.

declaration_reviews.name: _parse_risk_enqueue_policy
declaration_reviews.decision: Read typed Settings score directly, clamp by the existing 0..1 business policy, and retain configured level parsing and empty-level default.

declaration_reviews.name: _emit_parse_risk_hardcase
declaration_reviews.decision: Metrics is initialized as a dict before this phase; remove its speculative isinstance fallback. Existing candidate and policy enqueue checks preserve duplicate prevention.

declaration_reviews.name: _run_retrieval_abstain_hardcase_phase
declaration_reviews.decision: All contract policy keys are constructed by resolve_retrieval_contract_policy; use its required visibility key and copy the complete enqueue-policy result without empty-dict fallback. Phase ordering remains unchanged.

declaration_reviews.name: _run_retrieval_parse_quality_phase
declaration_reviews.decision: Settings float/int fields are validated at settings construction; delete downstream conversion exception defaults while retaining business clamps, gate-profile normalization and optional external repair-action/schedule input.

declaration_reviews.name: _run_retrieval_metrics_core_phase
declaration_reviews.decision: The earlier runtime phases initialize required list/dict fields and anchor evaluation keys. Remove empty-container fallbacks for those fields; retain nullable learned-router metadata, optional second-pass diff and optional iterative gap.

declaration_reviews.name: _retrieval_channel_health_item
declaration_reviews.decision: Retriever debug/channels is optional observational JSON with heterogeneous missing fields; retain shape checks and bounded channel reason extraction instead of treating absent debug as retrieval failure.

declaration_reviews.name: _run_retrieval_channel_health_phase
declaration_reviews.decision: Aggregate only available channel health and preserve the legitimate no-primary-channel case; query budget and actual fallback counters come from earlier phases. Empty retrieval diagnostics remains an optional payload.

declaration_reviews.name: _run_retrieval_metrics_features_phase
declaration_reviews.decision: Parse summary, parse risk and anchor result builders construct all consumed keys, including no-data outcomes. Read those keys directly and retain rounding, feature schema, list caps and optional repair metadata.

declaration_reviews.name: _filter_strict_span_citations
declaration_reviews.decision: This gate must parse optional evidence positions and reject missing/non-increasing spans. Retain TypeError/ValueError validation, removing only AttributeError masking of broken internal objects.

declaration_reviews.name: _contextual_evidence_gap
declaration_reviews.decision: Adapt current mandatory source/anchor policy to the evidence-gap evaluator; disabled must-recall intentionally passes empty requirement lists and still requires one citation.

declaration_reviews.name: _extend_unique
declaration_reviews.decision: Append new reason/term strings in order with the existing optional limit; this is a real shared bounded collection operation, not a forwarding wrapper.

declaration_reviews.name: _contextual_query_spec
declaration_reviews.decision: The actual planner always returns query, reason_codes and selected_terms with string elements; use these required keys instead of re-coercing them or fabricating empty lists.

declaration_reviews.name: _invoke_contextual_followup
declaration_reviews.decision: An optional followup invoke may fail; preserve BM25 readiness propagation and existing recorded error/timing/per-query entry so failure remains distinguishable from no matches.

declaration_reviews.name: _safe_retrieval_doc_key
declaration_reviews.decision: Removed: document_key(Document) always returns a stable nonempty string, including content hash fallback; the wrapper only swallowed broken internal Document contracts into None. All owned callers now invoke the actual helper.

declaration_reviews.name: _merge_contextual_docs
declaration_reviews.decision: Merge typed Document lists while preserving current ordering and dedup keys. Use document_key directly; do not introduce another identity fallback after the identity owner.

declaration_reviews.name: _apply_contextual_followup_docs
declaration_reviews.decision: Only added documents update runtime evidence and counters. detect_evidence_gap always returns has_gap; use that required result directly and preserve gap-closed reasons.

declaration_reviews.name: _run_contextual_followup_hop
declaration_reviews.decision: Planner output is an internal complete dictionary, not an unvalidated remote response. Remove fake planner_spec_invalid branch, preserve not-used outcome, and rely on the gap initialized before the hop.

declaration_reviews.name: _run_retrieval_contextual_followup_phase
declaration_reviews.decision: Execute the existing maximum hops and latency budget in order, stopping when a hop cannot add evidence; no resource or asynchronous cancellation protocol is altered.

declaration_reviews.name: _invoke_hard_fallback
declaration_reviews.decision: The configured fallback is a real optional retrieval attempt. Keep its exception recording, BM25 fatal readiness signal, elapsed accounting and per-query error record.

declaration_reviews.name: _merge_hard_fallback_docs
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep main evidence before fallback evidence and deduplicate by the stable document owner; malformed internal Documents no longer become unidentified documents through a swallowing wrapper.

declaration_reviews.name: _run_hard_fallback
declaration_reviews.decision: Runtime docs/citations already exist; remove empty-list fallback, keep strict-span gate and actual added-document/citation counts and fallback-used meaning.

declaration_reviews.name: _run_retrieval_citations_hard_fallback_phase
declaration_reviews.decision: Use the required require_evidence_spans policy key. Preserve metadata anchor ordering, citation construction, strict empty-span reason and configured fallback trigger.

declaration_reviews.name: _temporal_document_ids
declaration_reviews.decision: Document metadata is external; preserve optional document_id extraction, dedup order and max-document cap before the freshness read.

declaration_reviews.name: _apply_temporal_recency
declaration_reviews.decision: Freshness lookup and recency boost are explicitly optional; existing logged exception metadata preserves failure visibility while retaining main docs and scope parameters.

declaration_reviews.name: _apply_hierarchy_tree_dedup_phase
declaration_reviews.decision: Hierarchy/tree configuration gates this optional operation; retain logged failure plus exception metadata, original refill pool and top-k/overfetch parameters.

declaration_reviews.name: _run_retrieval_fusion_phase
declaration_reviews.decision: The plan normalizer always supplies k and Settings supplies an integer diversity budget. Read these directly, remove repeated defaults/catch, preserve RRF inputs, diversity clamp, recency/dedup order and final truncation.

declaration_reviews.name: _bounded_kg_path_text
declaration_reviews.decision: External graph provenance scalar fields are optional and bounded before diagnostic export; preserve None and length semantics.

declaration_reviews.name: _safe_kg_path_provenance
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep the existing graph provenance field allowlist and 10-item limit; optional hops parsing stays observable through the provenance logger.

declaration_reviews.name: _safe_kg_path_items
declaration_reviews.decision: Graph path entries are external JSON; retain list/dict guards, allowed identifiers, omission of missing values and bounded count.

declaration_reviews.name: _run_kg_search_sync
declaration_reviews.decision: This is a real synchronous bridge over the KG coroutine. Preserve existing caller event loop, executor ownership and exception propagation; parameter contract differs from the planning bridge.

declaration_reviews.name: _kg_path_steps
declaration_reviews.decision: Validate external path entry objects and nonempty entity IDs, retain optional type and six-step cap.

declaration_reviews.name: _kg_event_features
declaration_reviews.decision: Select optional graph ranking features and sanitized provenance from a validated event object; absence of a feature is legitimate and does not fabricate it.

declaration_reviews.name: _kg_event_candidate
