declaration_reviews.decision: External event UUID and score parsing remains a boundary; remove AttributeError catch because UUID(str(...)) and float JSON conversion have concrete parse/type failures, retaining normal malformed-input rejection.

declaration_reviews.name: _collect_kg_injection_candidates
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve source order, UUID dedup, score/feature maps and existing candidate limit; invalid external event shapes are skipped at the event parser.

declaration_reviews.name: _fetch_kg_injection_rows
declaration_reviews.decision: A nonempty graph fetch requires a real Session. Remove SessionLocal failure to db=None conversion and list-or-empty wrapping; propagate resource/SQL failures, close only owned Session exactly once, preserve borrowed Session.

declaration_reviews.name: _kg_chunk_row_map
declaration_reviews.decision: Map persisted DocumentChunk UUIDs to rows for ordered reconstruction; this is an actual lookup conversion, not a one-step service forwarding wrapper.

declaration_reviews.name: _kg_document_from_chunk
declaration_reviews.decision: DocumentChunk owns guaranteed ORM attributes; use direct doc_metadata/chunk_index/page/start/end properties, while preserving nullable metadata/position semantics and stable chunk IDs.

declaration_reviews.name: _build_kg_injection_docs
declaration_reviews.decision: Reconstruct documents in KG candidate order only for rows actually returned by the ACL-scoped owner; missing rows remain legitimate no matches.

declaration_reviews.name: _run_kg_injection
declaration_reviews.decision: After the tenant gate, parse tenant UUID once, retain document/dataset scope from its owner and fetch cached/live KG candidates. Let fetch failures reach the owning optional stage rather than silently returning empty rows.

declaration_reviews.name: _run_retrieval_kg_injection_phase
declaration_reviews.decision: Real inputs originate as Pydantic bool|None; explicitly resolve None to settings and preserve False. Capture optional KG resource/search failures once into the existing error field and logger, leaving main docs and zero injection count.

declaration_reviews.name: _tag_document
declaration_reviews.decision: TAG input accepts Document or raw dictionary records; retain its content/metadata validation and observable construction degradation, which are external boundaries rather than speculative internal guards.

declaration_reviews.name: _tag_documents
declaration_reviews.decision: TAG state input is optional external JSON; only a list is accepted and at most ten validated documents are injected.

declaration_reviews.name: _safe_metadata_float
declaration_reviews.decision: Graph ranking metadata may contain malformed numeric JSON. Keep TypeError/ValueError defaults and the explicit optional fallback field, removing unsupported AttributeError catch.

declaration_reviews.name: _safe_metadata_int
declaration_reviews.decision: External optional graph count fields use the documented default; retain conversion errors and remove AttributeError masking.

declaration_reviews.name: _kg_confidence_buckets
declaration_reviews.decision: Map validated graph score to the fixed low/mid/high buckets; threshold order and zero-score behavior remain unchanged.

declaration_reviews.name: _annotate_kg_ranking_features
declaration_reviews.decision: Apply existing graph metadata clamps, anchored flag and confidence features only to graph-signaled evidence; preserve metadata behavior and feature names.

declaration_reviews.name: _annotate_kg_ranking_docs
declaration_reviews.decision: This diagnostic annotation sidecar has an existing logged optional failure boundary; retain it and avoid changing main retrieval evidence on annotation failure.

declaration_reviews.name: _run_retrieval_tag_kg_boost_phase
declaration_reviews.decision: Resolve typed optional boost bool once without accepting arbitrary string objects, preserve tag insertion order, external numeric knob parsing and existing boost algorithm inputs.

declaration_reviews.name: _PostRerankRow
declaration_reviews.decision: Typed row schema distinguishes required scalar/candidate fields from calibration fields assigned later; keep separate retrieval and optional rerank score semantics.

declaration_reviews.name: _post_rerank_minmax
declaration_reviews.decision: Normalize a numeric list and retain the no-data/constant-range branches; zero normalized scores are legitimate outputs.

declaration_reviews.name: _post_rerank_row
declaration_reviews.decision: Document identity always exists through document_key, so remove index identity fallback. Preserve optional external score parsing and remove unsupported AttributeError catches.

declaration_reviews.name: _calibrated_post_rerank_rows
declaration_reviews.decision: Keep the exact calibration formula, existing zero/None tie ordering and stable original-index fallback; sorting and normalization semantics were deliberately not rewritten.

declaration_reviews.name: _calibrate_post_rerank_prefix
declaration_reviews.decision: Calibration requires two eligible scores; retain skip reasons, per-document copied metadata, ordering counters and configured alpha.

declaration_reviews.name: _resolve_post_rerank_corpus_cache_token
declaration_reviews.decision: Cache context is genuinely optional when Session/tenant is absent; retain unavailable-token behavior, UUID parsing and logged cache-owner failure, while removing unsupported AttributeError catches.

declaration_reviews.name: _build_post_rerank_candidates
declaration_reviews.decision: A Document key is guaranteed; only blank text excludes a candidate. Preserve prefix limit, candidate metadata copy and ID-to-document reconstruction map.

declaration_reviews.name: _get_cached_post_rerank_result
declaration_reviews.decision: Cache disabled/missing corpus version/miss are distinct real outcomes; retain key inputs, hit/miss accounting and logged optional cache failure.

declaration_reviews.name: _execute_post_rerank
declaration_reviews.decision: RerankResult elapsed_sec is float|None and zero is valid. Use wall time only for None; preserve provider execution, cache hit return and optional cache-write logging.

declaration_reviews.name: _annotate_retrieval_score
declaration_reviews.decision: External score metadata may require numeric parsing; preserve fallback from retrieval_score to score and default zero for malformed primitive values, narrowing catches.

declaration_reviews.name: _build_reranked_document
declaration_reviews.decision: A reused Document construction preserves content, copied metadata and optional chunk-ID fallback; retained because it owns conversion at both ranked and untouched-prefix paths.

declaration_reviews.name: _build_reranked_prefix
declaration_reviews.decision: Preserve ordered_ids validation against actual candidates, duplicate removal, score annotations and remaining-prefix order; optional provider model fields are real RerankResult fields.

declaration_reviews.name: _post_rerank_settings
declaration_reviews.decision: Typed Settings alpha cannot need TypeError/AttributeError fallback 0.7; read it directly and preserve the existing business range clamp, cache settings and typed pipeline list.

declaration_reviews.name: _run_post_rerank_single_mode
declaration_reviews.decision: Internal docs are a required list and scalar parameters are already numeric; remove None-list defaults while preserving governed prefix, top-k floor, cache accounting and calibration flow.

declaration_reviews.name: _stage_top_n
declaration_reviews.decision: Read PostRerankStageConfig.top_n directly. Zero inherits previous/default budget; later stages never exceed the preceding prefix or actual document count.

declaration_reviews.name: _pipeline_noop_result
declaration_reviews.decision: A complete explicit noop result describes a valid pipeline with no final candidates; preserve all outcome keys and counters, copy the required docs list directly.

declaration_reviews.name: _append_stage_meta
declaration_reviews.decision: Append a bounded diagnostic record for each executed stage, retaining provider/top-n/candidate count, elapsed rounding and cache-hit serialization.

declaration_reviews.name: _run_post_rerank_pipeline_mode
declaration_reviews.decision: Typed stages expose provider/top_n attributes; preserve sequential stages, non-growing prefix, final-only score annotations, calibration and original tail order.

declaration_reviews.name: _initial_post_rerank_result
declaration_reviews.decision: This producer constructs every required stage outcome key even when disabled or empty. Copy required docs directly; retained explicit initial diagnostics are actual phase state.

declaration_reviews.name: _apply_pipeline_result
declaration_reviews.decision: Pipeline producers return complete keys including used/calibration/skip reason; use required indexing instead of missing-key false defaults and retain noop-to-single fallback decision.

declaration_reviews.name: _apply_single_result
declaration_reviews.decision: Single-mode producer returns complete docs, counters and calibration keys. Remove get/or defaults, including fallback that replaced an explicit empty docs result with stale evidence.

declaration_reviews.name: _run_post_rerank_stage
declaration_reviews.decision: Flatten repeated disabled/no-doc returns, consume required settings/result keys and retain provider-off behavior, typed model_dump pipeline diagnostics and the explicit logged optional error outcome.

declaration_reviews.name: _build_no_retrieval_response
declaration_reviews.decision: Bypass is a real intent policy outcome; retain optional incoming metrics/profile handling, empty evidence result and trace/router schemas.

declaration_reviews.name: _build_retrieval_request
declaration_reviews.decision: This is the actual state-to-typed-request boundary; optional overrides deliberately distinguish None from False/zero before building QueryPreparationOverrides and expansion budget.

declaration_reviews.name: _run_retrieval_bootstrap_phase
declaration_reviews.decision: Prepare one complete QueryPlan, then initialize runtime fields in existing order. Evidence option iteration and retriever model_copy stay at this stage boundary.

declaration_reviews.name: _run_retrieval_bootstrap_phase.llm_engine
declaration_reviews.decision: Nested closure lazily obtains the real engine only if a model strategy needs it and reuses it within one request; None is a real uninitialized lifecycle state.
